source: Open States (openstates.org), collected from the legislature's own website

bills.t: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering costs related to labor-related legal activity or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers
bills.sm: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering labor-related legal costs or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers through rates, charges, surcharges, adjustment mechanisms, riders, or reconciliation mechanisms; defines labor-related legal activity.

bills.t: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

bills.t: Relates to supportive housing procedures
bills.sm: Implements procedures and requirements for discharge from permanent supported housing programs.

bills.t: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"; prohibits certain food additives and food color additives; provides that in an action to enforce compliance, the recognition by the federal food and drug administration of any of these substances as safe may not be alleged as a defense; establishes requirements for the reporting of GRAS (generally recognized as safe) substances.

bills.t: Relates to the establishment of local comprehensive emergency management plans
tl: REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS
bills.sm: Requires the inclusion of local and municipal animal shelters, any duly incorporated society for the prevention of cruelty to animals and veterinary services when establishing local comprehensive emergency management plans; requires that information to the public include the communication accommodation needs of persons with vision or hearing impairments and information on which temporary housing and other necessary facilities are designated as animal-friendly.

bills.t: Requires the division for small-business to publish a small business compliance guide
tl: REFERRED TO COMMERCE, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESS
bills.sm: Requires the division for small-business to publish a small business compliance guide and post such guide to the division for small-business's website.

bills.t: Relates to the introduction and use of business records in grand jury proceedings
bills.sm: Provides that any writing or record made as a memorandum or record of any act, transaction, occurrence or event, may be received in grand jury proceedings as evidence of proof that such act, transaction, occurrence or event, if it was made in the regular course of any business.

bills.t: Relates to making the housing access voucher pilot program permanent
bills.sm: Relates to making the housing access voucher pilot program permanent.

bills.t: Prevents outsourcing during a hiring freeze
bills.sm: Prevents an agency, department, division, commission, bureau or any other entity under the authority of the executive department from contracting, subcontracting or hiring any third party during a hiring freeze.

bills.t: Requires soccer programs, lacrosse programs, ice hockey programs, and field hockey programs to provide informational packets about concussions to parents and guardians of children participating in soccer programs
bills.sm: Requires soccer programs, lacrosse programs, ice hockey programs, and field hockey programs to provide informational packets about concussions to parents and guardians of children participating in soccer programs; defines soccer programs, lacrosse programs, ice hockey programs, and field hockey programs.

bills.t: Relates to local block anesthesia certificate
bills.sm: Provides that a dental hygienist shall not administer local block anesthesia without a certificate and except under the personal supervision of a dentist and in conjunction with the performance of dental hygiene procedures authorized by law and in accordance with regulations promulgated by the commissioner.

bills.t: Authorizes full-time college students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their colleges are located
bills.sm: Authorizes, under certain circumstances, full-time college and university students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their college or university is located.

bills.t: Enacts the NYS PPE resilience & manufacturing act
bills.sm: Enacts the NYS PPE resilience & manufacturing act under which state-funded health care entities are required to purchase PPE manufactured in New York state for all contracts exceeding fifty thousand dollars.

bills.t: Relates to deadlines for filing nominating petitions for small city school board elections
bills.sm: Requires that nominating petitions for small city school district elections be submitted no later than thirty days prior to the election; makes technical corrections relating to such small city school board elections.

bills.t: Permits the Johnson City Central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
bills.sm: Permits the Johnson City central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

bills.t: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services
bills.sm: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services, or to contract with counties, cities, towns, villages, school districts or public or private nonprofit corporations, associations, institutions, or agencies concerned with the aging, for the operation and maintenance of such programs.

bills.t: Relates to the New York state workforce development board
bills.sm: Renames the New York state workforce investment board as the New York state workforce development board; revises the duties of the board.

bills.t: Relates to the requirements for certification for certified interior designers
bills.sm: Relates to the educational and examination requirements for certification as a certified interior designer.

bills.t: Relates to zoning modifications and permitting for building projects
bills.sm: Requires municipalities to grant zoning modifications within ten days of receipt of request for a modification under certain circumstances; provides that a municipality may authorize the developer of a building project to hire an approved third-party inspector for such building project; relates to permits required for certain building projects and exemption from county review for small residential projects; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

bills.t: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled
bills.sm: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled; makes technical corrections to language.

bills.t: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program
bills.sm: Authorizes municipalities to establish an emergency repair pilot program; enables municipalities to repair immediately hazardous code violations in buildings where the owner has not undertaken such repairs in a reasonable time.

bills.t: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names pertaining to household goods moving
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names by companies in the business of household goods moving; provides that companies may not use the words "mover", "moving", or "relocation service" or any abbreviation or derivative thereof unless approved by the commissioner of transportation.

bills.t: Increases the period of supervision required for certain real estate license applications
bills.sm: Increases the period of supervision to four years for real estate brokers applying for a license.

bills.t: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact
bills.sm: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact to increase public access to psychological services by allowing telepsychological practice and temporary in-person services across state lines.

bills.t: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

bills.t: Relates to alternate jurors
bills.sm: Provides that after an alternate juror has been substituted, the jury shall deliberate anew on all issues submitted to the jury at the outset of deliberations; exempts issues for which a verdict was already rendered.

bills.t: Relates to the qualifications to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools
bills.sm: Allows parents of a child who has ever received services through an English as a second language program to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools even if the child is no longer enrolled.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups
bills.sm: Makes permanent certain provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups.

bills.t: Requires notices on generative artificial intelligence systems
bills.sm: Requires the owner, licensee or operator of a generative artificial intelligence system to conspicuously display a notice on the system's user interface that is reasonably calculated to consistently apprise the user that the outputs of the generative artificial intelligence system may be inaccurate.

bills.t: Relates to access to fair and transparent real estate listings
bills.sm: Requires timely public advertising or marketing of listed residential properties on platforms accessible to the general public; permits non-public marketing only where the seller gives informed, written direction after receiving a standardized state disclosure that clearly explains the risks and tradeoffs of withholding a listing from public marketing.

bills.t: Requires the development and implementation of a tattoo policy by law enforcement agencies
bills.sm: Requires the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services, the superintendent of the division of state police, and the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision and the person in charge of every state law enforcement agency to adopt and implement a tattoo policy for all members of such law enforcement agency who are designated as police officers, peace officers and applicants for employment in such positions.

bills.t: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered
bills.sm: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered; requires the superintendent of financial services and the commissioner of health to develop a uniform form for consent for payment; provides that any non-conforming form shall be prohibited and unenforceable.

bills.t: Relates to supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors
bills.sm: Provides for supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors who meet certain experience requirements.

bills.t: Prohibits the sale of 7-hydroxymitragynine products
bills.sm: Prohibits the sale of products that contain 7-hydroxymitragynine at a level that exceeds 2% of total alkaloids or one milligram per serving; establishes fines for the sale of such products.

bills.t: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
bills.sm: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund for any loss, claim, action or judgment for which such school district is authorized or required to purchase or maintain insurance for the kinds of risks for which insurance is authorized.

bills.t: Relates to the definition of tidal wetlands
bills.sm: Specifies the marine and coastal district as part of the definition of tidal wetlands.

bills.t: Approves notice and proof of disability from an attending nurse practitioner
bills.sm: Approves notice and proof of disability or proof of need for family leave, or proof of disability for a special cross-bow permit, from an attending nurse practitioner.

bills.t: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
bills.sm: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

bills.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
bills.sm: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

bills.t: Relates to eligibility for the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage
bills.sm: Clarifies medicare part D enrollment requirements as they relate to eligibility for the program for elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage.

bills.t: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program
bills.sm: Relates to requiring employers to obtain an acknowledgement of receipt from employees of their sexual harassment prevention policy and sexual harassment prevention training program in writing in English and in employees' primary languages; requires employers to obtain acknowledgements from employees and keep such acknowledgements for six years.

bills.t: Phases out certain mandatory university fees for certain graduate students and adjunct staff
bills.sm: Provides that beginning in the 2026-2027 academic year, certain graduate students shall be required to pay 25% of all current and future mandatory university fees; provides that in the 2027-2028 academic year and thereafter, no mandatory university fees shall be charged to certain graduate students and adjunct staff, with the exclusion of the graduate student association student activity fee.

bills.t: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the bathrooms of private colleges and universities
bills.sm: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the commonly used bathrooms of private universities.

bills.t: Relates to hospital care for mastectomy, lumpectomy, and lymph node dissection patients
bills.sm: Requires that general hospitals that provide mastectomy surgery, lymph node dissection or lumpectomy provide information to such patients concerning options for breast reconstruction.

bills.t: Relates to certain guilty pleas
bills.sm: Relates to certain guilty pleas where the plea is in the interest of justice and which are entered into with both the permission of the court and the consent of the people.

bills.t: Relates to the election of school board members after the number of members has been increased
bills.sm: Provides that elections to fill an increased number of seats on a school board will be conducted at the first annual meeting after the meeting during which number of seats was increased.

bills.t: Relates to license requirements for professional geologists; repealer
bills.sm: Provides that the education requirements to be licensed as a professional geologist may be partially substituted by practical experience; relates to the issuance of an identification card as a geologist in training.

bills.t: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024, 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 school taxes for two parcels of land located at 67 and 71 College Road in Monsey.

bills.t: Repeals certain provisions relating to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to voting by members of the New York state authorities control board.

bills.t: Provides for the enrollment of certain persons in direct deposit for compensation payments
bills.sm: Provides for the enrollment of a surviving spouse, a surviving domestic partner, a dependent child or children, or any other person entitled to a death benefit in direct deposit for compensation payments.

bills.t: Directs the president of the state civil service commission to conduct a study on job vacancies across state agencies
bills.sm: Directs the president of the state civil service commission to conduct a study on job vacancies across state agencies and determine which, if any, state agencies are understaffed.

bills.t: Relates to certain lease terms for BOCES properties
bills.sm: Relates to certain lease terms for BOCES properties increasing the maximum rental period to 20 years.

bills.t: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act
bills.sm: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act, preventing homeowners' associations from adopting or enforcing any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or maintenance of low impact landscaping.

bills.t: Relates to posting financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidate for a member of the legislature
bills.sm: Relates to the annual statement of financial disclosure and the posting of financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidates for a member of the legislature.

bills.t: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings
bills.sm: Requires electronic filing of all lobbying filings with the commission on ethics and lobbying in government.

bills.t: Permits the Oswego city school district to create an insurance reserve fund
bills.sm: Provides that the Oswego city school district may establish an insurance reserve fund.

bills.t: Requires accurate interpretation of statements made by deponents with limited English proficiency in accusatory instruments and supporting depositions
bills.sm: Provides that an accusatory instrument or supporting deposition consisting of factual allegations by a deponent with limited English proficiency is not sufficient unless accompanied by a sworn statement from an interpreter affirming the accuracy of the English interpretation.

bills.t: Relates to the creation of a state-wide catalog for preapproved, construction-ready housing plans
bills.sm: Directs the department of state to create a state-wide catalog for preapproved, construction-ready housing plans; creates a housing infrastructure fund for infrastructure and housing assistance for certain municipalities certified as NEST communities; directs a study to be completed concerning the modification and establishment of minimum prescriptive requirements necessary to include three-family, four-family and six-family dwellings within the scope of the residential code of New York state.

bills.t: Relates to the supervision of athletic trainers
bills.sm: Increases the number of athletic trainers that a physician can supervise at one time from four to six.

bills.t: Relates to extending the duration of limited permits to practice licensed clinical social work and licensed master social work
bills.sm: Extends the duration of limited permits to practice licensed clinical social work and use the title licensed clinical social worker, or practice licensed master social work and use the title licensed master social worker from twelve to twenty-four months with the ability to be renewed for up to two additional one-year periods.

bills.t: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the council's recommendation.

bills.t: Relates to physical therapist assistants
bills.sm: Changes the definition of continuous supervision in relation to physical therapist assistants in both the home care setting and school setting by eliminating the joint visit requirement with the patient by the supervising licensed physical therapist and the licensed physical therapist assistant.

bills.t: Relates to providing education and outreach programs related to home visiting programs
bills.sm: Relates to providing education and outreach programs related to home visiting programs which provide support for pregnant and parenting families, and have been proven to improve outcomes for mothers, infants, and families; provides that such information shall include information on services available from such programs, eligibility, and relevant contact information.

bills.t: Extends eligibility for real property tax exemptions to certain veterans
bills.sm: Extends eligibility for real property tax exemptions to certain veterans.

bills.t: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration
bills.sm: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration.

bills.t: Relates to the issuance of license plates for disabled veterans
bills.sm: Relates to the issuance of license plates for persons rated one hundred percent disabled by the United States department of veterans affairs.

bills.t: Relates to exempting disabled veterans from certain fees relating to physical modification of a residence to accommodate a disability
bills.sm: Relates to exempting disabled veterans from application fees relating to physical modification of a residence to accommodate a disability, including permit fees, plan review fees, inspection fees and reinspection fees.

bills.t: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption
bills.sm: Defines "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption.

bills.t: Relates to the issuance of pool and health memberships to disabled veterans at certain SUNY and CUNY campuses
bills.sm: Requires that the state university of New York's board of trustees and the city university of New York's board of trustees shall each adopt a policy requiring all state university of New York, city university of New York, college, and community college campuses that offer membership programs to the general public for the use of fitness and aquatic facilities, to permit disabled veterans to obtain a membership for the use of fitness and aquatic facilities upon the same terms and conditions as apply to the general public, but without payment of any fees or other charges, or at a discounted rate; defines "disabled veteran".

bills.t: Relates to the election to participate in the federal education tax credit program; relates to the powers of the commissioner of taxation and finance
bills.sm: Clarifies that the board of regents is the sole entity responsible for electing to have the state participate in the federal qualified elementary and secondary education scholarships program pursuant to 26 U.S.C. Section 25F and that the board of regents is the sole entity to determine what entities are qualified scholarship granting organizations; prohibits the commissioner of taxation and finance from electing, or taking any action to implement an election or participate in the federal scholarship tax credit program established under 26 U.S.C. Section 25F unless the board of regents has elected on behalf of the state to participate in such program.

bills.t: Relates to requirements of youth sports organizations
bills.sm: Relates to requirements regarding athlete agreements with youth sports organizations, including disclosure of total annual costs; prohibits stay-to-play provisions; provides for athlete data privacy; prohibits youth sports organizations from restricting attendees from personal recording and photography; provides for investor liability, arbitration, and enforcement.

bills.t: Relates to enacting Eric's ID Law
bills.sm: Provides for the placement of a discreet nonapparent disability designation on non-driver identification cards, drivers' licenses and learners' permits; makes technical and conforming changes.

bills.t: Requires the attorney general's law enforcement misconduct investigation office identify employees and officers with a practice or pattern of misconduct and requires a review of certain cases
bills.sm: Requires the attorney general's law enforcement misconduct investigation office identify employees and officers with a practice or pattern of misconduct, use of excessive force, or acts of dishonesty; requires a review of such employees' and officers' cases.

bills.t: Establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) program; repealer
bills.sm: Establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) program to provide financial assistance and reimbursement to municipalities for the abatement, removal and replacement of lead-contaminated water supply lines; establishes the Consolidated Lead-line Elimination and Replacement (CLEAR) fund; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

bills.t: Establishes understanding artificial intelligence responsibility act
bills.sm: Establishes the understanding artificial intelligence act requiring developers of covered models to be strictly liable for certain injuries.

bills.t: Establishes a New York Main Street development center within the empire state development corporation
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Establishes a New York Main Street development center within the empire state development corporation to disseminate information related to existing state programs to address the redevelopment of existing commercial/residential "Main Street" buildings.

bills.t: Commending Dennis W. Spilman posthumously upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate
Commending Lt. Colonel Barbara Caldara upon the occasion of her designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate

Commending Corporal William L. Rood upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a New York State Senate Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate
Honoring Brigadier General Barry Hartman upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate
Commending Specialist Ruben Cespedes upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate
Relates to reporting of certain independent expenditures
bills.sm: Relates to reporting of certain independent expenditures and penalties for failing to report such expenditures; includes certain communications which use language or imagery substantially associated with a candidate's campaign, platform, background, or publicly stated positions, such that a reasonable viewer would understand the communication as designed to influence the outcome of such general, special, or primary election in the definition of independent expenditure.

bills.t: Relates to requiring manufacturers of internet-enabled devices to conduct age assurance to determine a user's age category
bills.sm: Requires manufacturers of internet-enabled devices to conduct age assurance to determine a user's age category and provide all websites, online services, online applications and mobile applications on such user's internet-enabled device and/or application store manufactured by the covered manufacturer with a digital signal that such user is a covered minor as well as the age category of such covered minor via a real-time application programming interface (API).

bills.t: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
bills.sm: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within thirty days before a planned price increase takes effect; requires utility providers to provide contact information and a mechanism to cancel service completely.

bills.t: Requires health care providers facilitate a screening for maternal depression within a certain time frame
bills.sm: Requires health care providers facilitate a screening for maternal depression, unless refused by the birth mother, prior to the patient leaving the birthing facility and during the first postnatal visit, and that such screening be covered by insurance.

bills.t: Relates to certain crimes of interference with health care services or religious worship
bills.sm: Relates to the definition of "reproductive health services" for purposes of the offense of criminal interference with health care services or religious worship in the second degree; defines "legally protected health activity".

bills.t: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises
bills.sm: Establishes minority youth-owned business enterprises in the state of New York and the city of New York; creates certain contracting opportunities for members of minority youth-owned business enterprises; establishes an implementation program and oversight committee for minority youth-owned business enterprises.

bills.t: Mourning the death of Dolores Huerta, pioneering labor leader, civil rights icon, and lifelong advocate for working families, women, and children
Allows drivers to contest license revocations, suspensions, and other penalties based on cases of mistaken identity and require identity verification prior to adverse administrative action
bills.sm: Require the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish that the record of the adverse action actually matches the person the department has penalized by establishing a three-point match with the licensee rather than just a name match; allows a driver to contest the determination if they believe it is a case of mistaken identity; provides for a stay/removal of any penalty until there is a final determination.

bills.t: Requires certain security features and warning labels on baby monitors
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution, sale, or offering for sale of a baby monitor that broadcasts audio or video through an internet connection unless it includes certain security features to prevent unauthorized access; requires a written warning label; provides penalties.

bills.t: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board; repealer
bills.sm: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board.

bills.t: Prohibits retaliation by cooperative housing programs against shareholders
bills.sm: Prohibits cooperative housing programs from engaging in adverse actions and retaliation against shareholders.

bills.t: Relates to health care for children; repealer
bills.sm: Removes the household income as a factor for determining eligibility for healthcare for children.

bills.t: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals
bills.sm: Increases the state subsidy for school lunch meals where at least thirty percent of the school breakfast service, lunch service and reimbursable snack program food was purchased from New York state farmers, growers, producers or processors in the preceding year.

bills.t: Authorizes remote electronic witnessing performed with an electronic notarization, facilitates recording of electronically executed conveyances, and validates electronic signatures on certain documents; repealer
bills.sm: Authorizes remote electronic witnessing performed in conjunction with an electronic notarization, facilitates recordation of electronically executed conveyances, and validates electronic signatures on powers of attorney.

bills.t: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours
bills.sm: Requires Medicaid coverage of applied behavior analysis therapy rendered during school hours in certain schools.

bills.t: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have committed a violation of certain illegal dumping laws
bills.sm: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have committed a violation of certain illegal dumping laws for a period of three years.

bills.t: Enacts the Trevyan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act
bills.sm: Enacts the "Trevyan Rowe child and young teen mental health community safety act"; directs boards of education to create policies, procedures, and guidelines for at-risk children and young teens who have demonstrated suicidal ideation, been victims of harassment or bullying, and/or who have eloped from school property; establishes a commission to evaluate the safety and security of children in primary and secondary public and private schools in this state.

bills.t: Prohibits artificial intelligence companions from using features which are considered unsafe for minors
bills.sm: Prohibits artificial intelligence companions from using features which are considered unsafe for minors; defines terms; specifies what are considered unsafe features.

bills.t: Relates to the responsible AI safety and education (RAISE) act
bills.sm: Amends provisions relating to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models under the RAISE act.

bills.t: Requires the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a statewide critical infrastructure security, condition and resilience assessment program
bills.sm: Requires the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a statewide critical infrastructure security, condition and resilience assessment program for the purpose of identifying vulnerabilities, evaluating infrastructure reliability and preparedness, and developing recommendations to reduce risks to public health, safety, security and economic stability; provides that such assessments shall be conducted at least once every three years.

bills.t: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records
bills.sm: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records; requires such notice to include information on a new application for confidentiality of records.

bills.t: Relates to penalties for a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Provides that a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims shall be liable for a civil penalty of five hundred dollars for a first offense and one thousand dollars for each subsequent offense; provides for concurrent enforcement by the director or commissioner of a municipal consumer affairs office or by the town attorney, city corporation counsel, or other lawful designee of a municipality.

bills.t: Relates to residency requirements for clerk in the village of Alden, county of Erie
bills.sm: Authorizes the village clerk of the village of Alden, county of Erie, to reside outside of such village, providing such residency is in an adjoining county.

bills.t: Relates to defining a victim of a sexual offense
bills.sm: Adds to the definition of a victim of a sexual offense by including a victim of unlawful dissemination or publication of an intimate image.

bills.t: Extends the urban deer management pilot program
bills.sm: Extends the urban deer management pilot program for an additional three years.

bills.t: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Relates to qualifications to hold the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector in the village of Briarcliff Manor
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Briarcliff Manor to provide that the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector may be held by residents of Westchester county, or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

bills.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to restrict the taking of fish, shellfish and crustacea in special management areas
bills.sm: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to restrict the taking of fish, shellfish and crustacea in special management areas.

bills.t: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
bills.sm: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2026--2027 assessment rolls.

bills.t: Relates to the Sag Harbor Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.
bills.sm: Makes technical corrections to chapter 492 of the laws of 1981 relating to incorporating the Sag Harbor Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc., and providing for its powers and duties; changes "fireman" to "firefighter" and makes corrections to certain references.

bills.t: Relates to licensing restrictions for on-premises alcohol consumption for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages at specific locations
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

bills.sm: Exempts the East Concord Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

bills.sm: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

bills.sm: Expands the area outside Montgomery county in which a deputy sheriff in Montgomery county may reside.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations
bills.sm: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations to 12/31/2031.

bills.t: Relates to the qualifications to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland

bills.sm: Allows a non-resident to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland.

bills.t: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and the modernization of certain language
bills.sm: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and modernization of certain gendered language.

bills.t: Relates to the residency of certain officers of the village of Washingtonville, Orange county
bills.sm: Expands the residency requirement for the village clerk, deputy village clerk, village treasurer, and deputy village treasurer of the village of Washingtonville such that such person need not be a resident of such village, but must be a resident in the county in which such village is located or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

bills.t: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
bills.sm: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

bills.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft.

bills.t: Requires automated external defibrillators at electric utility worksites
bills.sm: Requires at least one automated external defibrillator to be available at electric utility worksites where two or more electrical utility workers are performing work on electrical transmission or distribution lines of six hundred one volts or more; requires electric utilities to maintain emergency response plans with regard to the use of automated external defibrillators.

bills.t: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo
bills.sm: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo.

bills.t: Relates to fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings; extending effectiveness
bills.sm: Extends provisions of law providing for certain fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings to December 31, 2028.

bills.t: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act
bills.sm: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act to January 1, 2028.

bills.t: Extends provisions related to the regulation of the amount of Jonah crabs that may be taken
bills.sm: Extends provisions related to the regulation of the amount of Jonah crabs that may be taken for an additional two years.

bills.t: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage
bills.sm: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage, Nassau county, New York, Inc.; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; directs that certain taxes received shall be used by such benevolent association in furtherance of its purposes.

bills.t: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association; provides for eligibility of membership, purpose, powers and duties, organization meeting and by-laws, the control and disposal of funds and property and the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Allows persons holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery to be a resident of certain other counties.

bills.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises; repealer
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on and off the premises.

bills.t: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county.

bills.t: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc., within the town of Central Square, Oswego county from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program
bills.sm: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program for an additional 3 years.

bills.t: Establishes the "rural water utility modernization and security act"
bills.sm: Establishes the "rural state water utility modernization and security act" which requires the development and implementation of an action plan for the modernization and enhancement of cybersecurity at all rural water utilities in the state; requires SECURE program funding to prioritize rural water utilities.

bills.t: Provides for the incorporation of the New Hartford Volunteer Exempt Firefighters' Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Provides for the incorporation of the New Hartford Volunteer Exempt Firefighters' Benevolent Association.

bills.t: Relates to the first responder peer support program act
bills.sm: Establishes the "first responder peer support program act" which supplies peer-to-peer mental health programs to first responders.

bills.t: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises.

bills.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town, so long as such person resides in Allegany county.

bills.t: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
bills.sm: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

bills.t: Establishes the Clarence Center Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Establishes the Clarence Center Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for eligibility of membership, purpose, powers and duties, organization meeting and by-laws, the control and disposal of funds and property and the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No.1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No. 1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

bills.t: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. within the town of Granby, Oswego county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

bills.t: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such taxes into a community preservation fund
bills.sm: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such taxes into a community preservation fund.

bills.t: Relates to automatic license plate reader systems
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of automatic license plate reader systems or captured plate data by government entities except for certain purposes.

bills.t: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership
bills.sm: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department, located in the village of Williamsville, county of Erie, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership.

bills.t: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; makes technical amendments to the chapter incorporating such association.

bills.t: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules
tl: REFERRED TO COMMERCE, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESS
bills.sm: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules until January 1, 2028.

bills.t: Provides an exemption for certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions for on-premises alcohol consumption for certain manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages
bills.sm: Provides an exemption for certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises or to sell at retail for consumption on the premises; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

bills.t: Relates to requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
bills.sm: Provides for requirements for the appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management; requires financial institutions to provide all necessary bank statements for a Medicaid application to a requesting department of social services or other state or local agency administering public assistance or medical assistance within a reasonable amount of time of receipt of such request; requires a banking organization, branch in this state of an out-of-state bank or foreign banking corporation to provide such records within thirty days of receipt of such request.

bills.t: Relates to dispositional alternatives for children placed with local social services agencies as destitute minors
bills.sm: Allows the court to enter an order regarding a destitute minor freeing the child for adoption and granting guardianship and custody to the commissioner of social services for the purposes of consenting to an adoption; authorizes agencies, commissioners of public welfare and city public welfare officers to consent to such adoptions.

bills.t: Enacts "Francesco's law"; repealer
bills.sm: Enacts "Francesco's law" which establishes violations for the failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms in the presence of a minor or a prohibited person; requires the office of gun violence prevention to collect and analyze statistical and other information and data with respect to injuries or deaths of minors resulting from failure to safely store a firearm, rifle, or shotgun.

bills.t: Requires the public service commission to conduct audits of private water companies
bills.sm: Establishes the "small water utility transparency act"; requires the public service commission to conduct audits of certain private water companies; requires certain private water companies which are under certain investigations to file public updates on the status of compliance with such orders.

bills.t: Relates to automatic license plate reader systems
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of automatic license plate reader systems or captured plate data by government entities except for certain purposes.

bills.t: Requires veterinary clinics to file notice and documentation to the attorney general before completing certain transactions
bills.sm: Requires veterinary clinics to file notice and documentation to the attorney general to determine if certain transactions would be against the public interest for veterinary care access prior to completing such transactions; prohibits certain negative use restrictions imposed against veterinary clinics by private agreements.

bills.t: Requires electric scooter service platforms to maintain insurance coverage
bills.sm: Requires electric scooter service platforms to maintain liability insurance and provide proof of insurance.

bills.t: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for private institutions of higher education
bills.sm: Allows the alteration or repeal of real property tax exemptions for private institutions of higher education.

bills.t: Prohibits healthcare non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants
bills.sm: Prohibits healthcare non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants; authorizes covered healthcare workers to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.

bills.t: Relates to tax credits for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
bills.sm: Provides that for taxable years beginning on and after January first, two thousand twenty-six, a resident taxpayer who serves as an active volunteer firefighter or as a volunteer ambulance worker shall be allowed a credit against the tax imposed equal to eight hundred dollars; provides for a real property tax exemption under certain circumstances to an enrolled member of an incorporated volunteer fire company, fire department or incorporated voluntary ambulance service residing in such city, village, town, school district, special district, fire district or county.

bills.t: Empowers the council on the arts to designate Little Yemen as a cultural district
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Empowers the council on the arts to designate Little Yemen as a cultural district.

bills.t: Authorizes a person to limit the gambling self-exclusion to online platforms
bills.sm: Authorizes a person to limit the gambling self-exclusion to online platforms.

bills.t: Enacts the Bicycle Traffic Safety Education Alternative act
bills.sm: Enacts the "Bicycle Traffic Safety Education Alternative act" under which a person charged with a noncriminal traffic violation arising from the operation of a bicycle or bicycle with electric assist may elect to view a bicycle traffic safety education video approved by the commissioner in lieu of payment of a fine.

bills.t: Establishes a full year youth and young adult employment immersion program
bills.sm: Establishes a full year youth employment immersion pilot program for eligible youths and young adults between the ages of 16 and 24; directs the office of temporary and disability assistance to establish a youth or young adult employment immersion pilot program in 3 local social services districts, with one being located in the city of New York.

bills.t: Requires the public service commission to conduct audits of private water companies
bills.sm: Establishes the "small water utility transparency act"; requires the public service commission to conduct audits of certain private water companies; requires certain private water companies which are under certain investigations to file public updates on the status of compliance with such orders.

bills.t: Commending James R. Peluso posthumously upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate
Relates to health insurance and provider divestment
bills.sm: Provides that it is unlawful for any person to directly or indirectly own, operate, or control the whole or any part of a health insurance company and a health care provider; requires divestment within three years; prohibits health insurance companies and health care providers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

bills.t: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act
bills.sm: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act to prohibit any person from selling, offering for sale or use, or distributing within the state, any second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide; prohibits the use of either a first-generation anticoagulant rodenticide or a second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide within five hundred feet of a wildlife habitat area.

bills.t: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies
bills.sm: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies; requires divestment of the interest in one or more insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers; prohibits insurance companies, pharmacies, and pharmacy benefit managers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

bills.t: Establishes a learning module to provide education on tickborne illnesses in the state of New York
bills.sm: Establishes a learning module to provide education on tickborne illnesses in the state of New York for state medical colleges and universities, county departments of health, and the public.

bills.t: Relates to releasing victims of domestic violence from certain contracts
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes one or more individuals who are under a shared contract to opt-out of such contract without a fee, penalty or charge due to status as a domestic violence victim; prohibits the company from transferring any contractual or billing responsibility of such shared contract to any other account holders on such shared contract; prevents companies from prohibiting a person who has opted-out due to domestic violence status to enter into a new contract.

bills.t: Relates to exempting 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions
bills.sm: Exempts 116th Street in the borough of Manhattan between Riverside Drive and FDR Drive from certain bus lane and bus operation-related photo enforcement provisions.

bills.t: Establishes free public, state-run courses to prepare individuals to become state certified real estate appraisers, state licensed real estate appraisers, and state licensed real estate appraiser assistants
bills.sm: Directs the department of state to establish free public, state-run courses to prepare individuals to become state certified real estate appraisers, state licensed real estate appraisers, and state licensed real estate appraiser assistants.

bills.t: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "Prader-Willi syndrome residential stabilization and best-practice support act" in relation to providing services to individuals with Prader-Willi syndrome.

bills.t: Creates a temporary commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of Legionnaires' Disease caused by cooling towers in New York city; repealer
bills.sm: Creates a temporary commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of Legionnaires' Disease caused by cooling towers in New York city; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.t: Establishes a tax credit for food service establishment donations to food pantries
bills.sm: Establishes a tax credit for food service establishment donations to food pantries, in the amount of fifty percent of the fair market value of each of the taxpayer's qualified donations up to seven dollars per qualified donation, beginning with the 2027 tax year; directs the commissioner of agriculture and markets to promote local procurement of ingredients by eligible food service establishments to be used when preparing qualified donations.

bills.t: Establishes a pilot program on upper payment limits for prescription drugs
bills.sm: Establishes a pilot program on upper payment limits for prescription drugs; provides that an upper payment limit shall not be less than the maximum fair price for a drug published by the secretary of the US department of health and human services.

bills.t: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student from being home schooled in certain circumstances
bills.sm: Prohibits school districts from authorizing a currently enrolled public school student to be home schooled when the superintendent of the school district is notified of a pending child abuse or neglect investigation or if either custodial parent or a person instructing the child has been convicted of domestic violence, child abuse, or neglect.

bills.t: Establishes enhanced educational continuity reviews for certain students transitioning to home instruction
bills.sm: Establishes enhanced educational continuity reviews for certain students transitioning to home instruction; requires school districts to review whether the individualized home instruction plan for a child is being implemented as required pursuant to law and regulations.

bills.t: Makes major revisions to provisions of the alcoholic beverage control law relating to the issuance of licenses and hours of operation
bills.sm: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to the powers of the chairman and members of the state liquor authority (Part A); authorizes special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning (Part B); relates to permissible sales by license holders (Part C); allows multiple off-premises licenses (Part D); relates to licensing restrictions for manufacturers and wholesalers of alcoholic beverages and retail licensees (Part E); relates to the approval of seven day licenses to sell liquor at retail for consumption off the premises (Part F); relates to changes of ownership of a licensed business (Part G); relates to the issuance of temporary retail permits; makes…

bills.t: Prohibits nondisclosure agreements intended to conceal information about the development of a data center from the public or intended to prevent public review thereof
bills.sm: Prohibits municipal corporations from entering into a contract or other agreement that has the purpose or effect of concealing the details of the development of a data center from the public or preventing public review of a data center; prohibits data centers from entering into a contract or other agreement having such purpose; exempts agreements solely intended to protect trade secrets.

bills.t: Requires certain physicians or other authorized practitioners to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome
bills.sm: Requires every physician or other authorized practitioner attending pregnant persons in this state to offer prenatal testing for antiphospholipid syndrome as part of routine prenatal care.

bills.t: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "Count me out!: Ending New York funding of designated foreign terrorist organizations act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from knowingly providing material support or resources to designated foreign terrorist organizations; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.

bills.t: Establishes the New York flight grant program
bills.sm: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to establish the New York flight grant program to offer grants to municipalities, government organizations, or community not-for-profit organizations to apply for grants to use in negotiations with airlines to attract new, direct flights and service to airports in this state; appropriates $15,000,000 therefor.

bills.t: Authorizes the division of housing and community renewal to enforce building codes
bills.sm: Authorizes the division of housing and community renewal to enforce building codes for properties owned by local municipalities and housing authorities.

bills.t: Allows certain persons to practice as a mental health practitioner under supervision for a certain period of time if application and fee requirements are met
bills.sm: Provides that a person with a master's level degree required for practicing as a mental health practitioner shall be allowed to practice under supervision for a period of up to ninety days after the submission of the required application and fees.

bills.t: Extends the time period for recovery of energy performance contract costs incurred by school districts
bills.sm: Extends the time period from eighteen years to twenty-five years that a school shall be guaranteed recovery of energy performance contract costs from energy savings incurred by school districts over that time period.

bills.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island.

bills.t: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund; provides that the salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund whose employment with the police department of the city of New York commenced on or after July 1, 2000 shall be determined in the same manner as members whose employment commenced prior to such date.

bills.t: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve air quality, and reduce noise pollution by promoting the adoption of quieter, zero-emission landscaping equipment; provides for rebates at the point of sale for applicants purchasing or leasing certain equipment; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

bills.t: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members from 63 to 65.

bills.t: Relates to health insurance and provider divestment
bills.sm: Provides that it is unlawful for any person to directly or indirectly own, operate, or control the whole or any part of a health insurance company and a health care provider; requires divestment within three years; prohibits health insurance companies and health care providers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

bills.t: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies
bills.sm: Provides limitations on overlapping control between insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers and pharmacies; requires divestment of the interest in one or more insurance companies and pharmacy benefits managers; prohibits insurance companies, pharmacies, and pharmacy benefit managers found in violation of such provisions from receiving payment from certain state programs.

bills.t: Authorizes Michael O'Brien to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list to be a full-time police officer for the village of Le Roy
bills.sm: Authorizes Michael O'Brien to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the village of Le Roy, in the county of Genesee.

bills.t: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities
bills.sm: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities for fiscal year 2027.

bills.t: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be eligible for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany.

bills.t: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
bills.sm: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2026-2027.

bills.t: Authorizes Janay Gasparini, a part-time police officer, with the town of New Paltz police department to take the civil service examination
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Janay Gasparini, a part-time police officer, with the town of New Paltz police department to take the civil service examination and be eligible for appointment as a full time police officer for the town of New Paltz.

bills.t: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department.

bills.t: Authorizes Christopher Walser and Matthew Patire to each take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer
bills.sm: Authorizes Christopher Walser and Matthew Patire to each take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and to each be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the village of Skaneateles police department.

bills.t: Provides that the additional sales tax that Cortland county is authorized to impose shall not be subject to preemption
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Provides that the additional rate of sales and compensating use tax imposed by Cortland county shall not be subject to preemption.

bills.t: Relates to the qualification of voters
bills.sm: Relates to the qualification of voters; provides that a citizen who is seventeen years of age at the time of a primary election and who will be eighteen years of age at the time of the general election for which such primary election is held, shall be eligible to vote in such primary election.

bills.t: Relates to base proportions in assessing units in Nassau and Suffolk counties
bills.sm: Limits the amount of property tax shift between homestead/non-homestead and class share apportionment for local governments within and including Nassau and Suffolk County.

bills.t: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate Daniel Montalto on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
bills.sm: Authorizes Daniel Montalto to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.

bills.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities on the campus of D'Youville University.

bills.t: Relates to banning shock gloves
bills.sm: Prohibits any person, firm, corporation, association or agent or employee thereof from importing, manufacturing, selling, holding for sale or distributing shock gloves; makes possession of shock gloves a misdemeanor.

bills.t: Enacts the "licensure incentives and fee-support for testing (LIFT) act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "licensure incentives and fee-support for testing (LIFT) act"; establishes the social work licensure examination voucher program to provide low-income individuals vouchers to cover the cost of the examination, regardless of the number of examination attempts, required for licensure as a licensed master social worker or licensed clinical social worker.

bills.t: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester
bills.sm: Authorizes the taxation of state land in the county of Westchester.

bills.t: Relates to judicial diversion programs; repealer
bills.sm: Relates to judicial diversion programs; establishes a diversion part in each county; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

bills.t: Relates to the wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program; appropriation
bills.sm: Establishes a wastewater infrastructure and drinking water program for the purpose of making payments toward the replacement and rehabilitation of existing local municipally-owned and funded drinking water, storm water and sanitary sewer systems; makes an appropriation therefor of $5,000,000.

bills.t: Establishes the crime of private carrier package theft
bills.sm: Establishes the crime of private carrier package theft; designates private carrier package theft a class E felony punishable by a fine of not more than two hundred fifty thousand dollars.

bills.t: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund
bills.sm: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund to provide incentive payments to municipalities based on the number of eligible new housing units produced within such municipality.

bills.t: Enacts the "licensure incentives and fee-support for testing (LIFT) act"

bills.sm: Prohibits a person to offer or promote instant payout loot boxes to New York consumers.

bills.t: Relates to deadline for the processing of building permits by local governments and the city of New York
bills.sm: Requires local building departments to process and approve or deny applications for residential or mixed-use buildings within 30 days; provides that if the local department does not process the application within the required timeframe an applicant shall be permitted to retain a private professional to perform the permit review to determine compliance with state and/or local building codes.

bills.t: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. Spor Jr.'s Law requiring the establishment of September eleventh awareness curriculum or instruction for school districts
bills.sm: Enacts Firefighter Joseph P. bills.t: Increases the penalties for overtaking and passing a school bus
bills.sm: Increases the penalties for overtaking and passing a school bus; provides that for the first conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $350 nor more than $500; provides that for a second conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $500 nor more than $800; also provides that for a third conviction a person shall be punished by a fine of not less than $800 nor more than $1500.

bills.t: Relates to the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child
bills.sm: Includes the act of, when knowing the character and content thereof, a person produces, directs or promotes any obscene synthetic sexual performance, as committing the crime of promoting an obscene sexual performance by a child; defines "obscene synthetic sexual performance".

bills.t: Relates to establishing distinctive "In God We Trust" license plates
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to issue "In God We Trust" license plates.

bills.t: Relates to enacting the "vehicle streaming device ban" act
bills.sm: Bans the sale of certain devices which allow video streaming on the center console or infotainment center of a motor vehicle which are in view of the driver, and the use of such devices while a vehicle is in motion.

bills.t: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
bills.sm: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

bills.t: Establishes a presumption that certain refunds received by public utility companies shall be passed on to ratepayers
bills.sm: Establishes a presumption that certain refunds received by public utility companies shall be passed on to ratepayers through bill credits, direct refunds, reductions in future rates, or other methods that provide a direct and equitable benefit to affected ratepayers.

bills.t: Relates to the disclosure of artificial intelligence use in floor statements and debate by members of the legislature
bills.sm: Enacts the "compulsory artificial narrative disclosure for official rhetoric (CANDOR) act" in relation to requiring any member of the senate or assembly that rises to speak, read a statement, or enter comments into the official legislative record to verbally state a standard disclosure prior to delivering such remarks if such remarks were drafted in whole or in part by artificial intelligence or generative artificial intelligence.

bills.sm: Updates school concussion management and response protocols; requires that the injured student have returned to a full class schedule without academic accommodations prior to resuming athletic activity; authorizes physician assistants to evaluate pupils with concussions.

bills.sm: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to tickets to places of entertainment.

bills.t: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns
