bills.sm: Grants the gaming commission the authority to develop, and require racetrack operators to implement, fire protection systems requirements for stables and barns used to house horses at racetracks.

bills.t: Relates to decreasing the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers
bills.sm: Relates to decreasing the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers from twenty to five dollars.

bills.t: Replaces the word addict or addicts and the word addiction with the words persons with substance use disorder or a variation thereof
bills.sm: Replaces certain appearances of the words addict, addicts and addiction with the words person with a substance use disorder, person with a mental health disorder, person with co-occurring disorder, person in recovery, or a variation thereof.

bills.t: Requires a certain type of opioid overdose rescue kit be provided by the state to schools
bills.sm: Requires the state to provide a certain type of opioid and fentanyl rescue kit to schools.

bills.t: Relates to the number of members in the public service commission
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Increases the number of members in the public service commission from five to seven members.

bills.t: Prohibits persons in certain relationships to members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator
bills.sm: Prohibits spouses, domestic or romantic partners, persons residing in the same household, or immediate family members of members of the legislature from engaging in certain activities that are deemed an indirect interest of a legislator; defines indirect interest; provides an opportunity to cure a violation of such provisions.

bills.t: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority
bills.sm: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools and establishing the board of regents as the primary charter vetting and oversight authority; provides that charter school applicants shall first apply to the community district education council or the board of education of the school district for approval for renewal of a charter within a certain amount of time and public hearings shall be conducted on such proposed application; provides that school district funding shall be contingent on application certification by the community district education council or the voters of the school district.

bills.t: Establishes the fentanyl and xylazine test strip program
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE
bills.sm: Provides free fentanyl test strips to individuals at specified distribution facilities; requires a public awareness campaign on the dangers of fentanyl and the provision of the test strips.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of East Hampton, town of East Hampton, in Suffolk county to establish demonstration programs imposing monetary liability for failure of operators to comply with posted speed limits
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of East Hampton in the town of East Hampton, county of Suffolk to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with posted maximum speed limits.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of Quogue, town of Southampton, in Suffolk county to establish demonstration programs imposing monetary liability for failure of operators to comply with posted speed limits
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Quogue in the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with posted maximum speed limits.

bills.t: Commending Charles F. Wanits posthumously upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of a Liberty Medal, the highest honor bestowed upon an individual by the New York State Senate

Authorizes the village of Southampton, town of Southampton, in Suffolk county to establish demonstration programs imposing monetary liability for failure of operators to comply with posted speed limits
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Southampton in the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk to establish a demonstration program imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with posted maximum speed limits.

bills.t: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
bills.sm: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

bills.t: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission
bills.sm: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission; provides for redistricting following every federal census.

bills.t: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for student loan payments
bills.sm: Provides for a personal income tax deduction for student loan payments up to five thousand dollars.

bills.t: Relates to establishing the offense of false pretense
bills.sm: Relates to establishing the offense of false pretense; provides civil remedies for the victims of such crime.

bills.t: Requires vehicle rental agreements instruct renters to remove personal information before returning the vehicle and permits rental vehicles to have decals informing the renter to remove such information
bills.sm: Requires rental vehicles have any personal information removed from the vehicle once returned.

bills.t: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system
bills.sm: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system.

bills.t: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; repealer
bills.sm: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; implements the agreements between the state and the public employees federation.

bills.t: Directs utility corporations to petition the public service commission for approval of electric grid utilization metrics
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Directs utility corporations to petition the public service commission for approval of electric grid utilization metrics; directs the public service commission to determine which electric grid utilization metrics shall be approved and how such metrics shall be applied; directs the public service commission to submit an annual report to the legislature and governor.

bills.t: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide for a specific period of time
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide between June 11 and July 20, 2026.

bills.t: Requires electric corporations build make-ready infrastructure
bills.sm: Requires electric corporations build make-ready infrastructure to facilitate the charging of electric public serving fleet vehicles.

bills.t: Relates to disclosure of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires biennial disclosure by trustees or executors of amounts in trust for the perpetual care of cemetery lots to a cemetery association.

bills.t: Relates to service of certain notice of violations returnable to the environmental control board
bills.sm: Provides for service of notice of violations of any provision of title sixteen of the administrative code of the city of New York by the department of sanitation on a respondent that is a closed commercial establishment.

bills.t: Relates to contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
bills.sm: Relates to provisions governing contracting between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including new, renewal, and extension contracts.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Hamburg to extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include the village of Blasdell
bills.sm: Provides that once the board of trustees of the village of Blasdell abolishes its fire department, the town of Hamburg may extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include such village.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Lt. Gary A. Scott in the town of LeRoy, county of Genesee.

bills.t: Relates to education transportation contracts
tl: REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION
bills.sm: Relates to employment contracts between school bus workers and the department of education in a city with at least one million inhabitants.

bills.t: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
bills.sm: Provides for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises at 22 N Main Street in the village of Florida, county of Orange.

bills.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
bills.sm: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional five years.

bills.t: Relates to the calculation of full-time employment for purposes of the federal public service loan forgiveness program
bills.sm: Increases the amount of credit to be certified under the federal public service loan forgiveness program for faculty or teachers to five hours worked for each hour of lecture or classroom time.

bills.t: Prohibits the aerial and ground application of malathion and certain pyrethroid-based insecticides
bills.sm: Prohibits the aerial and ground application of malathion and certain pyrethroid-based insecticides within one hundred feet of any school, day care center or park.

bills.t: Relates to the purpose of the Macedon Center Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association, Inc., and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
bills.sm: Relates to the purpose of the Macedon Center Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association, Inc., and the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be eligible for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany
bills.sm: Authorizes Joseph Fredrick to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer with the village of Allegany.

bills.t: Establishes the category of "qualified group practice" for medical, dental and podiatric practices that comply with certain standards
bills.sm: Establishes the category of "qualified group practice" for medical, dental and podiatric practices that comply with certain standards and authorizes such practices to operate a malpractice prevention program.

bills.t: Relates to captive insurance for commuter vans, black cars, ambulettes and paratransit vehicles, and small school buses, pre-arranged for-hire vehicles, and accessible vehicles
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.535
bills.sm: Establishes a captive insurance program for commuter vans, black cars, ambulettes and paratransit vehicles, small school buses, and charter buses that are engaged in the business of carrying or transporting nine to twenty-four passengers for hire; pre-arranged for-hire vehicles and accessible vehicles; defines terms.

bills.t: Permits the redaction of certain physician's names on birth certificates
bills.sm: Permits the redaction of certain physician's names on birth certificates when such physician's license to practice medicine has been surrendered or revoked by the office of professional medical conduct.

bills.t: Relates to increasing monetary penalties for public health law violations
bills.sm: Increases monetary penalties for public health law violations; provides support for the nursing home quality improvement demonstration program.

bills.t: Provides for an adverse inference in disciplinary proceedings against testimony of correction officers who disable cameras
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Provides for an adverse inference against the testimony of an officer or other employee of the department of corrections and community supervision, where such officer or other employee violated department rules or regulations by turning off a facility camera or body-worn camera or otherwise prevented such camera or cameras from recording the incident which is the subject of such disciplinary proceeding.

bills.t: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No.1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
bills.sm: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No. 1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

bills.t: Authorizes Powell House, in the village of Farmingdale, county of Nassau, to apply for a retroactive property tax exemption
bills.sm: Authorizes Powell House, in the village of Farmingdale, county of Nassau, to apply for and receive a retroactive property tax exemption with respect to the 2024-2025 school tax assessment rolls and the 2025 general tax assessment roll.

bills.t: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
bills.sm: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

bills.t: Prohibits the sale of cleaning products containing triclosan, triclocarban or derivatives of such antibacterial compounds
bills.sm: Prohibits the sale of cleaning products containing triclosan, triclocarban or derivatives of such antibacterial compounds.

bills.t: Requires cytomegalovirus screening for every newborn
bills.sm: Requires cytomegalovirus screening for every newborn by administration of a urine polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test.

bills.t: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
bills.sm: Exempts the Cody Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. within the town of Granby, Oswego county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

bills.t: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Permits assessment of certain fees and costs upon wrongful denial of access to records under the freedom of information law when either the person has substantially prevailed, or if the agency failed to respond within the statutory time.

bills.t: Allows certain adult care facilities to arrange for limited nursing services
bills.sm: Allows an adult home, enriched housing facility, assisted living residence or special needs assisted living residence to provide for nursing services in the facility that are not continual, either by arrangement with a provider of nursing services or by employment.

bills.t: Relates to community health assessment reporting
bills.sm: Relates to the frequency of submission of community health assessment reporting; requires a report no more frequently than every six years.

bills.t: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
bills.sm: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to change his service credit from the improved career retirement plan to a 20 year retirement plan.

bills.t: Expands recycling of electronic products
bills.sm: Expands the public education and outreach program required to be developed by manufacturers of electronics and electronic waste collection sites.

bills.t: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in N.Y. City of certain construction projects
bills.sm: Relates to providing notice to school districts and nonpublic schools located in New York city of certain construction projects; requires the New York city department of transportation to provide written notice to such school districts and nonpublic schools of certain construction projects undertaken within three hundred feet of a building of such school districts or nonpublic schools.

bills.t: Relates to certain powers of the attorney general
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the denial of access to certain public records which relate to civil investigations; relates to the enforcement powers of the attorney general; authorizes the attorney general to investigate and bring any civil action addressing repeated or persistent discrimination in elementary and secondary schools; requires the compromise of any claim which the state may have for care, maintenance or treatment furnished in hospitals or other such facilities to be made accordance with parameters established by the office of the attorney general; allows the commissioner of health to waive bills or compromise bills for the maintenance, care and treatment furnished to patients in medical…

bills.t: Relates to utilization review program standards and pre-authorization for certain health care services
bills.sm: Relates to utilization review program standards; requires use of evidence-based and peer reviewed clinical review criteria; relates to prescription drug formulary changes and pre-authorization for certain health care services.

bills.t: Designates certain traffic enforcement agents as peace officers
bills.sm: Designates all agents employed by the city of New York police department in the titles of traffic enforcement agent I and traffic enforcement agent II as peace officers.

bills.t: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
bills.sm: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including an advance payment of 25% of the total award to cover expenses incurred in the first quarter.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax
bills.sm: Authorizes the town of Minisink to impose a hotel and motel tax at a rate of five percent.

bills.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
bills.sm: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Greene.

bills.t: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee
bills.sm: Establishes the New York road salt reduction council and the New York road salt reduction advisory committee to provide a mechanism for interagency cooperation and coordination to implement the recommendations of the report of the Adirondack road salt reduction task force.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to William Cornell
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the Wantagh state parkway from route 27 to Jerusalem Road in the hamlet of Wantagh, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau to William Cornell.

bills.t: Relates to including rescue inhaler prescriptions for asthma and other chronic respiratory diseases for individuals under age nineteen in the statewide immunization information system
bills.sm: Relates to including rescue inhaler prescriptions for asthma and other chronic respiratory diseases for individuals under age nineteen in the statewide immunization information system.

bills.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix to be a nonresident of such town
bills.sm: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

bills.t: Relates to a death benefit option for the wife of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo
bills.sm: Authorizes a death benefit option for the beneficiary of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo, a justice of the unified court system.

bills.t: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease certain sports field fences for advertisements
bills.sm: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease fences at the John E. Markel Memorial Park for advertisements.

bills.t: Establishes the "protecting consumers and jobs from discriminatory pricing act"
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of electronic shelving labels, digital shelf display technology, and surveillance pricing in food retail establishments and drug retail establishments; provides injunctive relief and civil penalties.

bills.t: Relates to child care assistance under the child care block grant
bills.sm: Provides that a caregiver may be eligible for assistance for child care under the child care block grant regardless of the hours the parent actually works.

bills.t: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of labor and the workers' compensation board to issue stop-work orders; establishes procedure for the issuance of such orders; establishes penalties for failure to comply with such orders.

bills.t: Relates to the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in districts and courts
bills.sm: Directs the legislature to ensure that the number of judges and justices in districts and courts is sufficient; directs the chief administrator of the courts to report on the sufficiency of the number of judges and justices in each court and to make recommendations on such numbers.

bills.t: Relates to including environmental pollution mitigation within the authorized purposes of industrial development agencies
bills.sm: Includes environmental pollution mitigation projects within the authorized purposes of industrial development agencies.

bills.t: Relates to civil penalties for certain fraud or misrepresentation of a material fact with respect to a financial product or service
bills.sm: Relates to civil penalties for certain fraud or misrepresentation of a material fact with respect to a financial product or service.

bills.t: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
bills.sm: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

bills.t: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent
bills.sm: Establishes procedures regarding orders of post-termination visitation and/or contact between a child and such child's parent and for modification of such orders.

bills.t: Makes permanent the provisions of chapter 396 of the laws of 2012, amending the education law, relating to services to out-of-state school districts by boards of cooperative educational services
bills.sm: Makes permanent the provisions relating to services to out-of-state school districts by boards of cooperative educational services.

bills.t: Relates to physical therapist assistants
bills.sm: Changes the definition of continuous supervision in relation to physical therapist assistants in both the home care setting and school setting by eliminating the joint visit requirement with the patient by the supervising licensed physical therapist and the licensed physical therapist assistant.

bills.t: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose certain information to customers
bills.sm: Requires motor vehicle repair shops to disclose whether parts supplied are under warranty and the estimate for all parts and labor; provides that no work can be done without the consent of the customer; provides for fines for violations of such provisions.

bills.t: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

bills.t: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry
bills.sm: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry and issue reports on both topics.

bills.t: Establishes a private right of action for deed theft
bills.sm: Establishes a private right of action for deed theft; provides that victims of deed theft may maintain an action against a deed thief or a bank that provides a loan that assists in the commission of deed theft; authorizes victims of deed theft to recover actual damages, treble damages and attorneys' fees; defines terms.

bills.t: Prohibits the public display of kratom advertisements
bills.sm: Prohibits the public display of kratom advertisements within a certain distance of schools.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership
bills.sm: Prohibits pre-payment penalties for mortgages secured by real property owned in a cooperative form of ownership where over fifty percent of the units are shareholder occupied.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a portion of the 2024-2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2025 general taxes.

bills.t: Establishes "Kyra's Law"
bills.sm: Requires the court to consider a child's health and safety when making a decision regarding child custody and visitation; directs the court to review certain information as it relates to allegations of child abuse, domestic violence and child safety.

bills.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
bills.sm: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

bills.t: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"
bills.sm: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"; prohibits pharmaceutical manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers from discriminating against covered entities and New York state pharmacies based on participation in the drug discount program authorized by section 340B of the federal public health service act.

bills.t: Relates to notice and inspection requirements for battery energy storage systems in a city with a population with one million or more
bills.sm: Requires community boards to provide public notice of any planned siting and construction of battery energy storage systems and to provide for annual inspections of such battery energy storage systems; defines "battery energy storage systems"; requires operators of such battery energy storage systems to submit to the requirements of community boards regarding notice and inspection requirements.

bills.t: Grants retroactive membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees
bills.sm: Grants retroactive Tier IV membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees employed by the city of Yonkers parks department for the period beginning in 2009 and ending in 2014.

bills.t: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for certain programs
bills.sm: Clarifies the eligibility of an employment agency for status as a small business for division of minority and women's business development programs by changing the basis from number of employees to annual receipts.

bills.t: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery
bills.sm: Allows persons holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery to be a resident of certain other counties.

bills.t: Prohibits the operation of N.Y. city transit authority subways or trains without a conductor on board
bills.sm: Prohibits the operation of NYC transit authority subways or trains without at least one conductor on board except where it is currently permissible.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks in certain cases
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks to ascertain the payment status of a student loan of an applicant for employment.

bills.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts)
bills.sm: Authorizes the city of Oleans assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts) for all of the 2025-2026 school taxes and all of the 2025 general taxes.

bills.t: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department
bills.sm: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department.

bills.t: Relates to a death benefit option for the wife of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes a death benefit option for the beneficiary of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo, a justice of the unified court system.

bills.t: Establishes a comprehensive study of highway construction and maintenance worker safety
bills.sm: Directs the department of transportation to conduct a comprehensive study of highway construction and maintenance worker safety; directs the department to gather feedback from stakeholders; requires the department to submit a report on its findings and recommendations.

bills.t: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities and insurers; relates to coverage for treatment for gender dysphoria
bills.sm: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities including hospitals, certain professionals, and insurers; requires insurance coverage for services or treatments for gender dysphoria or gender incongruence.

bills.t: Relates to homeowner natural disaster preparedness, home safety and loss prevention courses
bills.sm: Requires the department of financial services to fulfill certain requirements to implement homeowner natural disaster preparedness, home safety and loss prevention courses.

bills.t: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of deputy sheriff in the county of Montgomery
bills.sm: Expands the area outside Montgomery county in which a deputy sheriff in Montgomery county may reside.

bills.t: Relates to requiring certain distribution centers to be equipped with electric vehicle charging stations
bills.sm: Requires distribution centers which are 50,000 sq. ft. or more to be equipped with electric vehicle charging stations as determined by the secretary of state and NYSERDA.

bills.t: Designates March twenty-third as "Pakistan Day"
bills.sm: Designates March twenty-third as "Pakistan Day".

bills.t: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE
bills.sm: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data for incarcerated individuals in medication assisted treatment programs.

bills.t: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego and removing the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county and allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner
bills.sm: Reestablishes the office of coroner in the county of Oswego; removes the powers and duties of coroners from the district attorney in such county; allows Oswego County to appoint a coroner.

bills.t: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation; repealer
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Dissolves the Clifton-Fine health care corporation and transfers any remaining records, property, rights, titles, and interest to the Clifton-Fine health care corporation d/b/a Clifton-Fine hospital, a New York not-for-profit corporation and its successors or assigns.

bills.t: Increases penalties for certain speed violations
bills.sm: Increases penalties for certain speed violations.

bills.t: Allows the president of the citywide council on high schools to participate in the selection of the members of the board of education elected by the community district education council presidents
tl: REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION
bills.sm: Allows the president of the citywide council on high schools to participate in the selection of the members of the board of education elected by the community district education council presidents.

bills.t: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta
bills.sm: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the city of Oneonta not to exceed 6%.

bills.t: Relates to drivers of buses, taxis and livery vehicles using hands-free mobile telephones
bills.sm: Prohibits drivers of a bus, taxi or livery from using hands-free mobile telephones; provides for certain exceptions.

bills.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a composting symbol
bills.sm: Directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a composting symbol to denote composting-acceptable materials.

bills.t: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024, 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 school taxes for two parcels of land located at 67 and 71 College Road in Monsey.

bills.t: Relates to certain reforms for agencies subject to the freedom of information law
bills.sm: Requires agencies subject to FOIL requirements to promulgate rules and regulations regarding to whom a requestor may appeal a denial and how to request records from or appeal a denial; makes certain provisions relating to publication of contact information for FOIL requests and appeals.

bills.t: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
bills.sm: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of stealth crawlers
bills.sm: Prohibits the deployment of a stealth crawler in a manner that would damage, impair or burden the operation of a covered news source or otherwise cause a news source economic harm.

bills.t: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Relates to the Islip Terrace Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; makes technical amendments to the chapter incorporating such association.

bills.t: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits.

bills.t: Requires that certain land which was conveyed to the town of Riverhead in 2011 be leased to the YMCA of Long Island for the provision of recreational and community services
bills.sm: Requires that land formerly used as an armory which was conveyed to the town of Riverhead, county of Suffolk by the state in 2011, to be leased to the YMCA of Long Island for the provision of recreational and educational programs.

bills.t: Relates to retention of records relating to certain acts of alleged misconduct
bills.sm: Relates to retention of records relating to certain acts of alleged misconduct for the duration of the statute of limitations.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Arthur A. Reddy
bills.sm: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Deer Park Avenue between Parkdale Drive and Sylvan Road in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Trooper Arthur B. Reddy.

bills.t: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to extend a lease of certain state lands located in the hamlet of Farmingdale, town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, state of New York
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to execute a one-time extension of an existing lease of state-owned lands located at 1 and 2 Marriott Plaza located in the hamlet of Farmingdale, town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, state of New York.

bills.t: Makes certain exceptions for violations pertaining to certain mufflers and exhaust systems
bills.sm: Excepts violations pertaining to mufflers and exhaust systems for cars, motorcycle exhaust devices without internal baffles and motorcycle exhaust devices that are intentionally designed to allow for the internal baffling to be fully or partially removed or interchangeable from having a summons not issued or having a summons dismissed if the violation is corrected.

bills.t: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways
bills.sm: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

bills.t: Creates the substance use disorder treatment bill of rights to be posted in a conspicuous place in all treatment facilities
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
bills.sm: Creates the substance use disorder treatment bill of rights to be posted in a conspicuous place in all treatment facilities.

bills.t: Relates to the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution
bills.sm: Authorizes the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution submitted to the people to be determined by enactment in a separate joint resolution passed by both houses of the legislature at least 120 days prior to the general election where such amendment to the constitution shall be submitted.

bills.t: Relates to protections against utility termination for medical emergencies, life-support equipment and elderly, blind and disabled customers
bills.sm: Establishes uniform definitions, standardized procedures, and uniform applications or forms, for determining a medical emergency, life-support equipment and designation of elderly, blind and disabled customers protected from termination of utility services.

bills.t: Relates to authorizing body scanner utilization in certain facilities under the office of children and family services
bills.sm: Authorizes the use of body imaging scanning equipment in certain facilities for youth and adolescent offenders placed with or committed to the office of children and family services.

bills.t: Relates to cost sharing fees for outpatient treatment at a substance use treatment program
bills.sm: Provides that for a substance use disorder outpatient treatment episode of care by a provider licensed, certified or otherwise authorized by the office of addiction services and supports, an insured shall only be responsible for a cost sharing fee not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars.

bills.t: Authorizes collaborative programs for community paramedicine services
bills.sm: Authorizes collaborative programs for community paramedicine services as part of the hospital-home care-physician collaboration program.

bills.t: Requires issuers of credit cards to give the cardholder at least thirty days notice before closing, cancelling, or terminating the cardholder's account
bills.sm: Requires issuers of credit cards to give the cardholder at least thirty days written notice via email, text message, or written letter before closing, cancelling, or terminating the cardholder's account.

bills.t: Requires events held by the state or on state property which include alcohol to include alcohol produced within the state
bills.sm: Requires events held by the state or on state property which include alcohol to include alcohol produced within the state.

bills.t: Relates to modifications, suspensions, revocations, and renewals of permits under the air quality control program
bills.sm: Enacts provisions relating to modifications, suspensions, revocations, and renewals under the air quality control program; provides for expiration of any permit which has no expiration and has been in effect for five years; provides renewal periods shall not be longer than five years.

bills.t: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program
bills.sm: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program for the purposes of notifying residential customers when energy usage exceeds a cost or usage threshold in a given billing period determined by the residential customer.

bills.t: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Requires certain establishments provide tap water on request.

bills.t: Relates to advanced transmission technologies
bills.sm: Directs electric corporations and combination electric and gas corporations to file a cost-effectiveness and timetable analysis as part of any base rate proceeding with the public service commission; directs NYSERDA to conduct a study on the effectiveness of advanced transmission technologies.

bills.t: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services
bills.sm: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services; directs the commissioner of health to enact regulations imposing certain standards and restrictions.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of restraints on incarcerated individuals during labor, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant persons during a custodial interrogation
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of restraints on and the use of force against incarcerated individuals during labor and incarcerated individuals who have experienced different pregnancy outcomes, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant and post-pregnancy persons during a custodial interrogation; provides for certain exceptions for restraints to be used and in such case limits the use to wrist restraints.

bills.t: Includes households who are fleeing or attempting to flee domestic violence under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program
bills.sm: Includes households who are fleeing or attempting to flee domestic violence under the family homelessness and eviction prevention supplement ("FHEPS") program.

bills.t: Relates to the evidentiary standard for evidentiary and disciplinary hearings
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Elevates the evidentiary standard for evidentiary and disciplinary hearings from substantial evidence to a preponderance of the evidence.

bills.t: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data for incarcerated individuals in medication assisted treatment programs.

bills.t: Relates to voiding certain agreements conditioning the right of a subcontractor's or material supplier's right to commence a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding for breach of contract or quantum meruit
bills.sm: Voids agreements conditioning the right of a subcontractor's or material supplier's right to commence a lawsuit or arbitration proceeding for breach of contract or quantum meruit.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
bills.sm: Authorizes the town of Smithtown assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc. for the 2023-2024 assessment rolls.

bills.t: Relates to expanding opioid overdose prevention measures in certain settings
bills.sm: Requires school districts, public libraries, BOCES, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists; requires the department of health to provide such opioid antagonists to such entities upon request.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn located on state route 941-A in the town of Greece, county of Monroe.

bills.t: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled
bills.sm: Authorizes certified school psychologists to participate in the certification of certain persons as intellectually disabled or developmentally disabled; makes technical corrections to language.

bills.t: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson
bills.sm: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Albertson; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; relates to the management and control as well as the usage of moneys received from foreign fire insurance companies by such association.

bills.t: Enacts "Shavon's law" prohibiting enforcement of a lien where an occupant has a pending social services department storage fee assistance request or appeal
bills.sm: Enacts "Shavon's law" prohibiting enforcement of a lien where an occupant has a pending social services department storage fee assistance request or appeal; provides the necessary steps for ensuring such enforcement is paused.

bills.t: Relates to the distribution of road salt
bills.sm: Requires that the department of transportation and every municipality, locality and public authority shall not spread road salt at a rate higher than three hundred pounds per lane mile on average during each snow and ice management season.

bills.t: Relates to absentee ballots for school district elections due to a religious commitment
bills.sm: Relates to absentee ballots for school district elections due to a religious commitment or following such applicant's religious teaching or tenet that forbids secular activity on that day.

bills.t: Relates to payments by a pharmacy benefit manager to participating pharmacies
bills.sm: Requires a pharmacy benefit manager to pay a participating pharmacy at minimum at the national average drug acquisition cost (NADAC) rate, or at the pharmacy acquisition cost rate if greater or there is not a NADAC rate, plus a professional dispensing fee that is at minimum the professional dispensing fee paid under the state medical assistance program.

bills.t: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
bills.sm: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

bills.t: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
bills.sm: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including an advance payment of 25% of the total award to cover expenses incurred in the first quarter.

bills.t: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be determination of medical necessity for coverage of a breast ultrasound
bills.sm: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be considered a determination of medical necessity for purposes of coverage of breast ultrasounds as recommended by a provider of mammography services.

bills.t: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead
bills.sm: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead.

bills.t: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer
bills.sm: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer.

bills.t: Requires certain leases and management agreements entered into by the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation to comply with master plans
tl: REFERRED TO CULTURAL AFFAIRS, TOURISM, PARKS AND RECREATION
bills.sm: Requires leases, licenses and management agreements entered into by the office of parks, recreation and historic preservation relating to the use or management of state parks and historic sites, having a term of more than 1 year, to comply with the recommendations of the management or master plan of the state park or historic site to which the lease, license or management plan relates.

bills.t: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways
bills.sm: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways.

bills.t: Details the procedure that certain school districts must follow when dealing with disciplinary actions for bus drivers and bus driver's assistants
bills.sm: Details the procedure that certain school districts must follow when dealing with disciplinary actions for bus drivers and bus drivers' assistants.

bills.t: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

bills.t: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
bills.sm: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan for service with the Seneca Falls Police Department.

bills.t: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras
bills.sm: Relates to school bus stop-arm cameras and the adjudication of traffic infractions related thereto.

bills.t: Establishes a highway safety corridor on the Southern State Parkway
bills.sm: Establishes a highway safety corridor on the Southern State Parkway between exit seventeen and exit thirty-one; provides for enhanced traffic enforcement and a reporting requirement.

bills.t: Prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide and establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Enacts "Nima's law" which prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide; establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program to expand education on the dangers of nitrous oxide misuse; prohibits the sale of whip cream chargers.

bills.t: Provides the village of Ossining, Westchester county, with the ability to set restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Provides the village of Ossining, Westchester county, with the ability to set restrictions on the hours of sale of alcoholic beverages at retail for on-premises consumption by local law, ordinance, or resolution.

bills.t: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; appropriation
bills.sm: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; authorizes funding of joint labor-management committees; implements agreements between the state and an employee organization; makes an appropriation therefor (Part A); provides for the salaries of certain state officers and employees excluded from collective negotiating units; makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).

bills.t: Corrects a misclassification property tax error on behalf of Tanya Hairston
bills.sm: Corrects a misclassification property tax error on behalf of Tanya Hairston for the property located at 40 North Tenth Avenue in the city of Mount Vernon for the 2011 - 2020 city assessment tax rolls.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sergeant Gregory L. Wahl
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sergeant Gregory L. Wahl.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements
bills.sm: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for periodic paper statements when such statements are required for an application for public assistance.

bills.t: Relates to asset-based lending transactions
bills.sm: Deems asset-based lending transactions to be loans for all purposes.

bills.t: Permits the establishment of reserve funds for costs relating to special education
bills.sm: Permits the establishment of reserve funds for unanticipated costs relating to special education, provided that the amount in such fund shall not exceed four percent of the district's current school year budget.

bills.t: Establishes the home improvement fraud prevention act
bills.sm: Establishes the home improvement fraud prevention act relating to the responsibilities of home improvement contractors and requiring home improvement contractors to register with the secretary of state.

bills.t: Provides dormitory authority financing for construction of buildings to be used as a school for Yeshiva Ohr Yoseph
bills.sm: Provides dormitory authority financing for construction of buildings to be used as a school for Yeshiva Ohr Yoseph.

bills.t: Relates to enacting the empire state licensing act; repealer
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Enacts the empire state licensing act to provide all New Yorkers with access to professional, occupational, commercial, or business licenses, permits, certificates, or related registrations regardless of an applicant's citizenship or immigration status.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county.

bills.t: Relates to determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial
bills.sm: Provides for the use of restoration services when determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial.

bills.t: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement benefits plan for Elmira traffic officers
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement plan for traffic officers employed by the town of Elmira, who submit an application therefor within one year of the effective date of such provisions, or within one year of start of employment.

bills.t: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

bills.t: Relates to eligibility for paid sick leave
bills.sm: Requires an employer to provide sick leave to an employee who telecommutes at the same rate and under the same conditions that an employee present at the employer's work site would accrue it.

bills.t: Authorizes certain exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters
bills.sm: Authorizes exemptions from school district real property taxes for volunteer firefighters residing in such school district.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Officer Stephen L. Raymond
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system, consisting of the bridge located on Diamond Point road at exit twenty-three of interstate eighty-seven in the town of Lake George, county of Warren, to Officer Stephen L. Raymond.

bills.t: Enacts the New York city Caribbean steel pan educational music program act
tl: REFERRED TO NEW YORK CITY EDUCATION
bills.sm: Enacts the "New York city Caribbean steel pan educational music program act"; requires community school boards in the city of New York to authorize, where reasonable, the use of school grounds in the summer months for use by any steel pan music organization to practice for the Labor Day Parade (West Indian Carnival).

bills.t: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services
bills.sm: Prohibits the retrospective denial of payment for substance use disorder treatment services if an insured was covered for such services at the time treatment was initiated; requires insurers to notify a treatment provider when an insured has lost coverage based on termination of the insured's employment.

bills.t: Establishes the Clarence Center Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Establishes the Clarence Center Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for eligibility of membership, purpose, powers and duties, organization meeting and by-laws, the control and disposal of funds and property and the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Jason T McGlone
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Hancock to Jason T McGlone.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to PFC Travis C. Krege
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting the bridge on Cleveland Drive crossing interstate route 90 in the town of Cheektowaga, county of Erie, to PFC Travis C. Krege.

bills.t: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act" relating to increasing the age of victims of the patronizing, promoting, and compelling of prostitution.

bills.t: Authorizes Frank R. Smith to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits
bills.sm: Authorizes Frank Smith, a New York city police detective, to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits for illness suffered as a result of exposure to disease during undercover assignments as a member of the police department of the city of New York.

bills.t: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
bills.sm: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional five years.

bills.t: Requires all edible cannabis products be packaged in child resistant packaging
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Prohibits all registered organizations, licensees, or permittees or other entities under the jurisdiction of the cannabis board from selling or delivering any edible cannabis products not in child resistant packaging.

bills.t: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections under certain circumstances
bills.sm: Requires mercantile establishments to cease collections upon a court finding of not guilty of larceny in mercantile establishments.

bills.t: Authorizes camp operators and employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children under certain circumstances
bills.sm: Allows camp employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children, under parent or guardian consent and authorization, pursuant to a patient specific order and in compliance with regulations.

bills.t: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent
bills.sm: Increases the value of a motor vehicle exempt from the provisions of a will or intestate distribution for the benefit of the family of a decedent.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Robert Bornt
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Petersburg, county of Rensselaer, to Robert Bornt.

bills.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Babylon to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes
bills.sm: Authorizes the Centerport Fire District to file an application for exemption from school taxes and real property taxes.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county.

bills.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the authority of Plandome Manor to enter into contracts to sell delinquent tax liens
bills.sm: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the authority of the village of Plandome Manor to enter into contracts to sell delinquent tax liens or to pledge such liens as collateral for a loan.

bills.t: Relates to authorizing certain sales of private label wine
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes certain restaurants to sell sealed bottles of private label wine for off-premises consumption with the purchase of a substantial food item.

bills.t: Prohibits leaded aviation gasoline
bills.sm: Prohibits an airport operator or aviation retail establishment from selling, distributing, or otherwise making available leaded aviation gasoline to consumers on or after January first, two thousand thirty-one.

bills.t: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
bills.sm: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

bills.t: Relates to expanding opioid overdose prevention measures in certain settings
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND SUBSTANCE USE DISORDERS
bills.sm: Requires school districts, public libraries, BOCES, county vocational education and extension boards, charter schools, and non-public schools to provide and maintain on-site opioid antagonists; requires the department of health to provide such opioid antagonists to such entities upon request.

bills.t: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways
bills.sm: Adds Lake Oscawana and Roaring Brook Lake in Putnam county to the definition of inland waterways.

bills.t: Provides for review of bail data reports by the state commission on judicial conduct
bills.sm: Provides for review of bail data reports by the state commission on judicial conduct to study such reports for evidence of bias or prejudice by any judge or justice, and where appropriate based on such reports, to initiate, investigate, and hear complaints and otherwise comment on matters of bias and prejudice evidenced therein.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the county of Wyoming, constituting state route 98 from School Street in the town of Sheldon at the southern end to the southern line of the village of Attica, to Specialist Thomas Edwin Beglinger.

bills.t: Sets maximum rates that may be charged for the towing and subsequent storage of a motor vehicle
bills.sm: Sets maximum rates that may be charged for the towing and subsequent storage of passenger and large vehicles outside of New York city.

bills.t: Enacts the New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Enacts the "New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act"; provides transparency requirements for news media content composed, authored, or otherwise created through generative AI.

bills.t: Establishes the "protecting consumers and jobs from discriminatory pricing act"
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.545
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of electronic shelving labels, digital shelf display technology, and surveillance pricing in food retail establishments and drug retail establishments; provides injunctive relief and civil penalties.

bills.t: Establishes procedures to be followed when the body scan of an incarcerated individual, employee or visitor to a correctional facility displays alleged abnormalities
bills.sm: Establishes procedures to be followed when the body scan of an incarcerated individual, employee or visitor to a correctional facility displays alleged abnormalities; requires staff discipline for staff who have wrongfully denied visitation to a visitor or entry to an employee based on a body scan; requires the collection and reporting of certain information relating to visitation and entry denials based on body scans; requires such law to be posted in visitor processing areas of correctional facilities.

bills.t: Relates to instances in where compliance is required in response to an inquiry, investigation, subpoena, or summons related to procedures for protections of legally protected health activities
bills.sm: Provides for instances in which a person or entity in the state of New York shall comply with or provide information in response to an inquiry, investigation, subpoena, or summons related to procedures for protections of legally protected health activities; adds that such disclosure requirements shall not apply to the disclosure of deidentified information in compliance with state grant reporting requirements or other reporting requirements under state law.

bills.t: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act
bills.sm: Enacts the restriction of anticoagulant pesticide transactions for online and retail stores act to prohibit any person from selling, offering for sale or use, or distributing within the state, any second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide; prohibits the use of either a first-generation anticoagulant rodenticide or a second-generation anticoagulant rodenticide within five hundred feet of a wildlife habitat area.

bills.t: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law
bills.sm: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law for prior employment with the New York state university police.

bills.t: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
bills.sm: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

bills.t: Requires state contracts with construction firms reserve a percent of such contract to soft cost spending towards small businesses
bills.sm: Requires state contracts with construction firms reserve a percent of such contract to soft cost spending towards small businesses located near the construction site; defines what qualifies as soft cost spending.

bills.t: Enacts the "donor conceived person protection act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "donor-conceived person protection act" to ensure that reproductive tissue banks, licensed by the department of health, collect and verify medical information from any donor it procures reproductive tissue from and to disseminate such information to a recipient before a recipient purchases or otherwise receives such tissue, and to donor-conceived persons, if any, when such persons turn eighteen years of age or earlier upon consent of the recipient parent or guardian; defines terms.

bills.t: Permits localities to opt to reduce renters' payments towards rent to one-third of household income for eligible participants in the SCRIE and DRIE programs
bills.sm: Relates to establishing a maximum rent of one-third of household income for the senior citizens rent increase exemption and disability rent increase exemption.

bills.t: Relates to child care provider registration
bills.sm: Provides that child care provider licenses be valid for a period of up to six years.

bills.t: Grants retroactive membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Grants retroactive Tier IV membership in the New York city teachers' retirement system to certain employees employed by the city of Yonkers parks department for the period beginning in 2009 and ending in 2014.

bills.t: Authorizes the New York state environmental facilities corporation to award grants and loans to non-public entities for certain water quality projects
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the New York state environmental facilities corporation to award grants and loans to community water systems and non-community water systems for water quality projects that relate to the removal of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

bills.t: Prohibits adverse employment action where an employee renders first aid or emergency treatment
bills.sm: Prohibits adverse employment action where an employee renders first aid or emergency treatment unless it is established that such employee was grossly negligent in providing such first aid or emergency treatment.

bills.t: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and the modernization of certain language
bills.sm: Relates to the use of certain moneys received by the West Babylon Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association and modernization of certain gendered language.

bills.t: Establishes "Kyra's Law"
bills.sm: Requires the court to consider a child's health and safety when making a decision regarding child custody and visitation; directs the court to review certain information as it relates to allegations of child abuse, domestic violence and child safety.

bills.t: Enacts the sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act
bills.sm: Enacts the "sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act"; exempts or limits environmental review under SEQR for the construction of certain new residential units to avoid creating unnecessary housing sprawl; limits certain rights to action under SEQR; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Relates to procedures for protections of legally protected health activities
bills.sm: Specifies that professional liability insurance insurers cannot deny coverage or increase rates solely based on legal use or prescription of certain gender-affirming care-related drugs; prescribes procedures for warrants issued in other jurisdictions for electronic data related to legally protected health activities; provides for additional procedural methods for protection of legally protected health activities.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Clara H. Barton
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the village of Dansville, county of Livingston, to Clara H. Barton.

bills.t: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act" to require companies selling, offering for sale, or distributing packaging materials and products to register with a packaging reduction organization to develop a packaging reduction and recycling plan; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Enacts the New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act
bills.sm: Enacts the "New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act"; provides transparency requirements for news media content composed, authored, or otherwise created through generative AI.

bills.t: Relates to certificate of residence policies for community colleges
bills.sm: Authorizes the state university trustees to promulgate rules or regulations relating to late fees and exceptions for students submitting certificate of residence forms, and a reconciliation process for such forms received after the list of non-resident students was sent to a county.

bills.t: Designates an individual who has been convicted of certain crimes or of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor
tl: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
bills.sm: Designates an individual found to have been convicted of certain crimes where the complainant or victim is an amateur or professional athlete, coach, official or other participant in a sports event, or a jockey, driver, trainer, owner, official or other participant in a horse race, or to have been convicted of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races, or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor; requires the commission to notify the individual; allows for the individual to contest such designation; requires account wagering licensees to prohibit any individual designated as a prohibited sports bettor from establishing or maintaining a wagering account.

bills.t: Extends the twenty-five year presumptive eligibility period for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations
bills.sm: Extends the presumptive eligibility period, from twenty-five to thirty-five years, for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations.

bills.t: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Establishes a temporary task force on the variable supplements fund program to make findings and recommendations.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lakeview Fire District
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lakeview Fire District with respect to the 2025-2026 assessment roll for a portion of the 2025-2026 school taxes and a portion of the 2026 general taxes.

bills.t: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
bills.sm: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

bills.t: Relates to coverage for services provided by school-based health centers for medical assistance recipients
bills.sm: Ensures services provided in school-based health centers are not provided to medical assistance recipients through managed care programs.

bills.t: Establishes interschool robotics competitions for certain schools
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of education to promulgate and review as necessary rules and regulations allowing trustees and boards of education of schools with a robotics program to conduct interschool robotics competitions for grades nine through twelve equivalent to the interschool athletic competitions conducted by such schools.

bills.t: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters
bills.sm: Provides for insurance coverage of comprehensive annual medical examinations for firefighters due to their increased risk for cancer and cancer-related diseases.

bills.t: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
bills.sm: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section…

bills.t: Authorizes the towns of Ellington and Charlotte in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns
bills.sm: Authorizes the towns of Ellington and Charlotte in Chautauqua county to elect a single town justice to preside in the town courts of such towns.

bills.t: Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2026-27 state fiscal year for grants in aid for certain services and expenses
Provides website and mobile application users the right to refuse non-essential cookies
