bills.sm: Provides website and mobile application users the right to refuse non-essential cookies; prevents operators from making additional requests for the use of non-essential cookies.

bills.t: Establishes transparency guidelines for condominiums and cooperative housing units
bills.sm: Requires that when a buyer enters into a contract to purchase a condominium or cooperative housing unit, the property management company or board of managers shall provide the buyer with records of the most recent inspection and engineering reports and permits for the subject property.

bills.t: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

bills.t: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports
bills.sm: Directs the superintendent of banks to promulgate rules and regulations requiring licensed cashers of checks to file suspicious activity reports.

bills.t: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
bills.sm: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

bills.t: Relates to the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer
bills.sm: Authorizes the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer into the general fund of the county.

bills.t: Allows the city of New York to convey certain lands to the Amity Little League, Inc.
bills.sm: Allows the city of New York to convey the Amity Little League Baseball Complex to the Amity Little League, Inc. for a period of forty years; subjects the conveyance to the provisions of the Uniform Land Use Review Procedure.

bills.t: Requires operators of bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles to wear protective head gear
bills.sm: Requires operators of bicycles with electric assist, electric scooters, and motor-driven cycles to wear protective head gear regardless of age.

bills.t: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler
bills.sm: Grants peace officer status to animal control officers of the county of Schuyler; defines "animal control officer".

bills.t: Requires the collection of certain demographic information by state agencies, boards, departments and commissions
bills.sm: Requires the collection of certain demographic information by state agencies, boards, departments and commissions.

bills.t: Relates to requiring the chair of the state liquor authority to make certain quarterly reports
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Requires the chair of the state liquor authority to make quarterly reports to the governor and the legislature of the authority's enforcement activities for the preceding quarter.

bills.t: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease certain sports field fences for advertisements
bills.sm: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease fences at the John E. Markel Memorial Park for advertisements.

bills.t: Enacts the New York emergency responder act
tl: REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS
bills.sm: Enacts the New York emergency responder act limiting the liability of certain emergency responders.

bills.t: Provides for recovery of economic development awards in cases where the recipient relocates outside the state
tl: REFERRED TO COMMERCE, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESS
bills.sm: Provides for the recovery of an economic development award in any case where a recipient relocates outside the state within five years of receiving such award; requires repayment of any such award shall be made pursuant to the timeframe specified in the award agreement.

bills.t: Relates to screening for gifted and talented students
bills.sm: Requires school districts to screen for gifted and talented students; provides the parents or guardians of such students the option to opt out of such screening.

bills.t: Authorizes camp operators and employees to administer medications and treatment to children under certain circumstances
bills.sm: Allows camp employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children, under parent or guardian consent and authorization, pursuant to a patient specific order and in compliance with regulations.

bills.t: Relates to a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for the New York State Capital Assistance Program
Requires certain political communications to include provenance data for all audio, images or videos used in such communications
bills.sm: Requires certain political communications to include provenance data for all audios, images or videos used in such communications; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.t: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Establishes the Harris Hill Volunteer Fire Company Benevolent Association; provides for eligibility of membership, purpose, powers and duties, organization meeting and by-laws, the control and disposal of funds and property and the precept for payment of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for SCRIE, DRIE, SCHE and DHE by any increase in the consumer price index
bills.sm: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE), disability rent increase exemption (DRIE), senior citizen homeowners' exemption (SCHE), and disabled homeowners' exemption (DHE) by any increase in the consumer price index (CPI).

bills.t: Provides for the notification of individuals when their address confidentiality time period is expiring
bills.sm: Provides for the notification of individuals when their address confidentiality time period is expiring no later than six months prior to such expiration; provides that such notification shall include information on how to reapply.

bills.t: Increases transparency in cooperative housing corporations
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Increases transparency in cooperative housing corporations by giving shareholders more rights to information of the co-op and limiting the powers of management companies and boards.

bills.t: Relates to the sales and use tax exemption for certain transactions in precious metal bullion held for investment purposes
bills.sm: Requires that sales tax exempt precious metal bullion shall be purchased by a bank, a foreign government, the U.N. or the state, federal or local government.

bills.t: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

bills.t: Authorizes Frank R. Smith to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Frank Smith, a New York city police detective, to receive accidental performance of duty disability retirement benefits for illness suffered as a result of exposure to disease during undercover assignments as a member of the police department of the city of New York.

bills.t: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members
bills.sm: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc., within the town of Central Square, Oswego county from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members.

bills.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
bills.sm: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

bills.t: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc.
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Cattaraugus assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Olean Community Theatre, Inc. for all of the 2021-2022 school taxes and all of the 2022 general taxes.

bills.t: Provides a legacy credit to the children and siblings of veterans who were killed in the line of duty
bills.sm: Provides a legacy credit to the children and siblings of veterans who were killed in the line of duty including veterans who were disabled as a result of their service, exposed to toxic substances, or presumptive conditions determined by the department of veterans affairs.

bills.t: Relates to determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial
bills.sm: Provides for the use of restoration services when determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial.

bills.t: Relates to state use of disaster emergency response personnel and non-state resource providers
bills.sm: Authorizes the governor to deploy non-state resource providers to the northern emergency management assistance compact and the international emergency management assistance compact.

bills.t: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to commercial financing
bills.sm: Relates to the application of certain provisions relating to commercial financing; provides that liability shall not be imposed on a provider if the actual annual percentage rate charged by the provider differs from the estimated annual percentage rate disclosed by the provider acting in good faith.

bills.t: Requires entities that access a consumer's consumer credit report to notify such consumer of their right to obtain a security freeze
bills.sm: Requires entities that access a consumer's consumer credit report to notify such consumer of their right to obtain a security freeze, in addition to other information necessary to place, temporarily lift or permanently lift such security freeze; prohibits notices to consumers of their right to obtain a security freeze from containing advertising for paid services.

bills.t: Provides technical corrections to provisions concerning the adjudication of certain traffic violations; repealer
bills.sm: Provides technical corrections to provisions concerning the adjudication of certain traffic violations.

bills.t: Enacts the "New York state phoenix act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "New York State Phoenix Act"; extends the statute of limitations for felony family offenses to ten years and misdemeanor family offenses to five years.

bills.t: Relates to multiple violations of the highway construction or maintenance work area photo speed violation monitoring system
bills.sm: Suspends the registration of vehicles which have been documented multiple times by a photo speed violation monitoring system for speeding in a highway construction or maintenance work area.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of Sodus Point, in the town of Sodus, county of Wayne to allow golf carts on certain streets
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Sodus Point, in the town of Sodus, county of Wayne to allow golf carts on certain streets under the exclusive control and jurisdiction of such village.

bills.t: Relates to reporting convictions of certain persons subject to the office of professional medical conduct
bills.sm: Requires the prosecutor to report convictions of certain persons subject to the office of professional medical conduct to the court after conviction and prior to sentencing.

bills.t: Increases the value of homesteads which are to be exempt from civil judgments
bills.sm: Increases the value of homesteads which are exempt from civil judgments from one hundred fifty thousand to two hundred fifty thousand dollars.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting county correction officers from dispensing medications to incarcerated individuals on the premises of a local correctional facility
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits county correction officers from dispensing medications to incarcerated individuals on the premises of a local correctional facility; provides that correction officers or staff may dispense or administer medications during a medical emergency, or dispense nonprescription medication.

bills.t: Establishes a SNAP and cash assistance fraud victims compensation fund
bills.sm: Establishes a SNAP and cash assistance fraud victims compensation fund.

bills.t: Relates to setting integrated behavioral health services
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of mental health, and the office of addiction services and support to jointly establish a single set of licensing standards and requirements for the construction, operation, reporting and surveillance of integrated behavioral health services.

bills.t: Relates to contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
bills.sm: Relates to provisions governing contracting between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including new, renewal, and extension contracts.

bills.t: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
bills.sm: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

bills.t: Prohibits the operation of N.Y. city transit authority subways or trains without a conductor on board
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Prohibits the operation of NYC transit authority subways or trains without at least one conductor on board except where it is currently permissible.

bills.t: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax
bills.sm: Permits the town of Monroe to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Consulate General of El Salvador
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Consulate General of El Salvador.

bills.t: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to change his service credit from the improved career retirement plan to a 20 year retirement plan.

bills.t: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence
bills.sm: Increases the occupancy tax in the county of St. Lawrence from three to five percent.

bills.t: Relates to extending the authorization for hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara
bills.sm: Extends the authorization for hunting big game by rifle in the county of Niagara until 2028.

bills.t: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
bills.sm: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund for any loss, claim, action or judgment for which such school district is authorized or required to purchase or maintain insurance for the kinds of risks for which insurance is authorized.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach to impose a hotel, motel and beach club tax
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Atlantic Beach, county of Nassau to impose a three percent hotel, motel and beach club tax; defines "beach club" as a facility formed, organized or operated by any person, firm or corporation, located on or contiguous to an ocean beach, permitting sunbathing, swimming and other allied recreation activities, including such uses operated by a hotel, cooperative complex or other entity; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Relates to reporting requirements of SUNY and CUNY
bills.sm: Relates to reporting requirements of SUNY and CUNY; relates to financial information and identifying vendor information of each contract; relates to a list of all foundation and state university employees by campus, department and location including salaries, job titles and descriptions.

bills.t: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways
bills.sm: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

bills.t: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in the provision of therapy or psychotherapy services
bills.sm: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in the provision of therapy or psychotherapy services by prohibiting the use of artificial intelligence to assist in providing supplementary support where the session is recorded or transcribed unless the patient is informed of the specific purpose of such use and consents of such use; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions; excludes religious counseling, peer-support, and self-help materials and educational resources from such provisions.

bills.t: Provides for priority status to victims of human trafficking for the receipt of certain assistance
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Provides for priority for applications and expedited determination of claims for a human trafficking victim who wishes to remove permanent marks that were part of the trafficking of such victim, including but not limited to, tattoos, markings, brandings, or other symbols or insignia.

bills.t: Relates to the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies
bills.sm: Provides that the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies shall be done on forms approved by the centers for Medicare and Medicaid services.

bills.t: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders
bills.sm: Enacts the "sunshine in litigation act" regarding protective orders to prohibit settlement agreements which conceal a public hazard or any information that would identify a public hazard.

bills.t: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises
bills.sm: Relates to establishing expanded construction mentorship opportunities for small business enterprises where there is privity of contract between a small business enterprise and a subcontractor or contractor working on an authority public works contract.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting the establishment of new for-profit hospices
bills.sm: Prohibits the establishment of new for-profit hospices or increasing the capacity of existing for-profit hospices.

bills.t: Requires that certain land which was conveyed to the town of Riverhead in 2011 be leased to the YMCA of Long Island for the provision of recreational and community services
bills.sm: Requires that land formerly used as an armory which was conveyed to the town of Riverhead, county of Suffolk by the state in 2011, to be leased to the YMCA of Long Island for the provision of recreational and educational programs.

bills.t: Relates to graduates with a masters in social work
bills.sm: Authorizes a graduate of an accredited master of social work program to engage in supervised social work.

bills.t: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity
bills.sm: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity to six gigawatts by the year 2030, twelve gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2040, and seventeen gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2050.

bills.t: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities
bills.sm: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities; provides penalties for safety violations and operating without a valid license; prohibits reductions in fines in certain circumstances where a patient is endangered or harmed.

bills.t: Prohibits the nonemergency application of pesticide or lawn care pesticide within any municipal park lands and lands under the jurisdiction of the state office of parks, recreation and historic preservation
bills.sm: Prohibits the nonemergency application of pesticide or lawn care pesticide within any municipal park lands and lands under the jurisdiction of the state office of parks, recreation and historic preservation; requires notice of pesticide application.

bills.t: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners
bills.sm: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners; adds nurse practitioners as persons who can authorize or make certain determinations authorized to be made or determined by physicians.

bills.t: Authorizes the assessor of Nassau county to accept an application for retroactive real property tax exempt status from Ray of Hope, Inc.
Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement benefits plan for Elmira traffic officers
bills.sm: Authorizes an optional 20-year retirement plan for traffic officers employed by the town of Elmira, who submit an application therefor within one year of the effective date of such provisions, or within one year of start of employment.

bills.t: Delays the zero-emission school bus mandate
bills.sm: Delays the zero-emission school bus mandate for a period of five years; requires school districts to only purchase or lease zero-emission school buses by 2032 and requires school districts to only operate and maintain zero-emission school buses by 2040.

bills.t: Enacts the voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)
bills.sm: Enacts the "voting integrity and verification act of New York (VIVA NY)"; provides that each voter is entitled to the use of an individual, voter verifiable paper ballot of the voter's vote and the opportunity to mark it.

bills.t: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle
bills.sm: Prohibits rental vehicle companies from imposing any fees, charges or penalties, other than the actual cost of a toll, on an authorized driver for such driver's use of a rental vehicle.

bills.t: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "fairness in cooperative homeownership act"; regulates the submission and determinations of applications for ownership of cooperative apartments.

bills.t: Relates to the duration of mechanic's liens
bills.sm: Provides for the continuation of a mechanic's lien which has been discharged by undertaking for a period of three years from the commencement of a foreclosure action.

bills.t: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; providing for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; appropriation
bills.sm: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; provides for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; makes an appropriation for the purpose of effectuating certain provisions thereof.

bills.t: Relates to the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Waives the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection except where the record reflects artistic, creative or scholarly works of authorship, academic course materials, or scientific or academic research, or if the copyright owner intends to distribute the record of derivative work based on it to the public by sale or other transfer of ownership.

bills.t: Relates to liability insurance for voluntary foster care agencies
bills.sm: Establishes participation in assigned risk plans for voluntary foster care agencies (Part A); requires the office of children and family services to establish standards of payment for liability insurance costs beginning July 1, 2028 for the 2027-2028 rate year that ensures the maximum state aid rate accurately reflect the year over year increased costs for voluntary foster care agencies; directs such office to establish an application process (Part B); establishes the voluntary foster care agency insurance bridge fund; establishes a process for the distribution of moneys in such fund; sets eligibility requirements; requires certain supporting documentation (Part C).

bills.t: Creates the Checkout NY pass
tl: REFERRED TO CULTURAL AFFAIRS, TOURISM, PARKS AND RECREATION
bills.sm: Creates the "Checkout NY" pass, a comprehensive pass that allows for free or discounted use of state parks, historic sites and recreational facilities; provides one such pass to each consolidated, federated and cooperative public library system within the state free of charge for circulation.

bills.t: Relates to enforcement of toll collection regulations and license plate violations
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to enforcement of toll collection regulations and license plate violations; permits registration suspension, seizure and liens.

bills.t: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for mining on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waters; repealer
bills.sm: Relates to permits and financial security for reclamation for mining on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waters; requires such permits to be subject to environmental quality review procedures; requires financial security to cover any damages directly or indirectly resulting from mining activities on state-owned lands occurring below or beneath navigable waterways, including, but not limited to, those resulting from collapse or water contamination.

bills.t: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language
bills.sm: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language; requires parties to demonstrate their understanding of the nature and effect of such documents.

bills.t: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage
bills.sm: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage, Nassau county, New York, Inc.; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; directs that certain taxes received shall be used by such benevolent association in furtherance of its purposes.

bills.t: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law for prior employment with the New York state university police.

bills.t: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
bills.sm: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Schoharie.

bills.t: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered
bills.sm: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered; requires the superintendent of financial services and the commissioner of health to develop a uniform form for consent for payment; provides that any non-conforming form shall be prohibited and unenforceable.

bills.t: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals
bills.sm: Imposes liability for damages caused by a chatbot impersonating certain licensed professionals.

bills.t: Allows access to sealed records and certain confidential records by the New York city civilian complaint review board in furtherance of the board's duties and functions
bills.sm: Allows access to sealed records and certain confidential records by the New York city civilian complaint review board in furtherance of the board's duties and functions.

bills.t: Relates to the definition of the term prospective relative guardian
bills.sm: Provides that no person shall be precluded from being deemed a "prospective relative guardian" based on whether such person's relationship with the child was established before or after such child's placement into foster care.

bills.t: Authorizes individuals receiving hospice services to enroll in managed long term care plans
bills.sm: Permits individuals receiving hospice services to enroll in managed long term care plans; ensures coordinated service delivery.

bills.t: Relates to requiring disclosure of use of generative artificial intelligence in a civil action
bills.sm: Requires certification of filings produced using generative artificial intelligence; requires the brief of an appellant to contain a disclosure of the use of generative artificial intelligence in the drafting of the brief and certification that the content therein was reviewed and verified by a human.

bills.t: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Ellicottville to impose a hotel and motel tax not exceeding five percent of the per diem rental rate for each room.

bills.t: Relates to the cancellation of contracts for health club services
bills.sm: Relates to the cancellation of contracts for health club services; provides that for a contract for service due for renewal on a monthly basis, the health club shall accept cancellation of renewal if such request is made up to the day before such renewal takes effect; relates to the mechanisms through which a health club shall accept notice of cancellation and offer cancellation.

bills.t: Relates to centralized contracts for services
bills.sm: Amends provisions of law from making it mandatory to optional that where the purchase of services by state agencies be conducted in a manner that accords second priority to centralized contracts meeting form, function and utility required by such agency, third priority to agency or multi-agency contracts and fourth priority to other means of contracting.

bills.t: Relates to workplace safety equipment for social services employees
bills.sm: Requires every city or county social services district to provide a wearable or mobile phone-based panic button to each employee whose job responsibilities necessitate direct interaction with clients in a client's home.

bills.t: Relates to payments by a pharmacy benefit manager to participating pharmacies
bills.sm: Requires a pharmacy benefit manager to pay a participating pharmacy at minimum at the national average drug acquisition cost (NADAC) rate, or at the pharmacy acquisition cost rate if greater or there is not a NADAC rate, plus a professional dispensing fee that is at minimum the professional dispensing fee paid under the state medical assistance program.

bills.t: Authorizes Medicaid coverage for the complex care assistant program
bills.sm: Establishes a program for specific individuals to become complex care assistants and provide private duty nursing services to certain Medicaid enrollees.

bills.t: Provides additional tax exemptions for two qualified veterans living in the same household
bills.sm: Provides additional tax exemptions on qualifying residential real property where two or more qualified veterans live in the same household.

bills.t: Commemorating the 40th Anniversary of A New Hope Center and recognizing its outstanding service to the residents of Tioga County and the Southern Tier of New York State
Prohibits insurance carriers and employers from withholding certain benefits from injured workers based on attachment to the labor market
bills.sm: Prohibits insurance carriers and employers from withholding certain benefits from injured workers based on a claim that such workers have voluntarily withdrawn from the labor market by not seeking alternate employment that their injury or illness does not preclude them from performing.

bills.t: Establishes the retire strong tax credit for certain individuals age 65 or older
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Establishes the retire strong tax credit for certain individuals age 65 or older; authorizes a tax credit amounting to half the qualifying real property taxes paid by such individual for the taxable year, up to $6,500.

bills.t: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
bills.sm: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

bills.t: Requires utility corporations and municipalities to notify property owners prior to beginning any scheduled non-emergency construction or other work
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires a utility corporation or municipality to notify property owners at least five business days prior to beginning any non-emergency construction or other work that will result in a planned interruption of a customer's property; requires notice to include, but not be limited to, a description of the work to be performed, the expected duration of such work, the location of such work, and the contact information for the utility performing such work; exempts cases where a natural or man-made disaster or state of emergency occurs.

bills.t: Requires the registration of data brokers and establishing a data deletion mechanism for consumers
bills.a: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires the registration of data brokers; imposes regulations upon data brokers; establishes a data deletion mechanism for consumers; imposes penalties upon data brokers for violations of the law.

bills.t: Congratulating Cella McLaughlin upon the occasion of capturing the 2026 NYSPHSAA High School Indoor Track & Field Championship in the 55-meter hurdles race
Requires the department of education to develop informational materials on type 1 diabetes to be made available to schools for distribution to parents and guardians of students
bills.sm: Requires the department of education, in consultation with the department of health, to develop informational materials on type 1 diabetes; requires such materials to be made available to schools providing elementary education through the department's website; requires schools to distribute such materials to parents and guardians of elementary school students and new students.

bills.t: Commending Class of 2026 Valedictorian Fatimah Braimah and Salutatorian Gendrys Torres of World Academy for Total Community High School, in recognition of their outstanding accomplishments
Relates to registrations of residential mortgages in default
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Increases fee amount authorized to be imposed on mortgagees or their agents.

bills.t: Relates to notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau in a city with a population of one million or more
bills.sm: Relates to notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau in a city with a population of one million or more; provides that in a city with a population of one million persons or more, if such notice is served upon the operator of a vehicle that has no such registration plate or if such registration plate is concealed or obscured, the vehicle identification number may be inserted in such notice in place of the plate designation and plate type.

bills.t: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry
bills.sm: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry such that it is easier to navigate; relates to the updating and availability of the registry.

bills.t: Relates to the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton
bills.sm: Increases the term of office from two years to four years for the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, and providing for the staggering of such terms of office.

bills.t: Relates to interest on unclaimed child and spousal support payments
bills.sm: Relates to interest on unclaimed child and spousal support payments by the owner of abandoned properties.

bills.t: Relates to professional employer organization services
bills.sm: Provides that receipts from other services and other business receipts, taxpayers, and combined groups including members, engaged in providing professional employer organization services shall include with such receipts amounts received with respect to wages, benefits, and other employee expenses disbursed to or for the benefit of a client's worksite employees and the related employment taxes if the amounts received are included in the calculation of the business income base or the combined business income base, respectively.

bills.t: Designates certain parts of the fifty-sixth assembly district a cease and desist zone and establishes an affirmative defense to violations of nonsolicitation orders and cease and desist zones
bills.sm: Designates the fifty-sixth assembly district encompassing community board 3 and community board 8 a cease and desist zone; establishes an affirmative defense to violations of nonsolicitation orders and cease and desist zones.

bills.t: Relates to demonstration programs imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits in the town of Yorktown
bills.sm: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, Westchester county, shall have the ability to install and operate photo speed violation monitoring systems within construction or maintenance work areas that fall within the border or jurisdiction of such municipality; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Permits requests for self-exclusion from gambling to be made electronically
bills.sm: Requires that procedures for placements on, and removals from, the list of persons self-excluded from gambling includes procedures that allow a person to submit requests electronically; requires such procedures to ensure parity between electronic and non-electronic requests with respect to record retention and transmission of requests to licensed gaming facilities and mobile sports wagering platforms.

bills.t: Prevents discrimination by insurers based on an individual's mental health or substance use disorder
bills.sm: Prevents discrimination by insurers based on an individual's mental health or substance use disorder; incorporates into law federal enforcement rules set forth in the federal mental health parity and addiction equity act of 2008.

bills.t: Honoring Joseph Grasso upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of the New York State Citizenship Award
Requires certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform, and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours
bills.sm: Requires an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users to ensure that its covered platform provides a process to allow law enforcement agencies to contact such covered platform, which shall provide continuous availability of such process; provides that an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users shall comply with a search warrant within seventy-two hours of receipt under certain circumstances; provides that a court may extend the time for compliance with a search warrant under certain circumstances.

bills.t: Relates to caregiver requirements for certain day care homes
bills.sm: Requires one caregiver for every two children under eighteen months of age in group family day care homes and family day care homes.

bills.t: Allows commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street
bills.sm: Directs the New York city taxi and limousine commission to establish a pilot program to evaluate the impact of commuter vans accepting street hails; authorizes commuter vans to accept hails from prospective passengers in the street in certain locations until June thirtieth, two thousand thirty; directs the New York city taxi and limousine commission to submit a report evaluating such pilot program to the mayor, the speaker of the council, the governor, the temporary president of the senate, and the speaker of the assembly, no later than February first, two thousand twenty-eight and annually thereafter until the completion of such pilot program.

bills.t: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes Simcray Holdings, LLC. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

bills.t: Commemorating the 37th Anniversary of the International Boxing Hall of Fame in Canastota, New York
Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for fire marshals I or supervisors of such title in Suffolk county
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for fire marshals I and supervisors of such title in Suffolk county.

bills.t: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status as evidence of identity for the issuance of an identification card
bills.sm: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status issued by OTDA as evidence of identity for the issuance of a non-driver identification card.

bills.t: Relates to a nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting list
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of health to establish nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting lists per designated waiver region, once the federally approved capacity for the waiver is reached.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Requires policies for the use of automatic license plate reader systems
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires the consumer protection division to promulgate a policy governing the use of automatic license plate reader systems by non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities; requires such non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities to conspicuously post such policy on their website or in their place of business.

bills.t: Requires the public service commission to consider the economic impact of utility rates and charges
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires consideration of evidence relating to the economic impact of major increases of rates or charges upon consumers and the areas affected by such increases of rates or charges prior to approval of any such rates or charges; establishes minimum data to be considered by the public service commission relating to such economic impact.

bills.t: Relates to certain alterations to multiple dwellings; repealer
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Relates to certain alterations based upon which room is being altered in a multiple dwelling.

bills.t: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the village of Freeport assessor
bills.sm: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2026 assessment roll.

bills.t: Relates to addressing non-covered dental services
bills.sm: Addresses non-covered dental services by requiring all policies providing coverage of and all contracts for dental services issued to include a disclosure stating that a participating provider may charge their normal fee for services that are not covered; requires a cost estimate to be provided.

bills.t: Relates to reports and awards by the office of victim services
bills.sm: Requires the office of victim services to publicize programs offered by the office and to include certain information in annual reports to the governor and the legislature and to make such reports public on the office's website.

bills.t: Congratulating Randal B. Caldwell upon the occasion of his retirement after many years of distinguished service to the people of the State of New York
Relates to access of certain information by the New York city department of investigation
bills.sm: Lifts required approvals on the access of information pertaining to children by the New York city department of investigation.

bills.t: Relates to civil penalties imposed by the public service commission upon certain utility corporations
bills.sm: Requires that any sanction or civil penalty imposed by the public service commission be returned to the rate payers by means of a direct bill credit, as soon as practically feasible or no later than ninety days.

bills.t: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto
bills.sm: Establishes a fiscal cliff task force to conduct a study on fiscal cliffs in the state's public assistance programs and to make recommendations related thereto.

bills.t: Congratulating Stephanie Tiemer upon the occasion of earning the distinguished Gold Award, the most prestigious of Scouting honors
Relates to the retirement of state, county and municipal 911 operators and dispatchers
bills.sm: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain public safety dispatchers, public safety telecommunicators, 911 operators, communications officers, police communication technicians, emergency services operators and emergency services dispatchers employed by the state, or a county or municipal emergency services department.

bills.t: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repealer
bills.sm: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repeals certain cost sharing requirements for such services.

bills.t: Relates to collection of social security account numbers for registration with the New York state donate life registry
bills.sm: Authorizes insurers to collect social security account numbers solely for the purpose of effectuating, verifying, or amending an individual's donor registration status in the New York state donate life registry; prohibits use of such information other than for such purposes.

bills.t: Authorizes the adoption of a rule permitting the use of the Korean war veterans parkway in Richmond county by certain commercial vehicles
bills.sm: Authorizes the New York city department of transportation to adopt a rule permitting the use of the Korean war veterans parkway in Richmond county by single unit commercial vehicles having no more than two axles and six tires.

bills.t: Relates to e-scooter mobile app disclosures
bills.sm: Prohibits electric scooter service platforms operating a digital network from operating electric scooters in this state unless such platform displays a warning that persons under 18 years of age are not allowed to operate electric scooters through the platform; imposes a penalty for violations.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions relating to installment loans and obligations evidencing installment loans
bills.sm: Extends certain provisions relating to installment loans and obligations evidencing installment loans to 2029.

bills.t: Relates to optional disability coverage for county probation officers
bills.sm: Provides optional disability coverage for county probation officers.

bills.t: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
bills.sm: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

bills.t: Relates to electronic appearances for parking violations
bills.sm: Provides that persons charged with a parking violation shall be able to make an electronic court appearance unless a locality elects not to permit electronic appearances.

bills.t: Relates to the ability of the New York state medical care facilities finance agency to issue certain bonds and notes
bills.sm: Increases the authorization of the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York ("DASNY"), as successor to the New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency ("MCFFA") pursuant to the Health Care Financing Consolidation Act of 1995, to issue hospital and nursing home project bonds and notes from $20 billion to $21.8 billion.

bills.t: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

bills.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island.

bills.t: Relates to training for school security guards
bills.sm: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

bills.t: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain employees of the New York Power Authority
bills.sm: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for employees of the New York Power Authority with the job title of mechanic, technician, electrician, equipment operator, power plant operator, utility security officer, or lineperson.

bills.t: Commending Class of 2026 Valedictorian Brayan Alonzo and Salutatorian Tremyah Hill of Metropolitan Diploma Plus High School, in recognition of their outstanding accomplishments
Establishes the block by block homeownership program
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Establishes the block by block homeownership program to provide capital subsidies for the purpose of constructing, preserving, and rehabilitating one- to two- family dwellings throughout the state, outside of NYC.

bills.t: Enacts the "freedom to read act"
bills.sm: Requires each board of education to adopt a written policy for reconsideration of school library materials and make such policy available on its website; requires such policies to include provisions for the creation of a reconsideration committee to review complaints regarding school library materials; requires the commissioner of education to develop one or more model policies for school districts.

bills.t: Establishes the "Maternal Health, Dignity and Consent act"
bills.sm: Prohibits drug, cannabis or alcohol testing of pregnant or postpartum individuals and newborns unless the individual consents and it is within the scope of medical care, or the testing is necessary for a medical emergency.

bills.t: Grants certain county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service beyond twenty-five years
bills.sm: Grants Nassau county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service rendered beyond twenty-five years.

bills.t: Congratulating Deputy Chief Joseph Twitty upon the occasion of his retirement from the Niskayuna Police Department
Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state bridge system to Detective Stephen J. Mullen
bills.sm: Dedicates bridge number 1019119 on state route one hundred ten in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Detective Stephen J. Mullen.

bills.t: Creates a women veterans history trail
bills.sm: Creates a women veterans history trail in order to recognize and celebrate the history of women in service.

bills.t: Relates to certain guilty pleas
bills.sm: Relates to certain guilty pleas where the plea is in the interest of justice and which are entered into with both the permission of the court and the consent of the people.

bills.t: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County
bills.sm: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County.

bills.t: Enacts the ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act
bills.sm: Enacts the "ceasing repeated and extremely egregious predatory (CREEP) behavior act"; provides for the issuance of anti-stalking orders.

bills.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
bills.sm: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

bills.t: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings
bills.sm: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings; authorizes utility companies or municipalities to commence an action against the owner of the premises affected to seek the appointment of a receiver of rents or payments for use and occupancy or common charges.

bills.t: Relates to establishing a hazardous substance exposure registry
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of veterans' services to establish a registry of self-identifying service members, veterans and family members of such individuals who may have experienced exposure to a hazardous substance at a military installation and to establish and maintain a public information program in order to educate and inform service members, veterans, and their families.

bills.t: Establishes a medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants test strip program
tl: REFERRED TO ALCOHOLISM AND DRUG ABUSE
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to establish a program for individuals to receive free drug test strips to detect the presence of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants; directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services, in cooperation with the commissioner of the department of health, to develop and conduct a public awareness and educational campaign on the dangers of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants.

bills.t: Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of the Harmony Corners Fire Department to be celebrated on August 8, 2026
Establishes a lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer or questioning plus crisis hotline
bills.sm: Establishes a twenty-four hour, toll-free hotline and website for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer or questioning plus (LGBTQ+) individuals who are experiencing emotional distress, suicidal ideation, or crisis-related challenges, which shall provide immediate support, referrals, resource lists, and other information.

bills.t: Commemorating the 6th Anniversary of the Central New York Tunnel to Towers 5K Run & Walk
Commending Dan Washington, Jr., Memorial Basketball Tournament upon the occasion of its annual competition on June 4, 2026
Enacts the responsible data center development act
bills.sm: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

bills.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain individuals employed by the Nassau county police department
bills.sm: Provides a performance of duty presumption for diseases of the heart for members who serve as an ambulance medical technician, ambulance medical coordinator, ambulance medical technician/supervisor or a member who performs ambulance medical technician related services, or a police medic, police medic coordinator, police medic supervisor, bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, assistant bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, or a member who performs police medic or police emergency ambulance related services and is employed in the Nassau county police department.

bills.t: Requires insurers to deposit certain funds into the reproductive health care access fund; and establishes the reproductive health care access fund
bills.sm: Requires insurance companies to deposit a certain percentage of premiums collected but not paid out in prior years for abortion care to the reproductive health care access fund for use for grants under the reproductive freedom and equity grant program; establishes the reproductive health care access fund; relates to the use of funds under the reproductive freedom and equity grant program; directs the governor to provide for funding in the state budget.

bills.t: Honoring William "Bill" Fries upon the occasion of his designation for special recognition after 40 years of distinguished service as Chief of the Hammondsport Fire Department
Establishes scholarship programs within the New York 529 program
bills.sm: Authorizes the comptroller, in consultation with the NYS higher education services corporation, to develop and administer a scholarship and savings program to provide a pathway for eligible children to save for education expenses.

bills.t: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
bills.sm: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

bills.t: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits paid to widows and orphaned children of members
bills.sm: Increases certain special accidental death benefits paid to a widow or widower or the children of a deceased member of the state and local retirement system.

bills.t: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines
bills.sm: Authorizes the renewal of the WSKG lease for such land, tower and associated utility lines to the Tioga county emergency services, the Newark Valley central school district, the Berkshire fire department and the town of Berkshire highway department for a period of ten years.

bills.t: Relates to a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate
bills.sm: Establishes a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the competency restoration process as it relates to defendants who are being evaluated and receiving restoration under article seven hundred thirty of the criminal procedure law to permit legal proceedings to resume without undue delay.

bills.t: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
bills.sm: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

bills.t: Mourning the death of Carl L. Marcellino, former New York State Senator and distinguished citizen of his community
Automated identification of eligible participants for the Medicare savings program
bills.sm: Identifies and enrolls SNAP program participants who are eligible for the Medicare savings program.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program
bills.sm: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program for an additional 3 years.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Edward "Red" Corrigan
bills.sm: Dedicates a bridge on state route 112 over state route 27 to Edward "Red" Corrigan in the town of Patchogue, county of Suffolk.

bills.t: Honoring Jude Miranda upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of the New York State Citizenship Award
Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor therapy
bills.sm: Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor therapy for new mothers.

bills.t: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county.

bills.t: Relates to the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton
bills.sm: Increases the term of office from two years to four years for the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, and providing for the staggering of such terms of office.

bills.t: Honoring Firefighter Arthur Sullivan upon the occasion of his designation for special recognition after 50 years of dedicated service to the Horseheads Fire Department
Authorizes the village of New Berlin to alienate certain parklands
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain lands.

bills.t: Relates to energy efficiency improvements and certain alterations to multiple dwellings
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Provides for energy efficiency improvements to certain windows; relates to certain alterations concerning windows and HVAC equipment in multiple dwellings.

bills.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft
tl: REFERRED TO CULTURAL AFFAIRS, TOURISM, PARKS AND RECREATION
bills.sm: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft.

bills.t: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel
bills.sm: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel for a 3 year period after successfully completing the emergency vehicle operator's course as part of their training.

bills.t: Amending a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-26 state fiscal year for community adult and youth mental health programs and services
Requires an annual brownfields redevelopment tax credit report
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Requires an annual brownfields redevelopment tax credit report.

bills.t: Enacts "India's law"
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Enacts "India's law" under which an incarcerated individual's next of kin shall be notified and allowed visitation by a local correctional facility when such individual is experiencing a serious medical event or demonstrating behavior that is likely to result in serious harm to themselves or others.

bills.t: Allows certain physically disabled individuals to complete the live-fire range training course for a concealed carry license while sitting
bills.sm: Allows physically disabled individuals who are not able to stand up to complete the two-hour live-fire range training course requirement for a concealed carry license while sitting.

bills.t: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
bills.sm: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

bills.t: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded
bills.sm: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded; mandates that the contractor use such enterprise identified on the utilization plan, unless such enterprise cannot perform or is no longer state certified.

bills.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree
bills.sm: Permits the town of Palm Tree to establish a demonstration program and install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices; relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree.

bills.t: Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for services and expenses of economic development and community services organizations
Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
bills.sm: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim October 2026, as Bullying Prevention Month in the State of New York
Extends provisions relating to physical therapist assistants
bills.sm: Extends provisions relating to physical therapist assistant services in a home care services setting until 2030.

bills.t: Relates to qualifications to hold the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector in the village of Briarcliff Manor
bills.sm: Authorizes the village of Briarcliff Manor to provide that the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector may be held by residents of Westchester county, or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

bills.t: Relates to requiring Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device to treat certain forms of cancer
bills.sm: Requires Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device that uses low-intensity, alternating electric fields delivered to the tumor site to treat glioblastoma and other cancers as recommended by medical and scientific evidence.

bills.t: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons and increases such exemption
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Includes retirement plans in the exemption for pensions and annuities for certain persons; increases such exemption to one hundred thousand dollars as adjusted by the consumer price index annually.

bills.t: Relates to requiring agencies to report information about FOIL inquiries to the committee on open government
bills.sm: Requires all agencies to submit to the committee on open government a log of all freedom of information law requests for each year in which they received or have pending a request for records; requires the committee on open government to publish, on one webpage, all freedom of information law request logs it receives.

bills.t: Relates to requiring utility companies maintain a toll free number for reporting service outages
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires utility companies maintain a toll free number for consumers to call to report service outages which shall be made available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

bills.t: Relates to access of certain information by the New York city department of investigation
bills.sm: Lifts required approvals on the access of information pertaining to children by the New York city department of investigation.

bills.t: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs
bills.sm: Relates to the availability of technical assistance grants in brownfield site remedial programs; provides that the commissioner of environmental conservation shall provide grants to the New York city community board with jurisdiction over the site or to any not-for-profit corporation exempt from taxation under section 501(c)(3) of the internal revenue code at any site which may be affected by a brownfield site remedial program.

bills.t: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act of 2026"
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act"; prevents junk dealers and scrap processors from selling metals that are used by critical infrastructure providers; defines terms.

bills.t: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to five hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period
bills.sm: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to five hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period.

bills.t: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health
bills.sm: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health.

bills.t: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Gives state income tax credit to volunteer firefighters and members of a volunteer ambulance corps in good standing up to $2500; must be in good standing for a minimum of five years and maintain continued eligibility.

bills.t: Relates to solid waste removal invoices and directs certain penalties and fines related to such invoices to be deposited into the environmental protection fund
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.478
bills.sm: Requires any waste hauler providing waste removal services to provide to customers certain estimated costs and invoices; includes penalties for initial and subsequent violations; requires moneys collected from penalties and fines to be deposited into the environmental protection fund.

bills.t: Protects the independence of libraries and shields librarians from civil and criminal liability for certain actions
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.486
tl: REFERRED TO LIBRARIES AND EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY
bills.sm: Protects the independence of libraries; shields librarians from civil and criminal liability for certain actions.

bills.t: Relates to preventing certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority; repealer
bills.sm: Prevents certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority.

bills.t: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
bills.sm: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

bills.t: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering
tl: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
bills.sm: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering and creating accounts on mobile sports wagering platforms; requires platforms to employ commercially reasonable and technically feasible age assurance methods.

bills.t: Congratulating Jeffrey Lin upon the occasion of receiving the distinguished rank of Eagle Scout, the most prestigious of Scouting honors, on June 13, 2026
Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
bills.sm: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

bills.t: Amends a plan establishing itemized list of grantees for 2025-2026 providing community public health programs and services
Requires an annual report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult
bills.sm: Requires a report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult, including the number of individuals who are primary caregivers for an older adult, the average age of a primary caregiver, the cost to an individual to provide care to an older adult, and the economic value and savings to the state of such individual's services.

bills.t: Requires landlords in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in certain dwellings
tl: REFERRED TO HOUSING, CONSTRUCTION AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Requires landlords of non-owner occupied, one-six family dwellings in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in all rented apartments; authorizes the promulgation of standards related thereto.

bills.t: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from seven to nine members
bills.sm: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from a maximum of seven members to nine members.

bills.t: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance
bills.sm: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance including both scripted and unscripted.

bills.t: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund
bills.sm: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund; provides that the salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund whose employment with the police department of the city of New York commenced on or after July 1, 2000 shall be determined in the same manner as members whose employment commenced prior to such date.

bills.t: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions
bills.sm: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each hospital a list of its hospital rule-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

bills.t: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district
bills.sm: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district; permits awards for a period of ten years for the loss of tax revenue.

bills.t: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination
bills.sm: Requires that tax amounts extended on the final assessment roll, and any interest or penalties subsequently accruing thereon, be rounded to the nearest five-cent denomination prior to inclusion on any bill or notice.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers.

bills.t: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children
bills.sm: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children; requires kindergarten in certain school districts.

bills.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
bills.sm: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Civil War veteran John B. Nicholas
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on state route five hundred thirty-one, crossing over route two hundred fifty-nine, otherwise known as, South Union Street, in the town of Ogden, county of Monroe, to Civil War Veteran John B. Nichols.

bills.t: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on certain content made available by the provider
bills.sm: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that such provider makes available.

bills.t: Prohibits the impersonation of an employee organization or an employee representative
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Prohibits falsely impersonating an employee organization or an employee representative with the intent to deceive the recipient and thereby cause harm to such recipient or employee organization by the use of fraud, misrepresentation, material omission, or other deception in making and disseminating a verbal, written or electronic communication; provides that the attorney general may bring an action or proceeding to enjoin such unlawful acts or practices.

bills.t: Commemorating the Miriam Carey 4th Annual Butterfly Brunch on September 20, 2026
Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of Rome Strip Steel Company
Commemorating the 10th Anniversary of CrossFit Strong Island and recognizing its outstanding contributions to the health, wellness, and vitality of the Merrick community
Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance
bills.sm: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance including both scripted and unscripted.

bills.t: Relates to energy efficiency and weatherization
