bills.sm: Relates to the exemption of certain parcels of land from the licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises.

bills.t: Repeals section 2 of chapter 316 of the laws of 2025 relating to the use of tax funds collected by the county of Orange
bills.sm: Repeals certain provisions of law relating to the use of tax funds collected by the county of Orange, which permits Orange county to distribute all of its sales and compensating use taxes to the municipalities thereof.

bills.t: Requires the registration of data brokers and establishing a data deletion mechanism for consumers
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires the registration of data brokers; imposes regulations upon data brokers; establishes a data deletion mechanism for consumers; imposes penalties upon data brokers for violations of the law.

bills.t: Requires schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder
bills.sm: Requires public schools to follow seizure action plans developed by health care providers of students diagnosed with a seizure disorder; requires schools to provide seizure awareness training to certain employees on the recognition of signs and symptoms of a seizure and the appropriate steps to be taken to respond to such symptoms.

bills.t: Relates to establishing a peer support program for veterans
bills.sm: Establishes a peer support program for veterans.

bills.t: Allows a person a second hearing to seal their child protective services records
bills.sm: Allows a person a second hearing to seal their child protective services records upon a showing of good cause and there is no evidence the subject has committed maltreatment of a child in the preceding two years.

bills.t: Increases the period of supervision required for certain real estate license applications
bills.sm: Increases the period of supervision to four years for real estate brokers applying for a license.

bills.t: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain data to the department of financial services and authorizes premium discounts to policyholders who demonstrate certain mitigation actions
bills.sm: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain zip code-level data to the department of financial services on nonrenewal rates, nonpayment cancellation rates, other cancellation rates, claim frequency rates, average claim amounts, paid loss ratios, and average premiums; requires property/casualty insurance companies that use a natural disaster risk model or scoring method to assign risk, information about such model or scoring method; authorizes a premium discount to policyholders of homeowners insurance or property/casualty insurance applicable to residential real property who demonstrate certain mitigation actions; requires insurers to post about such discounts on their…

bills.t: Relates to license requirements for professional geologists; repealer
bills.sm: Provides that the education requirements to be licensed as a professional geologist may be partially substituted by practical experience; relates to the issuance of an identification card as a geologist in training.

bills.t: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause
bills.sm: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause.

bills.t: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY
bills.sm: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY until July 1, 2028.

bills.t: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "Nassau future protectors act" to provide additional credits to the Nassau county law enforcement explorers in competitive civil service examinations.

bills.t: Commemorating the 10th Anniversary of Mercy Flight Central's Service to Oneida County
Requires the forfeiture of benefits to be paid pursuant to a service awards program to volunteer firefighters who have been convicted of certain crimes
bills.sm: Requires the forfeiture of benefits to be paid pursuant to a service awards program to volunteer firefighters who have been convicted of felonies committed against a volunteer fire department, volunteer fire company, fire district, or fire protection district.

bills.t: Commemorating the 70th Anniversary of King Pin Lanes of Rome, New York
Directs the commissioner of education to require public schools to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements
bills.sm: Directs the state education commissioner to require public school districts to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements.

bills.t: Allows a person a second hearing to seal their child protective services records
bills.sm: Allows a person a second hearing to seal their child protective services records upon a showing of good cause and there is no evidence the subject has committed maltreatment of a child in the preceding two years.

bills.t: Reduces electric corporations' response time for securing downed wires
bills.sm: Requires each utility to take appropriate safety precautions regarding electrical hazards, including developing plans to promptly de-energize downed wires within two hours of notification of the location of such downed wires from a municipal emergency responder and promptly secure such wires within six hours in the case of events that are not considered emergencies.

bills.t: Relates to labeling requirements for gas stoves
bills.sm: Requires the display of certain labels and warnings on gas stoves sold, displayed for sale, or offered for sale at retail to a consumer in this state; authorizes the department of state to adopt regulations regarding the placement and format of such labels; provides for penalties; authorizes the attorney general to enforce such provisions.

bills.t: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding
bills.sm: Relates to the practice of natural hair care and braiding; creates an apprenticeship in such area; makes conforming technical changes.

bills.t: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

bills.t: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires the results of any outage management system stress test conducted in the state by a utility company to be posted online and such results to be sent to the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly and the chairs of the senate and assembly standing committees on energy.

bills.t: Relates to pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.311
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires the clear and conspicuous disclosure of pricing changes for online grocery delivery and online pick-up services; imposes a fine of not more than one hundred dollars for the first offense and not more than two hundred fifty dollars for a second and each subsequent offense for violations.

bills.t: Provides for the enrollment of certain persons in direct deposit for compensation payments
bills.sm: Provides for the enrollment of a surviving spouse, a surviving domestic partner, a dependent child or children, or any other person entitled to a death benefit in direct deposit for compensation payments.

bills.t: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals
bills.sm: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals, including two hours of course work or training encompassing minority healthcare issues; provides an exemption for certain individuals; requires hospitals and facilities to request documentation of the completion of training from employees and prospective employees.

bills.t: Requires NYSERDA to develop a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan
bills.sm: Establishes a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan; requires the New York state energy and research development authority to further establish a "Fast Charge NY working group" to develop such plan; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Authorizes Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2026 assessment roll and all of the 2025-2026 school taxes.

bills.t: Relates to the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems
bills.sm: Regulates the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination; requires independent audits of high risk AI systems; provides for enforcement by the attorney general.

bills.t: Commemorating the life and extraordinary service of Assistant Sergeant Major Paulene Lewis Hopkins, distinguished veteran of the 6888th Central Postal Directory Battalion, educator, and civic leader
Includes image-guided biopsies under certain insurance coverage for breast cancer screening
bills.sm: Includes image-guided biopsies under mandatory insurance coverage for breast cancer screening.

bills.t: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York
bills.sm: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York to 2028.

bills.t: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities
bills.a: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
tl: REFERRED TO CULTURAL AFFAIRS, TOURISM, PARKS AND RECREATION
bills.sm: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities, or that provide educational services to students from such communities.

bills.t: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
bills.sm: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

bills.t: Relates to enacting the rent emergency stabilization for tenants act on local determinations of a housing emergency
bills.sm: Relates to enacting the rent emergency stabilization for tenants act on local determinations of a housing emergency; authorizes a city with a population of one million or more to declare an emergency as to any class of housing accommodations if the vacancy rate for the housing accommodations in such class within such municipality is not in excess of five percent and a declaration of emergency may be made as to all housing accommodations if the vacancy rate for the housing accommodations within such municipality is not in excess of five percent; authorizes other cities, towns and villages to declare a housing emergency after considering publicly available data and holding public hearings.

bills.t: Requires chain restaurants to label menu items that have a high content of added sugars
bills.sm: Requires chain restaurants to display an added sugars warning next to or directly under the name of each food item with high added sugars content wherever such food item is listed on a menu, menu board, or food tag, and by any self-serve dispensing point at which such food item is dispensed.

bills.t: Relates to the regulation of energy consumption by data centers
bills.sm: Regulates energy consumption by data centers; requires annual disclosure reporting; prohibits incentives in fossil fuel power purchase agreements with utilities.

bills.t: Provides for the sale of salvaged airbags; repealer
bills.sm: Provides for the sale of recycled inflatable restraint systems; allows for the sale of non-deployed recycled inflatable restraint systems in New York, provided that such inflatable restraint systems meet required safety standards.

bills.t: Provides for electronic notice for collateral loan brokers
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Provides for notice of intention to sell and notice of surplus to be made by e-mail or text message.

bills.t: Commemorating the hosting of the 2026 Special Olympics New York State Summer Games in the City of Utica and Oneida County
Congratulating James J. Weir upon the occasion of his honorary induction into the 2026 SUNY Oneonta Athletics Hall of Fame
Enacts the "deed protection act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "deed protection act" in relation to prohibiting a mortgage banker or mortgage loan servicer from commencing, maintaining, or proceeding with a foreclosure action on a mortgage loan where such mortgage banker or mortgage loan servicer knows or has reason to know that the mortgage securing such loan is dependent on a deed, conveyance, or other instrument affecting title to residential real property that was procured by fraud, forgery, or other unlawful means.

bills.t: Relates to proposed rate changes for gas and electric service
bills.sm: Requires respective changes to service and delivery charges for gas or electric service to be included in the information regarding average proposed rate changes required to be published by the public service commission in certain instances.

bills.t: Relates to notice requirement of adult care facility closures
bills.sm: Relates to notice requirement of adult care facility closures.

bills.t: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers as peace officers in the county of Seneca
bills.sm: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers appointed by the sheriff of Seneca county as peace officers in the county of Seneca.

bills.t: Relates to enacting the NY data protection act
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Enacts the New York privacy act to require companies to disclose their methods of de-identifying personal information, to place special safeguards around data sharing and to allow consumers to obtain the names of all entities with whom their information is shared.

bills.t: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system
bills.sm: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system; permits one in-person visit within twelve months unless such in-person visit causes undue hardship on a patient.

bills.t: Relates to copayment and coinsurance charged for physical and occupational therapy services
bills.sm: Provides that any copayment or coinsurance amount charged by an insurer to the insured for services rendered by a physical therapist or an occupational therapist shall not be more than twenty-five percent greater than the copayment or coinsurance amount imposed for an office visit to a licensed primary care physician or osteopath for the same or a similar diagnosed condition.

bills.t: Authorizes holders of certain operating certificates to employ or contract with applied behavior analysts and mental health counselors
bills.sm: Authorizes holders of certain operating certificates for treatment of persons with developmental disabilities to employ or contract with applied behavior analysts and mental health counselors.

bills.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions relating to alcoholic beverages
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.274
bills.sm: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on the premises.

bills.t: Directs the department of social services to establish an outdoor, nature-based child care pilot project
bills.sm: Directs the department of social services to establish an outdoor, nature-based child care pilot project to explore establishing licensing guidelines for the operation of outdoor, nature-based child care programs in an outdoor space and that employ a nature-based early learning curriculum to teach enrolled children.

bills.t: Relates to restricting the use of electronic monitoring and automated employment decision tools
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.260
bills.sm: Restricts the use by an employer or an employment agency of electronic monitoring or an automated employment decision tool to screen a candidate or employee for an employment decision unless such tool has been the subject of an impact assessment within the last year; requires notice to employment candidates of the use of such tools; provides remedies for violations.

bills.t: Requires screening incarcerated individuals for eligibility for public benefits prior to release
bills.sm: Requires screening incarcerated individuals for eligibility for public benefits prior to release and assistance in applying for such programs; requires officials to seek waivers from the USDA for eligibility for such program.

bills.t: Requires a lethality assessment in incidents of domestic violence
bills.sm: Requires law enforcement officers to conduct a lethality assessment as part of the standardized domestic incident report form when responding to incidents of domestic violence.

bills.t: Relates to veterans health care
bills.a: REFERRED TO VETERANS, HOMELAND SECURITY AND MILITARY AFFAIRS
bills.sm: Relates to veterans' health care; creates a veteran health care review to ensure veterans and their families have access to health and mental health treatment, including for post-traumatic stress disorder, depression, anxiety, military sexual trauma, reproductive and mental health conditions, and suicide prevention.

bills.t: Relates to food safety and quality date labeling requirements
bills.sm: Requires certain labeling to be used to indicate the safety dates and quality dates of food products; requires the department of agriculture and markets to educate consumers about such provisions.

bills.t: Requires mandatory background checks for persons employed by certain businesses serving minors and prohibiting certain persons from owning such businesses
bills.sm: Requires mandatory background checks for persons employed by or volunteering at any business corporation, not-for-profit corporation, limited liability company, or limited partnership that regularly provides instructional, recreational or extracurricular services to minors, including but not limited to dance studios, gymnastic schools, martial arts academies, sports training facilities, music schools and performing arts schools, tutoring and academic enrichment centers; provides for enforcement and penalties; prohibits certain people from owning such businesses.

bills.t: Repeals section 2307 of the public health law relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease
bills.sm: Repeals provisions relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease.

bills.t: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system
bills.sm: Permits telemedicine services for mental and behavioral health issues under the workers' compensation system; permits one in-person visit within twelve months unless such in-person visit causes undue hardship on a patient.

bills.t: Commemorating the 31st Annual Mohawk Valley Ride for Missing Children on June 5, 2026
Provides for the licensure of dietitians and nutritionists; repealer
bills.sm: Provides for the licensure of dietitians and nutritionists; defines the practice thereof.

bills.t: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering
bills.sm: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering and creating accounts on mobile sports wagering platforms; requires platforms to employ commercially reasonable and technically feasible age assurance methods.

bills.t: Relates to insurance coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment
bills.sm: Requires policies which provide dental coverage to provide coverage for bruxism diagnosis and treatment, including the cost of occlusal guards; requires medicaid and HMO coverage.

bills.t: Provides for the preservation of records of certain violations in correctional facilities
bills.a: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to promulgate rules and regulations to establish and maintain a system for the preservation of data on tier one violations in correctional facilities.

bills.t: Commemorating the 207th Anniversary of Walt Whitman's Birthday on May 31, 2026
Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program
bills.sm: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program.

bills.t: Relates to crypto kiosks
bills.sm: Provides for the registration and regulation of crypto kiosks and exchanges and licensing of cashier crypto exchange operators.

bills.t: Enacts the consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Enacts the "consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act" requiring manufacturers to make available certain documentation, parts, embedded software, firmware, or tools necessary for repairing equipment; establishes a timely repair for wheelchair program; deems all wheelchair repairs needed within 5 years of initial prescription medically necessary.

bills.t: Relates to lights for bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
bills.sm: Requires any person, firm, association or corporation selling or leasing bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in NYS to affix front and rear lights.

bills.t: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch
bills.sm: Authorizes an expedited application review process for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with Double H Ranch; provides such application fee shall be waived.

bills.t: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District
bills.a: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Grants retroactive participation in the New York State and Local Employees' Retirement System to the Rockland Central School District; deems such school district to have been a participating employer beginning on July 1, 2025 and relates to contributions made by eligible employees on and after July 1, 2025.

bills.t: Requires commissioners of local social services districts to screen, apply for, and use and conserve federal benefits on behalf of children placed in foster care
bills.sm: Requires commissioners of local social services districts to screen, apply for, and use and conserve retirement, survivors and disability insurance, supplemental security income, veterans' or any other federal social security benefits on behalf of certain children; provides for responsibilities of local commissioners of social services appointed to serve as the representative payee for a child; provides for technical assistance and financial literacy for certain children; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Provides benefits to Metro-North employees involved in or who witness a serious injury or fatality of another person in the course of an assigned duty
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Provides benefits to Metro-North employees involved in or who witness a serious injury or fatality of another person in the course of an assigned duty.

bills.t: Authorizes the city of Glen Cove to impose a hotel and motel tax
bills.a: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes a hotel and motel tax in the city of Glen Cove, in the county of Nassau, at a rate of four percent.

bills.t: Authorizes Michael O'Brien to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list to be a full-time police officer for the village of Le Roy
tl: REFERRED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes Michael O'Brien to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the village of Le Roy, in the county of Genesee.

bills.t: Relates to the disclosure of tenant screening criteria
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.271
bills.sm: Provides that a landlord shall provide a prospective tenant a written disclosure of the tenant screening criteria used to evaluate rental applications prior to accepting any fee, deposit, or screening information from such prospective tenant.

bills.t: Establishes a specialized electric vehicle emergency response training program
bills.sm: Requires the state fire administrator to make available a specialized electric vehicle emergency response training program to provide training to individuals responsible for providing emergency response and recovery following incidents involving electric vehicles; defines emergency medical services agency.

bills.t: Creates a temporary state commission concerning the incidence of asthma in the Bronx
bills.sm: Creates a temporary state commission to study and make recommendations concerning the incidence of asthma in the borough of the Bronx in New York city.

bills.t: Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of the Fort Orange Stamp Club
Honoring Beth Irons upon the occasion of her retirement as Market Manager of the Oneida County Public Market after years of dedicated service to the Mohawk Valley community
Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting
bills.sm: Requires state and county boards of elections to post sample ballots online at least twelve days prior to the first day of early voting; requires such ballots to be posted in a searchable database.

bills.t: Requires that all motor vehicles sold at motor vehicle dealerships contain a spare tire
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires that all new motor vehicles sold at motor vehicle dealerships contain a space saver tire unless certain exceptions apply.

bills.t: Relates to insurance coverage for endodontic services
bills.sm: Mandates insurance policies which cover restorative dental services to provide coverage for endodontic services including exams, imaging, root canals and post-treatment care.

bills.t: Relates to arbitration proceedings
bills.sm: Amends provisions of law governing arbitration proceedings; specifies fees and expenses with regard to employment or consumer arbitration proceedings; directs certain sanctions on a party which breaches an arbitration agreement.

bills.t: Adds ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions
bills.sm: Relates to adding ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions.

bills.t: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee based on the frequency of payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments
bills.sm: Prohibits certain financial institutions from charging a fee for making monthly, semi-monthly, and biweekly payments or for changing the frequency of mortgage payments.

bills.t: Requires towers to clean up any debris in the surrounding area resulting from the vehicles they are towing
bills.sm: Requires towers to clean up any debris in the surrounding area resulting from the vehicles they are towing and tow trucks to be equipped with the appropriate equipment for such clean up efforts.

bills.t: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers on renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.277
bills.sm: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers regarding renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs through a variety of methods, including brochures, posters, social media, television ads, and public ambassadors.

bills.t: Relates to requiring governmental entities to implement multifactor authentication for local and remote network access
bills.sm: Requires governmental entities to, whenever possible and feasible, consider implementing multifactor authentication for local and remote network access; requires public websites to encrypt all exchanges and to comply with privacy standards.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Rhinebeck, county of Dutchess, to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town
bills.sm: Authorizes the town of Rhinebeck, county of Dutchess, to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.t: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises; repealer
bills.sm: Exempts certain parcels of land from licensing restrictions prohibiting manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers of alcoholic beverages from sharing an interest in a licensed premises and from selling at retail for consumption on and off the premises.

bills.t: Relates to the sale and possession of self-defense spray devices in the state
bills.sm: Relates to the sale and possession of self-defense spray devices in the state; removes the requirement that only authorized dealers and pharmacists could sell such devices; provides that no more than two self-defense spray devices may be sold at any one time to a single purchaser; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

bills.t: Ensures the public has virtual access to public service commission proceedings and may file documents electronically
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Ensures the public has virtual access to public service commission proceedings and may file documents electronically.

bills.t: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without consent
bills.sm: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without signed written consent and requires disclosure if such information could be used to pay balances.

bills.t: Requires menstrual products to be provided in drop-in centers, intake shelters and emergency congregate housing
bills.sm: Requires menstrual products to be provided in drop-in centers, intake shelters and emergency congregate housing.

bills.t: Relates to the Sag Harbor Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.
bills.sm: Makes technical corrections to chapter 492 of the laws of 1981 relating to incorporating the Sag Harbor Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc., and providing for its powers and duties; changes "fireman" to "firefighter" and makes corrections to certain references.

bills.t: Relates to enabling constitutionally-qualified electors to register to vote and to cast a ballot on the same day at a polling location
bills.sm: Enables constitutionally-qualified electors to register to vote and to cast a ballot on the same day at a polling location.

bills.t: Relates to base proportions in assessing units in Nassau and Suffolk counties
bills.sm: Limits the amount of property tax shift between homestead/non-homestead and class share apportionment for local governments within and including Nassau and Suffolk County.

bills.t: Requires the workers' compensation board to submit a supplemental report every year
bills.sm: Requires the workers' compensation board to submit a supplemental report every year, including recommendations to modernize such board and certain data regarding claims made and decisions rendered on such claims.

bills.t: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign
bills.sm: Establishes a certified community behavioral health clinic public awareness campaign to educate the public regarding certified community behavioral health clinics.

bills.t: Relates to allowing health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid
bills.sm: Allows out of state health care professionals to perform services at the Ironman Lake Placid 2026.

bills.t: Recognizing the City of Rome, New York upon the occasion of hosting its 4th Annual Puerto Rico Constitution Day Celebration on June 27, 2026
Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before a certain date
bills.sm: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before June 30, 2027.

bills.t: Requires that notice of initial determination for unemployment benefits be provided
bills.sm: Requires that notice of initial determinations for unemployment benefits be provided to claimants within 30 days of such claimant furnishing all necessary documentation, and if the commissioner is unable to issue a determination within such time frame they shall inform the claimant of the new estimated time frame for the issuance of a determination.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency
bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead Community Development Agency for the 2020--2021 school taxes and the 2021 general taxes for the property at 40 Byrd Street.

bills.t: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys, provided that they live in Washington county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

bills.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties
bills.sm: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties; requires that such owners occupy such property as their primary residence and are enrolled in or eligible for the STAR exemption or credit or that such owners rent to a tenant for a term of at least twelve months and such tenant occupies such property as their primary residence.

bills.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
bills.sm: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

bills.t: Recognizing May 29, 2026, as Learn About Composting Day
Recognizing May 28, 2026, as National Marrow Donor Program Donor Day in the State of New York
Extends the authority for the town of Brookhaven to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited into a community preservation fund
bills.sm: Extends the authority for the town of Brookhaven to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited into a community preservation fund until 2045.

bills.t: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control
bills.sm: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control.

bills.t: Commemorating the 150th Anniversary of Davidson's Furniture
Relates to the geographic area of employment of state university police officers, centralization of the state university police, and hiring of state university police officers; repealer
bills.sm: Expands the geographic area of employment of state university police officers; centralizes the state university police by appointing a commissioner of state university police; provides for the hiring of state university police officers.

bills.t: Honoring the life and legacy of Thomas H. Watkins, Jr., a pioneering journalist, media entrepreneur, and champion for the economic and civic empowerment of the African-American community

Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report
bills.sm: Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report containing a comprehensive estimate and summary of funds needed and funds spent on stormwater projects under the department of environmental conservation, the environmental facilities corporation, the department of state and other applicable agencies or state authorities.

bills.t: Authorizes licensed creative arts therapists to bill Medicaid directly for their services
bills.sm: Authorizes licensed creative arts therapists to bill Medicaid directly for their services.

Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign
bills.sm: Establishes an elder financial exploitation public awareness campaign to educate older adults and persons providing care to older adults on the prevention and detection of financial exploitation.

bills.t: Relates to removing residency requirements for Ulster county assistant district attorneys
bills.sm: Removes residency requirements for persons holding the office of assistant district attorney for the county of Ulster; provides that a person holding such office may reside in Ulster county or an adjoining county within the state.

bills.t: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials
bills.sm: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials; requires the uniform building code to set standards for salvage lumber; requires the secretary of state to develop a program for grading salvage lumber for structural purposes.

bills.t: Relates to suspension of a license for failure to pay a fine for impaired driving violations
bills.sm: Permits the suspension of a license or driving privilege for failure to answer a summons for operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs; prohibits the reduction or waiving of fines or mandatory surcharges imposed for a violation of operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

bills.t: Adds home care visits to existing provisions of law prohibiting health care employers from requiring a nurse to work more than such nurse's regularly scheduled work hours
bills.sm: Adds home care visits to existing provisions of law prohibiting health care employers from requiring a nurse to work more than such nurse's regularly scheduled work hours, including regularly scheduled home care visits.

bills.t: Relates to penalties for contractors and subcontractors to cable television companies for violations of payroll reporting requirements, and to the payment of workers on certain excavation projects
bills.sm: Provides that contractors and subcontractors to cable television companies who are assessed penalties for two separate violations of payroll reporting requirements shall be ineligible to submit a bid on or be awarded any public work contract with the state, any municipal corporation or public body for five years; provides that cable television companies shall be subject to the requirement that workers on certain excavation projects be paid not less than a prevailing rate of wage.

bills.t: Relates to prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy
bills.sm: Provides that prescription labels for gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonists, pubertal suppressants, anabolic steroids, alpha reductase inhibitors, progestins, or drug classes for hormone replacement therapy maybe include the name of the dispensing practice instead of the prescriber; provides for notice to patients.

bills.t: Extends provisions related to certified school psychologists and special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions
bills.sm: Extends provisions related to certified school psychologists and special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions until June 30, 2028.

bills.t: Congratulating Cella McLaughlin upon the occasion of capturing the 2026 NYSPHSAA High School Indoor Track & Field Championship in the 55-meter hurdles race

bills.sm: Requires digital parking payment applications to provide notice of applicable parking restrictions to users based on location.

bills.t: Prohibits the sale of vape products that are made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one
bills.sm: Prohibits the sale of vape products that are made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one or are sold in packaging that is made to be attractive to or target persons under the age of twenty-one.

bills.t: Enacts the New York prediction market regulation act
bills.sm: Requires a license from the department of financial services to operate a prediction market; defines "prediction market" as any platform, electronic or physical, that allows participants to place wagers, trades, or financial positions on the outcome of future events, including but not limited to political, economic, weather, or other contingencies, where payouts are tied to event outcomes; provides for standards of conduct and enforcement authority by the department of financial services.

bills.t: Relates to payment of certain awards for disability
bills.sm: Includes the unaccrued portion of a non-schedule award in the amounts to be payable to and for the benefit of certain persons where a claimant was entitled to death benefits at the time of death.

bills.t: Relates to the health, safety and human rights of incarcerated pregnant individuals, incarcerated birthing parents of children and their children
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Relates to the health, safety and human rights of incarcerated pregnant individuals, incarcerated birthing parents and their children; requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish rules and regulations relating to conditions in institutions and correctional facilities and the treatment and care of birthing parents in such institutions and facilities.

bills.t: Includes certain persons engaged in a professional or teaching capacity in or for a religious, charitable or educational institution as employees for purposes of eligibility for paid family leave
bills.sm: Includes certain persons engaged in a professional or teaching capacity in or for a religious, charitable or educational institution as employees for purposes of eligibility for paid family leave.

bills.sm: Authorizes the City of Newburgh to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

bills.sm: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad at Stony Brook, Inc. for all of the 2025 general taxes and all of the 2025 school taxes.

bills.sm: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the town of Amherst, county of Erie, not to exceed 2.5%.

bills.sm: Requires potable water testing at state and local parks at least once every three years.

bills.sm: Permits amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects and the dismissal of a claim based upon claimant's failure to comply with jurisdictional pleading requirements.

bills.t: Relates to peace officer status for persons employed by the town of Southold serving on Fishers Island as public safety officers
bills.sm: Grants peace officer status to persons employed by the town of Southold serving on Fishers Island as public safety officers.

bills.sm: Designates the uniformed court officers of the town of Busti, in the county of Chautauqua, as peace officers.

bills.sm: Requires the division for small-business to publish a small business compliance guide and post such guide to the division for small-business's website.

bills.sm: Grants family leave benefits to persons who perform artistic and cultural work, including but not limited to, artistic and performing personnel, creative and design personnel, technical and production personnel, and front-of-house support personnel engaged in the production or operation of live theatrical or artistic performances.

bills.t: Enacts the "independent senior housing resident freedom of choice act" to authorize persons in independent housing to receive services they could get at home
bills.sm: Enacts the "independent senior housing resident freedom of choice act" to authorize persons in independent housing, shelters and residences to receive services they could otherwise receive if they resided in a private residence.

bills.t: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.225
bills.sm: Establishes the small business energy conservation ombudsman program to represent small businesses on issues relating to state energy policy and the goals of the climate leadership and community protection act.

bills.t: Limits the suspension or revocation of an individual's driver's license when participating in a treatment court program
bills.sm: Limits the suspension or revocation of an individual's driver's license when an individual takes a certain plea involving participation in certain treatment court programs or the court allowed the individual to withdraw their previously entered plea of guilty, and plead guilty to a lesser charge or the department revoked or suspended the individual's driver's license upon a plea of guilty and at least six months have elapsed since such initial plea.

bills.t: Relates to portable solar generation devices
bills.sm: Defines "portable solar generation device"; exempts portable solar generation devices from interconnection or net metering requirements; requires the state energy conservation construction code to allow for portable solar generation devices to be connected to a building's wiring through an electrical outlet.

bills.t: Establishes the white elephant housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Establishes the large projects historic rehabilitation tax credit and the "white elephant" housing historic rehabilitation projects tax credit program for qualified rehabilitation expenditures totaling fifty million dollars or more with respect to a certified historic structure that has been vacant, as determined by local code enforcement or other reasonable means, for at least ten of fifteen consecutive years preceding the date of the taxpayer's application for the rehabilitation credit.

bills.t: Relates to designating uniformed officers of the fire marshal's office of the town of Huntington as peace officers
bills.sm: Designates uniformed officers of the fire marshal's office of the town of Huntington as peace officers.

bills.t: Provides that consenting registrants of the adoption information registry may pre-authorize the release of identifying information
bills.sm: Provides that consenting registrants of the adoption information registry may pre-authorize the release of identifying information.

bills.t: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to make facility water testing results accessible to the public, incarcerated individuals and correctional facility staff
bills.sm: Requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to make correctional facility water testing results accessible directly, upon request, to incarcerated individuals and correctional facility staff in such facilities and make such water testing results available to the public on the website of the department.

bills.t: Provides for elder abuse prevention training
bills.sm: Requires the office for the aging to develop and provide elder abuse prevention training to train senior service centers and entities that contract with the office for the aging and the office of children and family services to provide services to elderly persons in the detection and reporting of elder abuse in consultation with the office of children and family services.

bills.t: Relates to the duration of mechanic's liens
bills.sm: Provides for the continuation of a mechanic's lien which has been discharged by undertaking for a period of three years from the commencement of a foreclosure action.

Commemorating June 11, 2026, as International Day of Play

bills.sm: Requires all authorities having jurisdiction over a population exceeding five thousand residents to adopt a residential automated solar permitting platform by June thirtieth, two thousand twenty-seven.

bills.t: Creates a commission to reform public assistance benefits
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN SOCIAL SERVICES
bills.sm: Creates a commission to reform public assistance benefits to conduct a study to examine the current payment method for public assistance benefits and to identify any and all income levels that exist where an individual or family would become ineligible for any public assistance benefit.

bills.t: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park
bills.sm: Establishes a distinctive plate for the Adirondack park.

bills.t: Relates to fair pricing for low-complexity, routine medical care
bills.sm: Relates to fair pricing for low-complexity, routine medical care to more closely align payment rates across ambulatory settings for selected services that are safe and appropriate to provide in all settings.

bills.t: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system to Jason T McGlone
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Hancock to Jason T McGlone.

bills.t: Provides for enhanced rates for child care services provided to disabled and/or developmentally delayed children
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of social services shall establish a rate differential for child care providers who provide care to a child with a diagnosed developmental delay or disability, provided such rate differential is no less than 30% above the applicable market rate otherwise payable for such child care services, and further provided such rate differential is sufficient to provide appropriate care.

bills.t: Relates to orders of protection where the respondent is a minor who resides with a parent or other legally responsible person or other party
bills.sm: Relates to orders of protection where the respondent is a minor who resides with a parent or other legally responsible person or other party; prohibits courts from issuing an order of protection that directs a minor respondent to stay away from the home of a parent or other person legally responsible for the respondent if the respondent would not have an appropriate alternative residence; provides that such a respondent shall have the right to have a guardian ad litem appointed, if appropriate; authorizes suspended judgment in certain cases provided that the respondent participate in a batterer's education program.

bills.t: Relates to the composition of the interagency task force on human trafficking
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Relates to the composition of the interagency task force on human trafficking and when such reports shall be submitted.

bills.t: Directs local social services districts to implement an income eligibility standard when available child care block grant funding is nearing exhaustion
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN CHILDREN AND FAMILIES
bills.sm: Provides that a social services district may implement an income eligibility standard for recipients of child care block grant funds when such district projects that allocated funds will be insufficient to open all eligible non-guaranteed cases; sets the income eligibility standards.

bills.t: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
bills.sm: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

bills.t: Relates to airport noise studies metrics
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of health to undertake a study utilizing a uniform metric for measuring noise impacts that will be used by airports for the purpose of noise exposure maps and noise compatibility programs.

bills.sm: Provides remote work flexibilities for licensed mortgage loan originators and staff and employees of licensed mortgage bankers, registered mortgage brokers and mortgage loan servicers under certain circumstances.

bills.sm: Provides for distinctive license plates for gold star family members; eliminates the registration fee for gold star parent and gold star family member distinctive license plates.

bills.a: AMEND BY RESTORING TO ORIGINAL PRINT 7630
bills.sm: Relates to the requirements for licensure of funeral directors; specifies requirements for a residency period under the direct supervision of a preceptor; sets requirements to act as a preceptor.

bills.t: Provides for licensing of a dental therapist
bills.sm: Requires individuals who practice the profession of dental therapy to be licensed and registered in the state; provides Medicaid reimbursement for dental therapy services.

bills.t: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"
bills.a: AMEND BY RESTORING TO ORIGINAL PRINT 9678
bills.sm: Enacts the "Jamie Rose care provider act"; requires health care facilities have policies for suspected victims of domestic abuse.

bills.t: Relates to consumer warnings regarding rifles, shotguns, and firearms
bills.sm: Relates to consumer warnings regarding rifles, shotguns, and firearms; provides that a graphic warning that depicts the nature of the health and safety risks of firearms be provided when any license or permit is issued or amended.

bills.t: Requires employers to provide paid leave of absence to veterans on Veterans' day
bills.sm: Requires employers to offer paid leave of absence to veterans on Veterans' day, except for emergency or critical employees, who shall be offered another day of paid leave.

bills.t: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory
bills.sm: Requires healthcare facilities to maintain a fifty percent operating threshold of certain reusable healthcare protective textiles in their inventory unless a reprieve is provided for supply chain issues; provides a fine may be assessed for failure to comply, as determined by the commissioner.

bills.t: Relates to the placement of homeless shelters
bills.sm: Requires that no homeless shelter shall be located within five hundred feet of a transit facility or within a building that has a rent-controlled or rent-stabilized dwelling unit.

bills.t: Provides protections against illegal voter purging
bills.sm: Provides protections against illegal voter purging.

bills.t: Relates to obtaining jurisdiction over certain defendants in matters relating to a tenancy or lease
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.175
bills.sm: Standardizes the language across the relevant court acts to allow tenants statewide to sue in the county where the real property at issue is located in matters relating to a tenancy or lease; requires the Office of Court Administration to develop necessary forms, procedures and deliver a report.

bills.t: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the village of Freeport assessor
bills.sm: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2026 assessment roll.

bills.t: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease
bills.sm: Requires landlords to mitigate damages when commercial tenants vacate premises in violation of the terms of the lease.

bills.t: Designates an individual who has been convicted of certain crimes or of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor
bills.sm: Designates an individual found to have been convicted of certain crimes where the complainant or victim is an amateur or professional athlete, coach, official or other participant in a sports event, or a jockey, driver, trainer, owner, official or other participant in a horse race, or to have been convicted of certain offenses involving sports contests, horse races, or wagering thereon, as a prohibited sports bettor; requires the commission to notify the individual; allows for the individual to contest such designation; requires account wagering licensees to prohibit any individual designated as a prohibited sports bettor from establishing or maintaining a wagering account.

bills.t: Establishes a usage monitor program
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program for the purposes of notifying residential customers when energy usage exceeds a cost or usage threshold in a given billing period determined by the residential customer.

bills.t: Relates to employee access to lactation rooms in the workplace
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Relates to employee access to lactation rooms in the workplace; requires that employers post written policies regarding the rights of nursing employees.

bills.t: Congratulating Dr. Carol Podgorski upon the occasion of her retirement after many years of distinguished service to the University of Rochester Medical Center
Requires age verification for internet pornography websites
bills.sm: Requires age verification for internet pornography websites; imposes a $50,000 penalty per day for violations; provides exemptions for news organizations.

bills.t: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties
bills.sm: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties having a population of more than 1.38 million and less than 1.42 million, determined in accordance with the latest federal decennial census.

bills.t: Relates to granting certain individuals youthful offender status or young adult offender status; repealer
bills.sm: Relates to granting certain individuals youthful offender status; adds a new category of individuals eligible for young adult offender status; provides for process and sentencing requirements related to such statuses.

bills.t: Enacts the stop subsidizing data centers act
bills.sm: Prohibits allocation of economic development power to data centers; provides for certain caps on amounts and eligibility for industrial development agency financial assistance; provides for the return of industrial development agency-awarded financial assistance if certain job levels are not maintained within 5 years of project completion; designates the department of environmental conservation as the mandatory lead agency for environmental quality review of any action consuming over 20 megawatts; requires environmental quality review for any action within 10 miles of a federally recognized Indian nation's territory.

bills.t: Commemorating the 100th Anniversary of The Cider Mill in Endicott, New York
Commemorating the 300th Anniversary of Old Fort Niagara
Relates to certain reforms for ORES oversight of siting of major renewable energy facilities and major electric transmission facilities
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to transparency and other requirements for applications submitted to ORES for siting of major renewable energy and major electric transmission facilities.

bills.t: Mourning the untimely death of Christopher G. Hunter, distinguished historian, archivist, and devoted member of his community
Relates to the application of New York state's human rights law to out-of-state employees
bills.sm: Relates to the application of New York state's human rights law to employees who work outside of the state of New York, if their employer maintains a physical address within New York state.

bills.t: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance
bills.sm: Relates to medical malpractice excess line insurance.

bills.t: Relates to certain motor vehicle license plates; repealer
bills.sm: Provides for fines and/or imprisonment for a person who knowingly sells, offers to sell, buys, or offers to buy a false, fraudulent, or stolen license, identification card, certificate of registration, or number plate.

bills.t: Commemorating the 2026 SUMAQ Peruvian Food Festival in Brentwood, New York, held August 8-9, 2026
Grants certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Enacts the heroes park pass act to grant certain first responders free use of state parks and campsites.

bills.t: Requires a statement of the full sales price of real property being conveyed and proof of such sales price to be submitted to the recording officer
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.154
bills.sm: Enacts the "deed theft: proof of sale price act" requiring a statement of the full sales price of real property being conveyed and proof of such sales price to be submitted to the recording officer in order for such officer to record or accept for recording the conveyance of real property.

bills.t: Relates to penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death
bills.sm: Increases penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving a death.

bills.t: Establishes bicycle with electric assist safety courses and requiring purchasers of bicycles with electric assist to provide a bicycle with electric assist safety certificate
bills.sm: Establishes bicycle with electric assist safety courses; requires purchasers of bicycles with electric assist to provide a bicycle with electric assist safety certificate at the time of purchase; requires operators of bicycles with electric assist to carry identification when operating such bicycles.

bills.t: Relates to enhanced eligibility requirements of STAR
bills.sm: Relates to enhanced eligibility requirements of STAR; bases income on retirement.

bills.t: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Enacts the "Niagara parks reinvestment act"; requires fifty percent of parking revenue generated at state parks in the county of Niagara to be deposited in the Niagara parks reinvestment fund; establishes the Niagara parks reinvestment fund.

bills.t: Authorizes the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to discipline certain employees for acts of serious misconduct
bills.a: REPORTED AND COMMITTED TO CIVIL SERVICE AND PENSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CRIME VICTIMS, CRIME AND CORRECTION
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to discipline certain employees for acts of serious misconduct; defines serious misconduct; establishes procedures for such disciplinary action; prohibits employees who have been removed for serious misconduct from being placed on the eligible list after such removal.

bills.t: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Establishes the adult care facility voucher demonstration program for persons with dementia, Alzheimer's diagnosis, or other cognitive impairments to provide a sliding-scale subsidy for adult care facility residents who are at risk of losing nursing home care due to depleted resources and to individuals who are not eligible for Medicaid or supplemental security income, but in need of adult day care services.

bills.t: Relates to exempting school buses from certain regulations on the percentage of zero-emission vehicles in manufacturers' sales fleets
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION
bills.sm: Exempts school buses from certain regulations relating to the percentage of zero-emission vehicles in manufacturer's sales fleets of medium-duty and heavy-duty vehicles.

bills.t: Relates to establishing school-based food pantries in schools in the city school district of the city of New York
bills.sm: Establishes school-based food pantries in high need schools in the city school district of the city of New York.

bills.t: Enacts the "homeowner fraud protection and property alert act"
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Enacts the "homeowner fraud protection and property alert act"; relates to establishing a statewide electronic property recording alert system to allow property owners to receive notification when an instrument affecting their property is recorded in the official records of any county; establishes the county recording modernization fund.

bills.t: Mourning the death of United States Border Patrol Agent Sean M. McDonough, devoted public servant, military veteran, family man, and beloved member of the North Country community
Increases personal income tax exemption for persons with dependent senior citizen residing with them, requires report by office for the aging on effect of exemption
bills.sm: Provides a resident taxpayer an additional personal income tax exemption for each dependent who is 65 years of age or older and who is residing with the taxpayer; requires the office for the aging to biennially report to the governor and legislature concerning the effects of such additional tax exemption on programs offered under the auspices or with the support, direct or indirect, of the office for the aging.

bills.t: Relates to electronic appearances for parking violations
bills.sm: Provides that persons charged with a parking violation shall be able to make an electronic court appearance unless a locality elects not to permit electronic appearances.

bills.t: Enacts the Census Enumerator Navigation Safety for Unimpeded Surveying Act
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Supplements federal law regarding access by census enumerators to multi-residence buildings; provides for the development of guidance regarding access for building personnel.

bills.t: Relates to compliance by New York city marshals with filing requirement regarding service of a notice of eviction
bills.sm: Requires New York city marshals to complete an electronic filing within one business day of service of a notice of eviction.

bills.t: Relates to extreme risk protection orders
bills.sm: Relates to extreme risk protection orders; defines "exception"; authorizes a police officer or district attorney to file an application for an extreme risk protection order if found that a person meets the requirements of an exception pursuant to section 6340 of the civil practice law and rules; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Creates the New York health benefit and cost commission; repealer
bills.sm: Creates the New York health benefit and cost commission to review and report on utilization rates, public and patient health effects, and impact on premiums and access to health care and health coverage of all existing and proposed mandated health benefits.

bills.t: Commending the Charlton Historical Society upon the occasion of hosting its 56th Annual Charlton Founders Day Weekend and Parade on June 7, 2026
Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation
bills.a: ORDERED TO THIRD READING RULES CAL.147
bills.sm: Designates certain entities relating to the decommissioning of Indian Point state agencies for the purposes of MWBE participation including the Indian Point Decommissioning Oversight Board and the Indian Point Closure Task Force.

bills.t: Relates to the enforcement of liens by sale of the occupant's goods that remain in a self-storage facility
bills.sm: Permits the sale of goods that remain in a self-storage facility to enforce a lien by the facility through a public website, pursuant to notice requirements.

bills.t: Enacts the Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Act
bills.sm: Enacts the Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Act directing the governor to invite the governors of Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Vermont, Maine, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania to participate in a Northeast Regional Health Insurance Compact Summit along with their respective health and insurance regulators, to discuss the feasibility of creating a Regional Health Insurance Collaborative that allows residents of participating states to purchase qualified health insurance plans offered in any member state.

bills.t: Relates to requiring prescription drug containers be labeled with a description of the size, shape, color and imprint of the prescription drug it contains if such drug is in tablet or capsule form
bills.sm: Requires prescription drug containers be labeled with a description of the size, shape, color and imprint of the prescription drug it contains if such drug is in tablet or capsule form.

bills.t: Relates to the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees
bills.sm: Adds falsely reporting the use of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument as part of the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees.

bills.t: Honoring Ed Gosek upon the occasion of his retirement after 36 years of distinguished service to SUNY Oswego
Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN ENVIRONMENTAL CONSERVATION
bills.sm: Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program for municipalities to receive grants for plans to develop solar energy systems on agricultural land and commercially-zoned properties in such municipalities; creates a database to track such solar energy system distribution.

bills.t: Provides for establishment of school speed limits by county legislative body
bills.sm: Provides for the establishment of school speed limits of not less than fifteen miles per hour by the legislative body of any county or, if so delegated, by the legislative body of any locality within said county on a portion of a state highway passing a school building.

bills.t: Relates to providing additional duties of the community gardens task force
bills.sm: Requires the community gardens task force to conduct an assessment of all community gardens located on publicly owned land in the state to facilitate each garden's designation as a critical environmental area.

bills.t: Authorizes seniors and persons who are severely disabled to use an ATV to enter and exit certain lands for ice fishing
bills.sm: Authorizes seniors and persons who are severely disabled to use an ATV to enter and exit certain lands where ice fishing is permitted by the department of environmental conservation when conditions are reasonably safe for the operation of ATV's.

bills.t: Relates to supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors
bills.sm: Provides for supervision by certain marriage and family therapists and mental health counselors who meet certain experience requirements.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of adhesive-based rodent traps in state-owned or state-leased buildings.

bills.t: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks in certain cases
bills.sm: Prohibits the use of student loan payment credit history checks to ascertain the payment status of a student loan of an applicant for employment.

bills.t: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Enacts the New York state good guardianship act to establish the statewide initiative of not-for-profit guardians.

bills.t: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home
bills.sm: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home.

bills.t: Prohibits the mayor from residing in a rent stabilized apartment
bills.sm: Prohibits the mayor from residing in a rent stabilized apartment; authorizes a landlord of a rent stabilized accommodation to bring a special proceeding to evict the mayor.

bills.t: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
bills.sm: Authorizes the town justice of the town of West Almond, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town, so long as such person resides in Allegany county.

bills.t: Authorizes all municipalities to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan
bills.sm: Authorizes all municipalities, with the consent of the county and the governing body of such municipality, to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan; requires certification.

bills.t: Commending the Valedictorians and Salutatorians of the Class of 2026 in the 1st Senate District, in recognition of their outstanding accomplishments
Relates to guardians of persons who are intellectually and developmentally disabled; and repeals certain provisions of the surrogate's court procedure act relating thereto
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Relates to guardians of persons who are intellectually and developmentally disabled; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

bills.t: Requires certain manufacturers to sell and distribute plastic beverage containers with tethered plastic beverage caps
bills.sm: Requires manufacturers with gross annual beverage sale revenues of ten million dollars or more, beginning January 1, 2030, to sell and distribute plastic beverage containers with tethered plastic beverage caps or openings from which the beverage can be consumed while the plastic beverage cap remains screwed onto or otherwise affixed to the plastic beverage container; requires manufacturers with gross annual beverage sale revenues of one million dollars or more to comply by January 1, 2033.

bills.t: Relates to certain commercial fishing and shellfish licenses and permits
bills.sm: Provides that where the total number of commercial food fish license, commercial crab permits, commercial whelk and conch licenses, and marine and coastal district party and charter boat license applications from persons who were not issued such license in the previous year exceeds the number of licenses that are available, the department of environmental conservation shall randomly select recipients of the available licenses from among those applications received by the first business day of the applicable license year.

bills.t: Relates to land used in agricultural production
bills.sm: Includes certain land that is owned or rented as a farm operation for the production for sale of crops, livestock or livestock products as land used in agricultural production.

bills.t: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct a study on health insurance coverage requirements
bills.sm: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct a comprehensive study on mandatory health insurance coverage benefits within the state as compared to other states and the impacts of removing such requirements.

bills.t: Establishes a municipal senior center capital support program in the office for the aging for local senior centers to assist municipalities in accessing capital funds necessary for the purchase of senior buses
bills.sm: Establishes a municipal senior center capital support program in the office for the aging to assist municipalities in accessing capital funds necessary for the purchase of senior buses; directs the director of the office for the aging to develop an application and establish criteria for the disbursement of grants to eligible municipalities for the purpose of procuring senior buses; makes an appropriation.

bills.t: Relates to providing valid government issued photo identification when casting a ballot
bills.sm: Requires a valid government issued photo identification card be presented when casting a ballot; provides for persons eligible for Medicaid to receive identification cards.

bills.t: Commemorating the 104th Anniversary of Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Inc., to be celebrated on November 12, 2026
Commending the Capital Region Chamber of Commerce upon the occasion of hosting its Military Appreciation event on May 21, 2026
Commemorating the 175th Anniversary of St. Ann s Church in the City of Hornell, New York
Relates to licensing of independent insurance adjusters
bills.sm: Relates to licensing of independent insurance adjusters by deeming requirements regarding a written examination met if the applicant holds a claim certification from a national or state-based claims association.

bills.t: Mourning the deaths of Bishop Dr. Donald D. Maxwell and Reverend Liscent B. Maxwell
Relates to transferring the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repealer
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Transfers the village of Potsdam housing authority to the village of Canton housing authority; repeals provisions relating to the village of Potsdam housing authority.

bills.t: Relates to mandatory arbitration clauses in employment contracts
