bills.sm: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority, in consultation with the Long Island Rail Road, to establish a no fare program for transportation on the Long Island Rail Road for individuals in active military service of the United States and active duty members of the New York national guard, upon showing a military or national guard identification card.

bills.t: Requires electric utility corporations, energy services companies and municipalities to provide an itemized breakdown on all monthly bills
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires electric utility corporations, energy services companies and municipalities to provide an itemized breakdown on all monthly bills detailing infrastructure costs, contributions to the New York Power Authority, and other public utility investments.

bills.t: Relates to providing transparency to residential utility and municipality ratepayers on the cost impact of the climate action council's scoping plan
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires utility corporations and municipalities to ensure that bills for service to residential customers include a line item for cost impact measures taken in accordance with the climate action council's final scoping plan; requires the department of public service to establish a formula to enable utility corporations and municipalities to calculate the cost impact on each residential customer's bill attributed to measures taken in accordance with the climate action council's final scoping plan.

bills.t: Directs the commissioner of health to establish best practice protocols to screen children four years of age and younger for vision problems
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of health to establish best practice protocols to screen children four years of age and younger for vision problems.

bills.t: Honoring Dr. Bonita Durand upon the occasion of her retirement after 25 years of distinguished service to Buffalo State University
Designates fire marshals employed in the Long Island Rail Road Company Office of the Fire Marshals as peace officers
bills.sm: Designates fire marshals employed in the Long Island Rail Road Company Office of the Fire Marshals as peace officers.

bills.t: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats
bills.sm: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats; prohibited for reasons of convenience in keeping or handling a dog or cat.

bills.t: Relates to certain jury awards in employment discrimination actions
bills.sm: Provides that the court shall not reduce jury awards as excessive in employment discrimination actions unless the court finds exceptional circumstances which compel the conclusion that the jury was influenced by partiality, prejudice, mistake or corruption or that remittitur or additur is necessary to avoid a complete miscarriage of justice.

bills.t: Relates to the metropolitan transit authority
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Relates to the metropolitan transit authority; provides that the members from the counties of Dutchess, Orange, Putnam and Rockland shall each cast one vote apiece, instead of one collective vote.

bills.t: Relates to granting employees access to personnel records
bills.sm: Grants employees access to personnel records; requires notice of negative information in such records and an opportunity for a review; permits employee to include certain information in personnel records.

bills.t: Requires certain public authorities to develop a feasibility study to promote bicycle and pedestrian access on bridges
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires the New York state bridge authority, the Thousand Islands bridge authority, the Nassau county bridge authority, the Ogdensburg bridge authority, and the New York state thruway authority to develop a feasibility study to promote bicycle and pedestrian access on bridges and provide a report to the governor, temporary president of the senate, speaker of the assembly, and the public a copy of such plan.

bills.t: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes with respect to certain aircraft; and repeals certain provisions of the tax law relating thereto
bills.sm: Relates to the imposition of sales and compensating use taxes with respect to certain aircraft; repeals provisions relating to the exemption from sales and compensating use taxes of general aviation aircraft, and machinery or equipment to be installed on such aircraft.

bills.t: Authorizes university faculty practice corporations for the practice of occupational therapy
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes licensed occupational therapists who are members of the faculty of a college or university with an accredited occupational therapy program to create a university faculty practice corporation for occupational therapy students to receive clinical instruction.

bills.t: Authorizes Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes the Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2026 assessment roll and all of the 2025-2026 school taxes.

bills.t: Relates to the qualifications to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland
bills.sm: Allows a non-resident to hold the position of assistant county attorney in the county of Rockland.

bills.t: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation
bills.sm: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation.

bills.t: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each hospital a list of its hospital rule-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

bills.t: Establishes the statewide fibroid study program

bills.sm: Relates to sales and compensating use taxes imposed with respect to vessels.

bills.t: Authorizes Godschild Outreach Ministries to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
bills.sm: Authorizes Godschild Outreach Ministries to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk.

bills.sm: Authorizes residential cooperative corporations to offer health insurance.

bills.sm: Directs state agencies to adopt a waste diversion plan.

bills.sm: Authorizes the county of Erie to offer an optional twenty year retirement plan to Nicholas Cervoni, Thomas Makin, and Sarah Murphy, deputy sheriffs employed by such county.

bills.sm: Relates to due process rights for non-public school students with special needs.

bills.sm: Authorizes and directs the department of public service to conduct a study on the deployment of energy interconnection processes into the electrical grid to meet the state's renewable energy goals; directs the department of public service to submit a report on its findings one year after the effective date.

bills.t: Relates to the consumer protection division in the department of state
bills.sm: Requires the consumer protection division to establish a process by which any state agency or third party, pursuant to an interagency agreement with the division for the purposes of fraud prevention, identity verification, and ensuring the integrity or security of individual identities, to grant access to verify New York resident identities via a secure comparison process against state systems.

bills.t: Relates to security expenses for candidates for and holders of elective office
bills.sm: Authorizes the expenditure of contributions received by a candidate or a political committee for security expenses incurred to address ongoing dangers and threats to a candidate, the campaign staff for such candidate, or the candidate's immediate family related to the status or activities as a candidate for elective office or holder of elective office.

bills.t: Congratulating Ava Guilmette of Shenendehowa High School upon the occasion of capturing the 2026 NYSPHSAA Girls Wrestling Championship title in the 165-pound Division on February 26, 2026
Congratulating the Marlboro High School Boys Bowling Team upon the occasion of winning the New York State Public High School Athletic Association Division II State Championship
Enacts the energy assessment cap and consumer cost relief act
bills.sm: Enacts the "energy assessment cap and consumer cost relief act" to limit certain surcharge increases; directs studies on costs associated with environmental and energy laws; directs a study on the value of assets and utility gas infrastructure discontinued as a result of laws and regulatory actions; institutes a moratorium on related surcharges, taxes, fees and cost bearing regulations for five years.

bills.t: Requires transmitters of money to provide a certain warning to consumers
bills.sm: Requires transmitters of money to provide a warning which informs consumers of certain fraudulent activities that may occur.

bills.t: Enacts the "consumer protection and automotive transparency act"
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Enacts the consumer protection and automotive transparency act mandating transparency in automotive labeling relating to materials used in motor vehicles.

bills.t: Relates to staffing at state-operated facilities that deliver health care services
bills.sm: Requires each state-operated facility that delivers health care services which is operated and licensed pursuant to the mental hygiene law, the education law, the correction law or section 504 of the executive law and which requires two or more registered nurses or licensed practical nurses to be present within the facility at any given time.

bills.t: Prohibits the imposition of a system benefits charge on ratepayers' utility bills
bills.sm: Prohibits the public service commission's imposition of a system benefits charge on ratepayers' utility bills.

bills.t: Relates to the establishment of local comprehensive emergency management plans
bills.sm: Requires the inclusion of local and municipal animal shelters, any duly incorporated society for the prevention of cruelty to animals and veterinary services when establishing local comprehensive emergency management plans; requires that information to the public include the communication accommodation needs of persons with vision or hearing impairments and information on which temporary housing and other necessary facilities are designated as animal-friendly.

bills.t: Requires government-issued photo registration for registration and voting
bills.a: HELD FOR CONSIDERATION IN ELECTION LAW

bills.a: REPORTED AND COMMITTED TO CONSUMER PROTECTION

bills.t: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies and lenders from using an individual's late payment of cashless tolls to determine their credit worthiness
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Prohibits consumer reporting agencies and lenders from using an individual's late payment of cashless tolls to determine their credit worthiness.

bills.t: Relates to requiring training of police department and state police personnel on the protocols of the address confidentiality program
bills.sm: Requires the secretary of state to develop and mandate training of police department personnel and state police officers on the protocols of the address confidentiality program.

bills.t: Requires the court to treat the date of dissolution as if a spouse retired from employment with New York state when calculating the distribution of a pension
bills.sm: Requires the court to treat the date of dissolution as if a spouse retired from employment with New York state when calculating the distribution of a pension for the purposes of divorce.

bills.t: Relates to contributions paid into the insurance reserve fund by the Medford fire district
bills.sm: Authorizes the Medford fire district, located in Suffolk county, to deposit into the insurance reserve fund an amount of $400,000 in each of the years 2026, 2027 and 2028.

bills.t: Relates to prohibiting the construction of certain energy storage systems within five hundred feet of a school or dwelling in a city of one million or more
bills.sm: Prohibits the construction or maintenance of energy storage systems capable of storing more than twenty kilowatt hours within five hundred feet of a school or dwelling in a city with a population of one million or more.

bills.t: Permits accidental death benefits and/or special accidental death benefits to be awarded to the beneficiary of Patricia Espinosa

bills.sm: Provides that persons arrested for domestic violence forfeit bail when violating an order of protection.

bills.sm: Relates to requiring bills with a threshold level of co-sponsorship to be brought to the floor for a vote to be taken thereon.

bills.t: Relates to emissions of toxic air contaminants
bills.sm: Directs the department of environmental conservation to promulgate air quality standards for emissions of certain toxic air contaminants.

bills.t: Commending Jaxon Egloff upon the occasion of his designation as the New York State Sportswriters Association s Class D Boys Basketball Player of the Year
Congratulating Phyllis H. Rigby upon the occasion of celebrating her 100th Birthday
Relates to the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain payments and transfers
bills.sm: Provides for the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain loans, payments and transfers.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 4, 2026, as Volunteer Firefighters' Appreciation Day in the State of New York
Relates to the personal income tax rates; repealer
bills.sm: Phases in tax cuts to the personal income tax over a period of ten years; repeals certain provisions relating to tax benefit recapture.

bills.t: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
bills.sm: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

bills.t: Congratulating Lloyd Evans upon the occasion of celebrating his 100th Birthday
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 3-9, 2026, as Drinking Water Week in the State of New York
Commending LifeSong, Inc. upon the occasion of hosting its 14th Annual LifeSong Dash 5k on June 6, 2026
Establishes the commercial tenant opportunity to purchase act
bills.sm: Establishes the commercial tenant opportunity to purchase act; provides commercial tenants the right of first refusal for the purchase of certain commercial rental properties.

bills.t: Requires certain health insurance policies to provide coverage for diabetes and prediabetes screening
bills.sm: Requires certain health insurance policies to provide coverage for diabetes and prediabetes screening.

bills.t: Enacts "Brendon's law" relating to motor vehicle speed contests, races, sideshows and street takeovers
bills.sm: Enacts "Brendon's law" to prohibit participation, including spectators within two hundred feet, of any motor vehicle speed contest, sideshow and street takeovers; authorizes seizure and forfeiture; adds damaging an authorized emergency vehicle as constituting the crime of criminal mischief in the third degree.

bills.t: Requires colleges, universities, professional, proprietary, and graduate schools to provide a notice of tuition liability policies
bills.sm: Requires colleges, universities, professional, proprietary and graduate schools to provide written notice to all students of the institution's tuition liability policy.

bills.t: Enacts the "advancing rights for talent, independence, services and tenure (ARTIST) act"
bills.a: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Enacts the "advancing rights for talent, independence, services and tenure (ARTIST) act" in relation to personal services contracts between artists and companies.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 4, 2026, as 10th Mountain Division and Fort Drum Day in the State of New York
Requires health plan coverage to include certain generic drugs and biosimilars
bills.sm: Requires health plan coverage to include generic drugs and biosimilars where the wholesale acquisition cost of such generic drugs or biosimilars is lower than the brand drug's wholesale acquisition cost.

bills.t: Provides that transportation shall be provided to all children attending grades kindergarten through twelve who live within a fifteen mile radius of the school they legally attend
bills.sm: Provides that transportation shall be provided to all children attending grades kindergarten through twelve who live within a fifteen mile radius of the school they legally attend; provides that such transportation may also be provided for such students to before-and/or-after-school child care locations.

bills.t: Relates to requiring the public service commission to provide certain information relating to a major change in rates on its website
bills.sm: Requires the public service commission to post a written summary of the actions taken by the commission or department upon approval of a major change in rates to promote ratepayer affordability and minimizing residential energy burden.

bills.t: Memorializing Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 2026, as Motorcycle Safety and Awareness Month in the State of New York
Relates to eligibility for accidental disability benefits under the heart bill
bills.sm: Allows a one-year window for application for a disability retirement for members of the New York state and local employees' retirement system or the New York state and local police and fire retirement system who retired from service on or after January 1, 2021 due to heart disease; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

bills.t: Expands the training time for local municipalities in relation to the open meetings law
bills.sm: Expands the training time for local municipalities in relation to the open meetings law; requires at least one hour of such training be provided by the committee on open government or an appropriate entity in relation to compliance with the open meetings law and if not provided, a justification shall be given.

bills.t: Relates to the powers of the head of the office of mental health and the head of the office for people with developmental disabilities to promulgate rules regarding communications needs of non-English speakers
bills.sm: Relates to the powers of the head of the office of mental health and the head of the office for people with developmental disabilities to promulgate rules regarding communications needs of non-English speakers seeking or receiving services; includes the provision of language services and documents in English and the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by individuals in New York State based on United States census data.

bills.t: Relates to the scope of quasi-judicial immunity of referees in mortgage foreclosure actions
bills.sm: Clarifies and codifies the limits of quasi-judicial immunity applicable to referees appointed in mortgage foreclosure actions; ensures accountability for misconduct and ultra vires acts.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 4-10, 2026, as Postpartum Depression Awareness Week in the State of New York
Relates to capital upgrades to certain residential health care facilities
bills.sm: Ensures that publicly-sponsored residential health care facilities and facilities that receive grants under the Statewide Health Care Facility Transformation program are not subject to outdated total project cost caps or excessive project equity requirements.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 2026 as Hypertension Awareness Month in the State of New York
Directs the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to study gender disparity in sentencing outcomes
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services to study gender disparity in sentencing outcomes and make a report to the governor and the legislature of their findings, conclusions and recommendations.

bills.t: Establishes the Birch Hill-Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County
bills.sm: Establishes the Birch Hill - Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County.

bills.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 6, 2026
bills.sm: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 6, 2026 for the support of government.

bills.t: Relates to enforcement actions by the office of cannabis management
bills.sm: Expands available enforcement actions by the office of cannabis management.

bills.t: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads
bills.sm: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads.

bills.t: Relates to increasing utility rate increase transparency
bills.sm: Increases utility rate increase transparency for consumers by requiring additional information be made accessible to the public regarding fuel cost increases and increases in rates or charges.

bills.t: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities
bills.sm: Increases the time certain parties have to submit a notice of intent to be a party to the certification proceedings for the siting of major utility transmission facilities from thirty days to forty-five days.

bills.t: Removes designating letters on ballots
bills.sm: Removes designating letters for rows and columns on ballots.

bills.t: Requires employers to pay employees accrued but unused vacation, paid time off, or other paid leave provided upon separation from employment
bills.sm: Requires employers to pay employees accrued but unused vacation, paid time off, or other paid leave provided upon termination, resignation, retirement or other separation from employment.

bills.t: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer
bills.sm: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer within 2 years of the effective date.

bills.t: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
bills.sm: Authorizes George Orfanoudakis to receive certain retroactive membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

bills.t: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices against tenants relating to citizenship or immigration status
bills.sm: Prohibits landlords or their agents from inquiring or requiring disclosure about citizenship or immigration status, requiring specific immigration documentation to be presented, disclosing immigration or citizenship status to third parties, or threatening to report a tenant's citizenship or immigration status in retaliation for asserting their rights.

bills.t: Relates to the inspection of meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity by the division of weights and measures
bills.sm: Directs the division of weights and measures to inspect meters and other apparatus used for regulating and supplying gas or electricity to verify that such apparatus are properly maintained and calibrated.

bills.t: Relates to sentences of imprisonment for offenses committed while using public transportation
bills.sm: Imposes certain sentences of imprisonment for offenses committed while using public transportation; creates the offense of reckless endangerment on public transportation as a class A-I felony.

bills.t: Authorizes the board of trustees of any library chartered by the regents of the state of New York to develop, lease, or use public library spaces for the purposes of constructing affordable, mixed-use housing
bills.a: REFERRED TO LIBRARIES AND EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY
tl: REFERRED TO LIBRARIES AND EDUCATION TECHNOLOGY
bills.sm: Permits libraries occupying or possessing public land to develop, lease, or use such property for the purposes of constructing affordable, mixed-use housing; provides that such use aligns with libraries' educational purposes, represents a valid exercise of the trustees' power, and is in the best interests of the libraries.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Gorham Pageant of Bands
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Gorham, county of Ontario, to the Gorham Pageant of Bands.

bills.t: Relates to requiring insurers participating in the NY state of health marketplace to offer at least one dental plan for individuals age 65 and older
bills.sm: Requires insurers participating in the NY state of health marketplace to offer at least one dental plan for individuals age 65 and older.

bills.t: Relates to authorizing workforce stabilization leave and alternative compensation for certain correctional employees during a qualifying emergency period
bills.sm: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision to declare a staffing emergency when certain conditions are met; provides that eligible employees may request up to three days of non-cumulative workforce stabilization leave per calendar month during a qualifying emergency period; provides that an eligible employee shall receive alternative compensation if they are unable to utilize their workforce stabilization leave due to operational necessity or if such leave is denied.

bills.t: Relates to HIV testing in certain criminal cases
bills.sm: Relates to the time when court ordered HIV testing in certain criminal cases must be conducted.

bills.t: Authorizes distinctive license plates for women veterans
bills.sm: Authorizes distinctive license plates for women veterans; directs that excess service charges collected be used to support programs that support women veterans at the direction of the commissioner of veterans' services.

bills.t: Grants free access and parking at airports for veterans
bills.sm: Grants free access and parking at airports for veterans.

bills.t: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads
bills.sm: Permits the town of Redfield, Oswego county, to designate certain roads as minimum maintenance roads.

bills.t: Relates to the reporting and remediation of certain sites following municipal notification to the department of environmental conservation
bills.sm: Requires a municipality to notify the department of environmental conservation about certain sites containing illegal or hazardous substances; requires the department of environmental conservation to notify the United States environmental protection agency and create a remediation plan for the affected site.

bills.t: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund
bills.sm: Authorizes Mike Hartnett to apply for military service credit in the New York city fire pension fund for active duty service in the U.S. Army from July 7, 1964 until July 7, 1967.

bills.t: Relates to legalizing and validating certain actions taken by the town of Aurelius in apportioning water district costs
bills.sm: Legalizes and validates the establishment of a unit-based tax levy by the town of Aurelius in apportioning certain water district costs in violation of current town law.

bills.t: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules
bills.sm: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules; relates to access to records prepared pursuant to street cleaning parking rules.

bills.t: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property to the town of Goshen
bills.sm: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property located on the Mid-Hudson Forensic Psychiatric Center campus to the town of Goshen.

bills.t: Relates to threats or harm to animals as a means of coercion or coercive control
bills.sm: Provides that the use of threats or harm to animals shall be considered a means of coercion or coercive control.

bills.t: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud and invalidating the filings made by a contested candidate
bills.sm: Deems certain nominating or designating petitions to be permeated with fraud; invalidates the filings made by a contested candidate.

bills.t: Authorizes owners of certain condominium units to apply to raise rents in excess of certain guidelines as an alternative to making a hardship application
bills.sm: Authorizes owners of certain condominium units to apply to raise rents in excess of certain guidelines as an alternative to making a hardship application, where such raise is necessary to exceed annual operating expenses by at least 5%.

bills.t: Authorizes the town of Hamburg to extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include the village of Blasdell
bills.sm: Provides that once the board of trustees of the village of Blasdell abolishes its fire department, the town of Hamburg may extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include such village.

bills.t: Requires a police officer accompanying federal immigration officers to wear and use a body camera and secure the recordings
bills.sm: Requires certain police officers to wear and turn on body-worn cameras when accompanying an agent or officer of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement or of U.S. Customs and Border Protection.

bills.t: Requires certain retailers stock nicotine replacement therapy products
bills.sm: Requires certain retailers stock nicotine replacement therapy products; establishes procedures in how nicotine replacement therapy products may be sold.

bills.t: Relates to coordination of policies and services of the traumatic brain injury program with the office for the prevention of domestic violence
bills.sm: Directs the coordination of policies and services of the traumatic brain injury program with the office for the prevention of domestic violence; includes the executive director of the office for the prevention of domestic violence on the traumatic brain injury services coordinating council.

bills.t: Relates to termination of service, deferred payment plans and quarterly billing
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Increases the number of days between the sending of a notice of termination by a utility corporation and the actual date of termination of service; increases the age of residents in the home to 21 from 18 for purposes of special procedures for terminations; decreases the amount required for a downpayment on an arrears on utility bills; lowers the age of customers to whom a utility company must offer quarterly billing from 62 to 55.

bills.t: Requires an annual report on the New York state college choice tuition savings program and the translation of vital documents in the most common non-English languages
bills.sm: Requires an annual report on the New York state college choice tuition savings program to be delivered to the governor and the legislature and posted on the comptroller's website and the translation of vital documents in the most common non-English languages.

bills.t: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments
bills.sm: Relates to youth programs sponsored by fire departments; provides that participants may respond to an emergency or hazardous activity, but shall remain in an appropriate and safe designated area that has been established by the chief or officer in charge; provides such participants cannot respond to an emergency on a vehicle using lights and/or sirens; provides such participants may not enter a burning structure; protects volunteer fire departments and fire companies from certain criminal and civil liability potentially arising from the operation of a youth program.

bills.t: Relates to health and social services practitioners included under the health care proxy law, the family health care decisions act, and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate
bills.sm: Adds licensed mental health counselors and licensed marriage and family therapists to the health and social services practitioners included under the health care proxy law, the family health care decisions act, and nonhospital orders not to resuscitate.

bills.t: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services
bills.sm: Requires appearance enhancement business and cosmetology licensees and trainees to disclose the price of cosmetology services both verbally and through signage.

bills.t: Enacts the "fair authorized investment returns act"
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Enacts the "fair authorized investment returns act"; sets a default authorized return on equity equal to the ten year US Treasury rate plus two hundred basis points; provides such default authorized return shall reset annually; establishes a competitive equity auction through which the cost of equity for a covered utility may be determined on a market basis, whether initiated by the utility or ordered by the commission.

bills.t: Requires a special election to fill a vacant supervisor position in towns with a population of six hundred thousand or more
bills.sm: Provides that where a supervisor in a town with a population of six hundred thousand or more vacates their position before the end of their term, a special election shall occur in order to fill such vacant supervisor position.

bills.t: Establishes the proposition betting task force
bills.a: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
tl: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
bills.sm: Establishes the proposition betting task force to examine, evaluate and make recommendations concerning proposition betting, with particular consideration of under bets.

bills.t: Establishes a working group to create a pilot program for an alternative system to a credit score
bills.sm: Establishes a working group to create a pilot program for an alternative system to a credit score for unbanked persons, undocumented immigrants and any other individuals who would benefit from such alternative system.

bills.t: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from providing counseling, therapy, and treatment services for bettors in New York
bills.a: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
tl: REFERRED TO RACING, GAMING AND WAGERING
bills.sm: Requires mobile sports wagering operators when providing information regarding compulsive play, all links and referrals for counseling, therapy or treatment services shall direct account holders to the problem gambling services webpage maintained the office of addiction services and supports.

bills.t: Prohibits distribution or publishing any political communication that was produced by or includes materially deceptive media
bills.sm: Prohibits distribution or publishing any political communication that was produced by or includes materially deceptive media.

bills.t: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle for more than 3 consecutive minutes
bills.sm: Prohibits the idling of any passenger vehicle, with certain exceptions, for more than 3 consecutive minutes; establishes the first violation is a warning and subsequent violations of such section are traffic infractions punishable by a fine of $150.

bills.t: Relates to health care payment amounts
bills.sm: Requires an insurance company which owns a health care provider to pay any health care provider which it does not own an amount that is no less than the amount that it pays a health care provider which it does own for a comparable service; prohibits an insurance company which is owned by a health care provider from paying any health care provider which does not own such insurance company an amount that is less than the amount that it pays a health care provider which does own such company for a comparable service.

bills.t: Provides additional protections for sensitive health information and requires patients to have the right to restrict the disclosures of such patient's health information
bills.sm: Provides additional protections for sensitive health information; requires all health information networks, electronic health record systems, and health care providers to provide patients with a right to restrict the disclosures of such patient's health information; defines terms; provides for exceptions.

bills.t: Provides for requirements for vendors who make products available for order and delivery to incarcerated individuals and provide for safe food storage in correctional facilities
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to promulgate rules and regulations for requirements for vendors who make products available for order and delivery to incarcerated individuals and provide for safe food storage for incarcerated individuals in their cells.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 30, 2026, as Therapy Animal Day in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 2, 2026, as Polonia Day in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 29, 2026, as Fentanyl Awareness Day in the State of New York
Relates to a waiver of earnings limitation for certain retired law enforcement officers
bills.sm: Provides a waiver of earnings limitations for retired sworn law enforcement officers employed by the office of the special commissioner of investigations for the New York city school district.

bills.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 4, 2026
bills.sm: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 4, 2026 for the support of government.

bills.t: Increases the weight limits for vehicles powered primarily by electric battery power and other fuels
bills.sm: Provides that a vehicle or a combination of vehicles operated by an engine fueled primarily by means of natural gas, propane gas, or hydrogen or powered primarily by means of electric battery power may exceed certain weight limits by up to two thousand pounds.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 2026 as Bullying Prevention Month in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 2026, as Workers' Awareness Month in the State of New York
Establishes the chief administrator of the courts shall submit annually a report on the Drug Treatment Court Program during the preceding year
bills.sm: Establishes the chief administrator of the courts shall submit annually a report on the administration, function and effectiveness of the Drug Treatment Court Program during the preceding year.

bills.t: Honoring the Washington Street Historical Society upon the occasion of the unveiling of its monument, Al Qalam: Poets in the Park, at Elizabeth H. Berger Plaza on April 30, 2026
Honoring Joseph Emminger upon the occasion of his retirement after 20 years of distinguished service to the town of Tonawanda, New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 29, 2026, as Undiagnosed Rare Disease Day in the State of New York
Provides that coverage for outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder shall not be subject to preauthorization
bills.sm: Provides that coverage for outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder shall not be subject to preauthorization.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 2026, as Co-Occurring Disorders Awareness Month in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim July 23, 2026, as Egyptian Heritage Day in the State of New York
Requires the state to participate in the United Nations for certain purposes
bills.sm: Requires the state to participate in the United Nations human rights council's universal periodic review by submitting a report in the capacity of a subnational stakeholder.

bills.t: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system
bills.sm: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

bills.t: Relates to the approval of applications of charter schools
bills.sm: Provides that charter school applicants shall first apply to the community district education council or the board of education of the school district for approval for renewal of a charter within a certain amount of time and public hearings shall be conducted on such proposed application.

bills.t: Provides for the implementation of certain parts of the state fiscal plan for the 2026-2027 state fiscal year
bills.sm: Authorizes the South Country central school district, in the county of Suffolk, to issue serial bonds for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general fund; requires that the district prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances; provides for advance aid to such school district (Part A); extends provisions of law relating to directing the state inspector general to appoint an independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency for one year (Part B).

bills.t: Defines satisfaction of judgment and authorizing satisfactions to be filed on affirmation
bills.sm: Defines the term "satisfaction" in relation to the satisfaction of judgments; allows satisfaction of judgments to be filed by affirmation rather than after notarization; increases the time during which attorneys may file satisfaction of judgment from ten to twenty years; clarifies that the twenty-day time limit applicable to filing satisfactions of judgment is measured in business days.

bills.t: Commending Douglas DiGesare upon the occasion of his designation as recipient of the 2026 Leadership Award and the Years of Service Award by the New York Alliance for Inclusion and Innovation
Provides coverage for a cranial prosthesis under certain conditions
bills.sm: Provides coverage for a cranial prosthesis under certain conditions; defines a cranial prosthesis as a wig or hairpiece.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 2026 as Parkinson's Disease Awareness Month in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim February 2026 as Career and Technical Education Month in the State of New York
Establishes a moratorium on the installation of synthetic turf pending a comprehensive environmental and public health study
bills.sm: Establishes a moratorium on the installation of synthetic turf pending a comprehensive environmental and public health study; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

bills.t: Repeals the tax exempt status of private universities that receive real property tax exemptions of one hundred million dollars or more
bills.sm: Repeals the tax exempt status of private universities that received real property tax exemptions of one hundred million dollars or more during the prior fiscal year.

bills.t: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment
bills.sm: Allows certain defenses to parking violations despite entering of a default judgment.

bills.t: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree
bills.sm: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree.

bills.t: Relates to major renovations or alterations to a cemetery
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires the approval of a cemetery board before a major renovation or major alteration and upon submission of a report by the cemetery; requires certain information about applications and permits be included in such report; requires any report submitted for a major renovation or major alteration expected to cost in excess of $250,000 be certified by a licensed engineer, architect or landscape architect; changes the due date for each cemetery corporation's report from March 15th to April 15th.

bills.t: Establishes representative requirements for district leadership teams and school leadership teams
bills.sm: Requires district leadership teams and school leadership teams to include student representatives; provides who should appoint such representatives.

bills.t: Repeals provisions of law relating to prohibiting the installation of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems in new construction and to certain decarbonization action plans
bills.sm: Repeals provisions of law relating to prohibiting the installation of fossil-fuel equipment and building systems in new construction and to establishing decarbonization action plans for state-owned facilities.

bills.t: Mourning the death of Salvador Vizcarrondo Jr. distinguished citizen and devoted member of his community
Relates to administrative law judges overseeing the process certain policy proceedings
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Requires the department of public service to assign an administrative law judge to oversee the process in policy proceedings before the public service commission; provides that the department of public service shall be considered a party in policy proceedings.

bills.t: Establishes the citywide leadership team; appropriation
bills.sm: Establishes the citywide leadership team to ensure that parents' and students' voices are represented in all education decision-making, ensure education policies considered or implemented are conducive to promoting student achievement and enhancing the overall quality of education for students attending public schools in the city of New York, and include all stakeholders at all stages of the decision-making process.

bills.t: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies
bills.sm: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies; establishes penalties for failure to establish such policies.

bills.t: Requires district leadership teams to operate under open meetings law requirements
bills.sm: Requires district leadership teams to operate under open meetings law requirements.

bills.t: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
bills.sm: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

bills.t: Honoring Christian Jerome upon the occasion of his designation as Athlete of the Year
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim October 14, 2026, as Emergency Nurses Day and October 11-17, 2026, as Emergency Nurses Week in the State of New York
Honoring Christian Jerome upon the occasion of his designation as Athlete of the Year
Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services
bills.sm: Requires all motor vehicle insurers to file annual detailed financial and claim data statements with the superintendent of financial services; provides all such statements shall be made available to the public.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 2026, as Esophageal Cancer Awareness Month in the State of New York
Establishes a two generation pilot program
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Establishes a two generation pilot program to promote family stability and children's school readiness; provides for the repeal of this section in five years.

bills.t: Mourning the untimely death of Arthur W. Jones Jr., renowned professional athlete, admired role model, and devoted member of his community
Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems
bills.sm: Requires financial security for reclamation for solar and wind electric generating systems.

bills.t: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County
bills.sm: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim May 26, 2026, as Guyanese Independence Day in the State of New York
Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim November 28, 2026, as Albanian-American Heritage Day in the State of New York
Creates a commission to evaluate the need for community colleges to participate in the educational opportunity program
bills.sm: Creates a commission to evaluate the need for community colleges to participate in the educational opportunity program.

bills.t: Relates to the introduction and use of business records in grand jury proceedings
bills.sm: Provides that any writing or record made as a memorandum or record of any act, transaction, occurrence or event, may be received in grand jury proceedings as evidence of proof that such act, transaction, occurrence or event, if it was made in the regular course of any business.

bills.t: Directs the commissioner of education to change the name of the state high school equivalency diploma to the Excelsior diploma
bills.sm: Directs the commissioner of education to change the name of the state high school equivalency diploma, formerly known as the general education development (GED) program, to the Excelsior diploma.

bills.t: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026
bills.sm: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 30, 2026 for the support of government.

bills.t: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership
bills.sm: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department, located in the village of Williamsville, county of Erie, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership.

bills.t: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to make publicly available on its website information regarding waivers, rental supplement plans and shelter supplement plans
bills.sm: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to make publicly available on its website information regarding waivers, rental supplement plans and shelter supplement plans.

bills.t: Relates to defining community significant projects and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program
bills.sm: Defines community significant projects as a business creating or retaining current jobs as determined by the commissioner, with particular emphasis on employment and/or training of current public housing residents; currently located or to be located in existing leased space of a building in a public housing development in the state; and which makes significant qualified capital investments to start a business, or improve services and working conditions for an existing business, when located in such public housing space and including such projects in the excelsior jobs program.

bills.sm: Enacts the "packaging reduction and recycling infrastructure act" to require companies selling, offering for sale, or distributing packaging materials and products to register with a packaging reduction organization to develop a packaging reduction and recycling plan; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Memorializing Governor Kathy Hochul to proclaim April 27, 2026, as Children of the Holocaust Remembrance Day in the State of New York
Enacts the "commuter rail employee rights protection act"
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Enacts the "commuter rail employee rights protection act".

bills.t: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission to review and evaluate statewide planning, development, and implementation of caregiver support services, including respite care, for informal family caregivers caring for those across the lifespan.

Celebrating the 100th Anniversary of the birth of John Coltrane, renowned artistic trailblazer and innovative New York jazz musician
Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives
bills.a: REPORTED REFERRED TO WAYS AND MEANS
bills.sm: Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives to issue grants to initiatives regarding the promotion and advancement of fatherhood, including but not limited to all underserved fatherhood groups to help expand opportunities to improve parenting knowledge, attitudes, and self-efficacy.

bills.t: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child
bills.sm: Requires immediate notification of a child's parent when an allegation of child abuse in an educational setting has been made regarding such child.

bills.t: Relates to companion animals
bills.sm: Provides that companion animals, as sentient beings, shall be considered victims of animal cruelty crimes, including but not limited to all offenses as defined in article twenty-six of the agriculture and markets law, and shall be treated as such in a court of law.

bills.t: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption from the Al-Hikmah Institute Inc.
Increases the mileage fees in the city of New York for services provided by sheriffs
bills.sm: Increases the mileage fees in the city of New York for services provided by sheriffs.

bills.t: Relates to the statute of limitations for leaving the scene of an accident which resulted in the death of another person
bills.sm: Enacts "Pete's law"; provides that a prosecution for a hit-and-run which results in the death of a victim may be commenced at any time.

bills.t: Provides for inclusive instruction and instructional materials
bills.sm: Requires school districts and charter schools to establish a task force to make recommendations on model curriculum or instruction on the political, economic, and social contributions of lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer, intersex, and asexual people, in an appropriate place in the curriculum of middle school and high school students.

bills.t: Relates to credit monitoring services
bills.a: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Provides that if the person or business providing the notification was the source of the breach, an offer to provide appropriate identity theft prevention and mitigation services, shall be provided at no cost to the affected person for not less than 12 months, along with all information necessary to take advantage of the offer to any person whose information was or may have been breached if the breach exposed or may have exposed personal information.

bills.t: Enacts the "automatic utility deferment act"
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Enacts the "automatic utility deferment act" which requires regulated utility providers to automatically suspend termination of service and waive late payment penalties for state employees who are subject to a payroll freeze because the state budget was not passed by April first.

bills.t: Establishes hate crimes against police officers
bills.sm: Establishes hate crimes against police officers; defines such crimes as committing murder in the first degree, aggravated murder, or murder in the second degree against a police officer and the victim is chosen because they are a police officer.

bills.t: Removes the deadly weapon or dangerous instrument requirement from aggravated assault upon a police officer or peace officer
bills.sm: Removes the deadly weapon or dangerous instrument requirement from aggravated assault upon a police officer or peace officer.

bills.t: Ensures diversity and inclusion at certain state entities and combats harassment and discrimination in the workplace
bills.sm: Establishes the committee for diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, the office of diversity management, and the state workforce diversity and inclusions council to ensure diversity and inclusion at certain state entities and combat harassment and discrimination in the workplace.

bills.t: Relates to the identification of individuals who provide face-to-face care to or direct observation of a patient
bills.sm: Limits the identification of individuals who provide face-to-face care to or direct observation of a patient to their employee identification number, first name and first initial of last name when full name identification may place the personal safety of such individual in jeopardy.

bills.t: Relates to the use of aerial images for the purposes of homeowners' insurance
bills.sm: Imposes certain requirements for the use of aerial images of an insured property for the purposes of homeowners' insurance; requires certain notices and appeals process.

bills.t: Prohibits the disclosure of the personal information of any active or former New York state, New York city or local municipal emergency first responder, judges or prosecutors
bills.sm: Prohibits the disclosure of the home address, personal telephone numbers, personal email addresses or personal social media handles of any active or former New York state, New York city or local municipal emergency first responder, a judge of any court of law of this state, or a New York state, county or municipal prosecutor or the spouse or child thereof; relates to criminal penalties; permits civil action.

bills.t: Prohibits investment managers from assisting in investing moneys belonging to retirement system
bills.sm: Prohibits investment managers from assisting in investing moneys belonging to retirement systems; defines who qualifies as an investment manager.

bills.t: Relates to enforcement of owner liability for failure of an operator to stop for a school bus
bills.sm: Provides that the use of school bus photo violation monitoring systems shall be limited to the geographic boundaries of school districts which adopt resolutions opting into such programs.

bills.t: Relates to requiring resident councils to maintain websites with certain information
bills.sm: Provides that every resident council shall maintain a website and shall post on such website such resident council's budgets and spending of tenant participation activity funds.

bills.t: Authorizes public transit agencies to hire former police officers as transit security marshals having peace officer status
bills.sm: Authorizes public transit agencies to hire former police officers as transit security marshals having peace officer status, provided they complete trainings and meet medical and physical fitness standards.

bills.t: Relates to the crimes of assault in the second degree and assault in the first degree in places, conveyances, or vehicles used for public transportation or public transit
bills.sm: Provides that a person is guilty of assault in the second degree when such person recklessly or with intent to cause physical injury to another person causes physical injury to another person in any place, conveyance, or vehicle used for public transportation or public transit; provides that a person is guilty of assault in the first degree when with intent to cause serious physical injury to another person such person causes such injury to such other person in any place, conveyance, or vehicle used for public transportation or public transit.

bills.t: Relates to establishing enhanced attendance verification procedures for members of the legislature
bills.sm: Requires legislative members to verify attendance on legislative session days via an identification card system and facial recognition technology.

bills.t: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings
bills.sm: Creates shared housing rooming units in new class A multiple dwellings or buildings converted to class A multiple dwellings; creates new regulations in the New York city building codes.

bills.t: Relates to the alternative veterans property tax exemption
bills.sm: Relates to the alternative veterans property tax exemption; authorizes active members of the military to apply for such exemption.

bills.t: Relates to residential rehabilitation units in correctional facilities
bills.sm: Prohibits the department of corrections from placing incarcerated individuals in two-person cells in residential rehabilitation units unless such incarcerated individuals agree.

bills.t: Relates to permitting certified handicapped individuals and senior citizens to use all-terrain vehicles on state land for hunting purposes
bills.sm: Permits certified handicapped individuals and senior citizens to use all-terrain vehicles on state land for certain hunting purposes; directs the department of environmental conservation to establish a senior game recovery permit program to allow use of all-terrain vehicles on state lands by senior hunters for the purpose of retrieving big game.

bills.t: Requires community median income be used by certain affordable housing programs in N.Y. City
bills.sm: Requires community median income be used by certain affordable housing programs in a city having a population of one million or more; requires affordable housing programs using state funding to cover 33 percent or more of the construction costs of a building or buildings to use community median income to determine income eligibility and rent levels; exempts programs utilizing federal funding.

bills.t: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity
bills.sm: Increases the statewide energy storage capacity to six gigawatts by the year 2030, twelve gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2040, and seventeen gigawatts of statewide energy storage capacity by 2050.

bills.t: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process
bills.sm: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process; provides for automatic denial of such application for failure to make such report.

bills.t: Gives state residents reservation preference for state parks and recreational facilities
bills.a: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Gives state residents reservation preference for state parks and recreational facilities.

bills.t: Eliminates fees for receiving a copy of a high school equivalency diploma
bills.sm: Eliminates fees for receiving a copy of a high school equivalency diploma and/or transcript.

bills.t: Relates to autonomous vehicle driving
bills.sm: Provides that a person may operate a fully autonomous vehicle on the public roads of this state without a human driver provided that the automated driving system is engaged and the vehicle meets certain conditions; defines terms; requires insurance and that such vehicle is registered as a fully autonomous vehicle; makes related provisions.

bills.t: Prohibits persons who were sentenced for a crime involving unlawful sexual conduct or assault from using public transportation
bills.sm: Prohibits persons who were sentenced for a crime involving unlawful sexual conduct or assault from using public transportation including services in the transportation of passengers, airports, train stations, subway and rail stations, and bus terminals.

bills.t: Establishes limitations on taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel; authorizes certain local laws limiting taxes on motor fuel
bills.sm: Provides for a phased decrease of excise taxes and sales taxes and petroleum business taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel when the average price of motor fuel in the state exceeds $2.25 per gallon; authorizes cities having a population of one million or more and counties to adopt local laws limiting taxes on diesel motor fuel and motor fuel.

bills.t: Enacts the "renewable energy project labor agreement act"; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof
bills.sm: Enacts the "renewable energy project labor agreement act" in relation to requiring project labor agreements for renewable energy projects receiving state support; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

bills.t: Relates to limiting the liability of low-income housing providers who receive government assistance, and establishing a temporary insurance stabilization program for such entities
bills.sm: Limits the liability of low-income housing providers who receive government assistance; establishes a temporary insurance stabilization program for such entities.

bills.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 125th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 125th Street Luther Vandross station
bills.a: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
tl: REFERRED TO CORPORATIONS, AUTHORITIES AND COMMISSIONS
bills.sm: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 125th Street - Lexington Avenue subway station to the 125th street - Luther Vandross station.

bills.t: Directs the department of health to conduct a study of recreational activity programming in nursing homes
bills.sm: Directs the department of health to conduct a study and prepare a report of recreational activity programming in nursing homes examining the accessibility and inclusivity of programming, including accommodations for residents with physical or cognitive impairments, availability of multilingual services, transportation for off-site programming, and scheduling considerations.

bills.t: Relates to the public campaign finance board and certain matching funds
bills.sm: Authorizes the public campaign finance board to accept an application/certification form jointly signed by candidates for governor and lieutenant governor for eligibility to participate in public matching funds.

bills.t: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment
bills.sm: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card.

bills.t: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer
bills.sm: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer within 2 years of the effective date.

bills.t: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times
bills.sm: Requires small businesses to have and maintain a first aid kit on the premises of the business at all times and to store such kits in an accessible location and to make such kits available for use by any person who enters the premises of the business.

bills.t: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip to be a nonresident of such town
bills.sm: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip, in the county of Suffolk, to be a nonresident of such town.

bills.t: Allows Christopher Strattner, a retired police officer, to serve as chief of police for the town of Fishkill police department without diminution of retirement benefits
bills.sm: Allows Christopher Strattner, a retired police officer, to serve as chief of police for the town of Fishkill police department without diminution of retirement benefits.

bills.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to William E. Peterson
bills.sm: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk to William E. Peterson.

bills.t: Keeps professional sports franchises in their home communities
bills.a: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
tl: REFERRED TO TOURISM, PARKS, ARTS AND SPORTS DEVELOPMENT
bills.sm: Keeps professional sports franchises in their home communities by requiring franchise owners offer the franchise for sale prior to relocating or eliminating the franchise.

bills.t: Requires instruction on nutrition in schools
bills.sm: Requires instruction on nutrition in schools at all grades.

bills.t: Expands the amount of information required in client service reports
bills.sm: Expands the amount of information required in client service reports to include the identity of persons who assist a client or patient.

bills.t: Enacts the "fraudulent social media advertising prevention act"
bills.a: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
tl: REFERRED TO CONSUMER AFFAIRS AND PROTECTION
bills.sm: Requires social-media platforms to prevent, detect, and remove fraudulent advertisements and to establish advertiser-vetting obligations; requires reporting to the attorney general.

bills.t: Increases the distance allowed between cannabis storefronts and premises for adult-use on-site consumption and school grounds and houses of worship; restricts their distance with a child day care
bills.sm: Increases the distance allowed between cannabis storefronts and premises for adult-use on-site consumption and school grounds and houses of worship; restricts their distance with a child day care.

bills.t: Provides for the use of rooms within a public school at a reasonable rate
bills.sm: Provides for the use of rooms within a public school at a reasonable rate.

bills.t: Requires a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure
bills.sm: Requires a mortgagor to provide notice of imminent foreclosure to their tenant or prospective tenant prior to renewing or signing a lease agreement.

bills.t: Relates to the utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises, service-disabled veteran-owned businesses, small businesses and microbusinesses by private businesses operating in state-funded bldgs
bills.sm: Relates to the utilization of minority and women-owned business enterprises, service-disabled veteran-owned businesses, small businesses and microbusinesses in state-funded construction projects; directs the empire state development corporation, in consultation with other state agencies, to develop a state division of post-construction commitments and compliance to create rules and regulations for private businesses operating in buildings constructed using state funding to have certain employment goals and living wage requirements, annual minority and women-owned business enterprise, certified service-disabled veteran-owned business, small business and microbusiness utilization goals for…

bills.t: Increases transparency in certain film production and post-production tax credits
bills.sm: Requires the department of economic development issue a quarterly report on film production and post-production tax credits by project and by county in the aggregate and publish such reports on such department's website.

bills.t: Establishes the crime of aggravated disorderly conduct
bills.sm: Establishes the crime of aggravated disorderly conduct; designates such crime as a specified offense for the purposes of hate crimes.

bills.t: Relates to expanding the definition of interim multiple dwelling to provide protections for certain residents
bills.sm: Expands the definition of interim multiple dwelling (lofts) to provide protections for certain remaining, long time residents.

bills.t: Requires signatures on a voter registration form to be notarized and providing a fail-safe registration method
bills.sm: Requires signatures on a voter registration form to be notarized or providing other identity proofs.

bills.t: Enacts the "Technical Sergeant Joseph G. Lemm tuition benefit act"
bills.sm: Enacts the "Technical Sergeant Joseph G. Lemm tuition benefit act" to allow members of the New York state organized militia to receive tuition benefits for certain post-secondary degree programs.

bills.t: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office
bills.sm: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office; directs such office shall provide information to legislative committees of the senate and assembly with respect to the state budget, appropriation bills and other bills providing budget authority or tax expenditures; requires such office to report to the temporary president of the senate, the senate minority leader, the speaker of the assembly and the assembly minority leader.

bills.t: Relates to registration fees for certain motor vehicles; repealer
bills.sm: Increases fees for the registration of larger, heavier motor vehicles; provides a waiver for a portion of weight added by batteries in electric vehicles.

bills.t: Requires the establishment of an appeals process for students who are denied the state resident tuition rate at any public university or college
bills.sm: Requires the establishment of an appeals process for students who are denied the state resident tuition rate at any public university or college.

bills.t: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists
bills.sm: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists including: campaign contributions to elected officials; existing business relationships or associations with public officials; and the names of family members of a public official to whom the lobbyist, or their employer, paid compensation of over $500 in the preceding calendar year and the amount of compensation paid; provides for the disposition of campaign funds.

bills.t: Relates to the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer
bills.a: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
tl: REFERRED TO INVESTIGATIONS AND GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS
bills.sm: Authorizes the deposit of additional sales and compensating use taxes by the county of Herkimer into the general fund of the county.

bills.t: Ensures that the provisions governing liquor licenses are consistent with respect to public interest factors
bills.sm: Ensures that the provisions governing liquor licenses are consistent with respect to public interest factors.

bills.t: Relates to unlawful surveillance in the first degree
bills.sm: Expands unlawful surveillance in the first degree to include instances where the surveillance is of a person who has an active order of protection against them.

bills.t: Enacting the lead-free game donation act
bills.sm: Prohibits game taken by a firearm using lead ammunition from being donated for human consumption.

bills.t: Designates unlawful discriminatory practices relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder
bills.sm: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices by government agencies relating to persons recovering from substance use disorder.

bills.t: Relates to the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection
bills.sm: Waives the ability of government agencies in New York to claim copyright protection except where the record reflects artistic, creative or scholarly works of authorship, academic course materials, or scientific or academic research, or if the copyright owner intends to distribute the record of derivative work based on it to the public by sale or other transfer of ownership.

bills.t: Directs the department of labor to post on its internet website and annually update the names of employers who employ 50 or more employees who receive public assistance
bills.sm: Directs the department of labor to post on its internet website and annually update the names of employers who employ 50 or more employees who receive public assistance.

bills.t: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding certain licensures and employment
bills.sm: Relates to the definition of "direct relationship" for the purposes of article 23-A of the correction law regarding licensures and employment of persons previously convicted of one or more criminal offenses.

bills.t: Requires the department of environmental conservation review laws and policies pertaining to free or reduced cost hunting and fishing licenses
bills.sm: Requires the department of environmental conservation to review laws and policies pertaining to free or reduced cost hunting and fishing licenses.

bills.t: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child
bills.sm: Provides for the issuance of birth certificates of a deceased parent to their child.

bills.t: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act
bills.sm: Enacts the child abuse reporting expansion act; relates to making clergy members required reporters of child abuse or mistreatment.
